data.name: Satisfactory.ConnectingAutomatically
data.value: Guteranya: kurungika itegeko, gufata icemeza, no kwemeza isano...

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleInputBusy
data.value: Hariho itegeko ritararangira muri console y'iyi serveri. Gukuraho imbere yo guhuza; Synix ntishobora kuyisubiriza.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleFilters
data.value: Nukure ivyandikano vy'ivyandikano vyo kuri iyo serveri kugira ngo Synix ishobore gusoma ico kimenyetso gishasha.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.LocalIdentity
data.value: Urubuga rwa API rwo mu karere si urw'umukozi yatowe. Nusuzume ikibuga cayo co gukiniramwo; nta kimenyetso na kimwe carungitswe kuri iyo API.

data.name: Satisfactory.NotConnected
data.value: Guhitamwo guhuza: gukurikiza Connect API nyuma yo kwinjiza no gutangura seriveri. Ubugenzuzi busanzwe bwa Synix buracabandanya gukora ata kamenyetso.

data.name: Satisfactory.StartFirst
data.value: Tangura seriveri yashizwe hamwe na Synix, hanyuma uyisabe muri Satisfactory's in-game Server Manager. Subira ngaha uhuze API.

data.name: Satisfactory.ConnectedHint
data.value: API ihuye na {0}. Nusubize ibintu mu buryo kugira ngo usubiremwo amakuru y'ubu.

data.name: Satisfactory.SetupSteps
data.value:
Kurangiza itegurwa rya mbere muri Satisfactory's Server Manager hanyuma ugumane seriveri ikorana na -NewConsole.
Fyonda aha hepfo. Synix irarungika iryo tegeko, igasoma ico kimenyetso gishasha, ikagisuzuma, maze igicungera neza. Nta gukoporora canke kwinjizamwo.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.AmbiguousToken
data.value: Ako gakingirizo karasubije utuntu dutandukanye. Nta bucuti bwazigamwe.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleUnavailable
data.value: Synix ntishobora kwinjira muri console ya Unreal y'iyi serveur. Bitangurire kuri -NewConsole hanyuma ukoreshe uburenganzira bumwe bwa Windows kuri Synix no kuri seriveri.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleTokenMissing
data.value: Iryo tegeko ryararungitswe, ariko Synix ntiyashoboye gusoma ikimenyetso gishasha cose kivuye mu vyo iyo serveur yasohotse. Nusuzume ko serveri iriko irishura be n'uko inyandiko yayo ishobora kwandikwa. Imigenderanire yose yazigamwe yaragumijwe; iryo tegeko ntiryasubiwemwo.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleBusy
data.value: Icombo ntikiriko kiritabira canke hari ikiganiro kiriko kiraba. Subira ugerageze. Iryo tegeko ntirizokwigera risubirwamwo mu buryo bwikora.

data.name: Satisfactory.TokenSafety
data.value: Ibi bituma Synix imenyekana. Ako kamenyetso kariko karashirwako amabanga y'ikonte yawe ya Windows, kandi ntikigera gashirwa mu migambi y'urukino canke mu vyo gutanguza urubuga. Satisfactory irayerekana muri console yayo no mu gitabo cayo; ivyo bigume ari ibanga. Gukuraho ihurizo ryarokowe ntibikuraho ico kimenyetso.

data.name: Satisfactory.SecurityHelp
data.value: Inyuma yo gushiraho Satisfactory, tangura seriveri na -NewConsole. Muri Synix: Server Options → Satisfactory Control Center → Connect API → Connect automatically. Ubwo bucuti budasabwa ntibwigera bubuza uburyo busanzwe bwo gucungera imbuga.

data.name: Satisfactory.AddAfterInstall
data.value: Kwongerako ukoresheje Control Center inyuma yo kwinjiza

data.name: Satisfactory.Updated
data.value: Igihinduwe {0}. Ibiharuro vy'abakinyi b'ibikoresho vyo ku kibaho birasubirwamwo mu buryo bwikora; iki gishushanyo kirashobora guhindurwa hakurikijwe ibisabwa.

data.name: Satisfactory.Connected
data.value: Ikimenyetso cemejwe kandi kizigamwe neza. Ubu umukinyi arakurikiranwa.

data.name: Satisfactory.DisconnectConfirm
data.value: Gukuramwo Synix igicapo n'inyemezabwishingizi vyazigamwe kuri iyi seriveri? Serveri izoguma ikora. Ibindi vyasabwe ntivyugarwa.

data.name: Satisfactory.StartConfirm
data.value: Gutangura iki gisata biciye kuri Synix? Mu gihe itashizweko, igikorwa gisanzwe co gushiraho Synix kizobandanya.

data.name: Satisfactory.StopConfirm
data.value: Guhagarika iyi serveri biciye kuri Synix? Abakinyi bazova ku murongo. Synix izokwerekana ko iyo modoka yahagaritswe n'ibigirankana kugira ngo umurinzi ntaze asubire kuyitangura.

data.name: Satisfactory.RestartConfirm
data.value: Gusubiza iyi seriveri ku murongo biciye kuri Synix? Abakinyi bafatanije bazotandukanywa.

data.name: Satisfactory.LifecycleFailed
data.value: Synix ntiyashoboye kurangiza ico gikorwa c'umukozi. Nusuzume ibijanye n'ibikorwa be n'ibijanye no gusuzuma indwara.

data.name: Satisfactory.OptionsHelp
data.value: Nusubize ibintu ku rutonde rw'ibisomwa vyashigikiwe n'iyi seriveri. Hindura ibiciro, hanyuma ukoreshe impinduka zawe gusa. Imfunguruzo z'urukino be n'ibiharuro biguma mu congereza. Ibiciro birindiriye bishobora gukenera gusubirwamwo biciye kuri Synix.

data.name: Satisfactory.ApplyConfirm
data.value: Gushira mu ngiro {0} impinduka za seriveri? Amahinduka amwamwe yoshobora gusaba ko utangura ubuzima bushasha. Synix ntizosubira gukora.

data.name: Satisfactory.DiscardOptions
data.value: Kwirengagiza amahinduka yawe y'ibikoresho utarinze kuzigama hanyuma ugasubira ku murongo?

data.name: Satisfactory.OptionsApplied

data.value: Inyubako ya seriveri ntiyuzuye canke ntishobora kuvugururwa neza.

data.value: Fungura ikigo kijejwe ivy'ukwitegurira gukorana n'abaserukira abandi maze ukoreshe Fix Config igihe kiboneka. Synix ikora backup imbere yo gusubiramwo configuration yafashwe.

data.value: Fungura ikigo kijejwe ivy'ukwitegura kw'amasereri kugira ngo usuzume neza. Urashobora gusubiramwo amakuru y'ubuhinga ari munsi nimba ukeneye gutanga raporo y'iyo ngorane.

data.value: Fungura Live Process Details hanyuma uhagarike ikopi ya kera y'iyi serveri, canke uhindure iyo serveri hanyuma uhitemwo irembo ry'ubusa. Subira ugerageze.

data.name: GameDefinitions.Builder.Guide
data.value:
Gutangura ningoga 1. Andika izina ry'umukino n'igitigiri Steam ca AppID ya seriveri. 2. Andika inzira ya seriveri ikurikizwa ijanye n'ububiko bwa seriveri bwashizweho. 3. Niwandike gusa icanditswe c'iryo tegeko kiza inyuma y'igitabo gikora. Koresha utujambo dushigikiwe hepfo aho Synix igomba kwinjiza igenamiterere ry'umukoresha. 4. Nuhitemwo ukuntu urukino ruronka idosiye y'ingene rwatunganijwe. Uburyo butunganijwe busaba idosiye yuzuye, ikora neza y'ibikoresho, atari akarorero gatoya. 5. Nuhitemwo Validate & Preview. Gukosora ingorane zose zashikirijwe imbere yo kuzigama. 6. Kubika, gusubiramwo Synix, gukora ibizamini vy'imashini, hanyuma kugerageza gushiraho/gutangura/guhagarika/kugenzura urukino.
UBUHAMYA BUSHINZWE • Izina ry'umukino: izina abakoresha babona muri Synix. • ID y'igiharuro: ID idasanzwe y'inyuguti ntoyi; Synix irabikura mw'izina ry'urukino. • Steam AppID: dedicated-server AppID, si buri gihe umukino wa client AppID. • SteamCMD app configuration: ubusanzwe ni ubusa. Imikino ya GoldSrc AppID 90 ikoreshwa mu buryo bwemejwe '90 mod folder', nk'akarorero '90 mod cstrike'. Synix yemera gusa ubwo buryo bwo kwikingira. • Igishobora gushirwa mu ngiro: nk'akarorero Binaries\Win64\Server.exe. Ntiharimwo agapfukamunwa ko kwinjiza. • Ibivuko: ibivuko vy'imikino n'ivy'ibibazo vyemejwe. • Ikarata n'uburyo bwo gukina: niwandike igiciro kimwe c'urukino ku murongo. Ivyo bica bitanga amahitamwo yerekanwa igihe uriko urakora canke uhindura umusereva.
INTUMBERO ZIHAMBAYE KU GUTANGURA Ntimushire muri executable ubwayo. Gumana ibendera ry'umukino nk'inyandiko isanzwe kandi ushiremwo amatag gusa ku biciro bigenzurwa na Synix. Akarorero: -port {port} -queryport {query} -name "{ServerName}" -maxplayers {MaxPlayers}
IBIGIRANIRO BISHIGIKIWE [LAUNCH_ARGUMENT_TAGS]
RCON RECIPE Shira {rcon} mu bisobanuro vy'ugutanguza aho itegeko RCON ritegerezwa kuba riri. Mu gisomwa ca RCON, ukoreshe: [RCON_ARGUMENT_TAGS] Akarorero RCON syntax: +rcon.port {rcon_port} +rcon.password "{rcon_pass}"
IBIGENZEKO BIKURIKIRA • Ntivyemejwe: Synix ntishobora gucunga config file. • Umukino uragihingura inyuma yo gutangura ubwa mbere: ukoreshe config yose yafashwe nk'igishushanyo c'uguhindura no gusanura. • Synix irikura mu gishushanyo: Synix ishira config yose imbere y'uko itangura. • Gutangura impari gusa: urukino ntirukeneye uburyo bwo gutunganya izo mpari.
UBUGENZI TEMPLE TAGS Uburyo bwo guhitamwo {ServerName}, {Password}, {HasPassword}, {AdminPassword}, {MaxPlayers}, {Port}, {QueryPort}, {RCONPort}, {RCONPassword}, {EnableRcon}, {Identity}, {WorldName}, {WorldSeed}, {WorldSize}, {AppPort}, {LocalIP}, {PublicIP}, {IsPvp}, {IsPve}, {GameMode} {HasPassword} yandika igiciro c'ukuri c'insiguro igihe hariho ijambo ry'ibanga rya seriveri n'igiciro cayo kitari ryo igihe iryo jambo ry'ibanga ritagira ico rivuze. Koresha Add configuration files igihe seriveri ikeneye dosiye irenze imwe. Hitamwo buri dosiye yose y'isoko, uce uhindura aho iri mw'isandugu kugira ngo inzira ibe iyigereranije n'ububiko bwa seriveri. Synix iremeza, igashiramwo, ikandika, igasanura, kandi igatera imbere buri dosiye yanditswe hamwe.
IBIGENZEKO BITANGWA N'UMUKIRIZA Andika inzira imwe y'umutekano ku murongo, ugereranije n'ububiko bwa seriveri bwashizweho. Amadosiye asabwa abuza gutangura gushika ubu; amadosiye y'amahitamwo arinjizwa iyo abonywe ariko ntiyigera abuza gutangura. Mu gihe dosiye zisabwa ziva mu rukino rusanzwe, sobanura intambwe yose y'ukoresha mu mabwiriza yo gushiraho. Synix ntiyigera ikura, ikirengagiza uburenganzira umuntu afise, canke ngo isubire gukwiragiza amadosiye y'abakinyi bafise uruhusha. Ububiko bw'amakuru yo hanze ni izina ry'ububiko Synix ishobora kurondera munsi y'ububiko bw'inyandiko z'umukoresha. Urashobora kuyireka igaragara igihe umukoresha ategerezwa gukoporora amadosiye n'intoki.
IGIHAMBA CYO KUBONA INTANGURIRO N'IJAMBO Nushireho imburi igihe abakoresha bategerezwa kurangiza gushiraho imbere y'uko batangura. Niwandike intambwe z'ukuri kandi umenye ikintu ico ari co cose umukoresha ategerezwa kuronka mu kwinjiza urukino rwiwe bwite. Icon URL ni optionel kandi igomba gukoresha HTTPS. Synix iragaruka kuri icegeranyo c'igikorwa ca seriveri yashizweko igihe kitagira ico givuze.
KUGUSUBIRA IBIGWIRIZA N'UBUKINGIKE Gutangura ibisobanuro n'ibishushanyo bishasha ku mpinyanyuro 1. Kwongereza igenzura ry'igiharuro igihe cose igiharuro c'urukino gihindutse. Kwongerera isubirwamwo ry'igishushanyo igihe gusa ihindurwa ry'uburyo bwo gutunganya ibintu. Synix iranka gusubiramwo ata mpinduka yo hejuru kandi irazigama ama backups y'inyongera.
IBIGENZEKO BIKURIKIRA GUSHIRIZA Gushira mu ngiro Steam igihe c'uguhererekanya gusa igihe seriveri yemejwe ko ibisaba. Ikigenewe gitegerezwa kuba igipapuro gifitaniye isano n'ico gisata. Synix ikoporora gusa DLLs zayo zitatu ziri ku rutonde rwemewe rwa Steam runtime.
IBINTU BITEGEKWA KU BIJANYE N'Igihe co Gukora Gushira minimum system RAM kuri 0 igihe umukino udafise minimum yemewe. Ibikoresho n'ibipimo vya Windows birasigura ibisabwa bitarakorwa imbere y'ugushiraho no gukinga ugutanguza bidakingiwe; ntibahindura imiterere ya Windows. Guhitamwo .NET Framework canke Visual C++ runtime gusa igihe ibisabwa n'urukino bivyerekana. Synix iraba muri registry ya Windows ariko ntiyigera ishiraho canke ngo ikureko ibisabwa mu mwiherero. Hyper-V irasaba Windows Professional canke hejuru, rero guhitamwo Hyper-V na vyo nyene bihitamwo ico gisabwa ca Windows.
INYIGISHO Z'Igihe co gufungura Koresha uburyo busanzwe bwo gukurikirana ivyakozwe ku bakiriya basanzwe. Gushira hanze ni ugushira mu ngiro gusa, imashini nyabwonko, canke iyindi nshingano ifise ubuzima bwa seriveri; buca buzimanganya gukurikirana ibibazo. Gushiraho "Manager visible" (umuyobozi w'abakinyi) ku dukino dutegerezwa kugumiza "manager" (umuyobozi w'abakinyi) yawo. Ivyo birakurira hejuru ivyo umukoresha ahitamwo vyose ku bijanye n'uguhisha urubuga gusa kuri iryo tegeko. Uburyo bwo gutanguza bwagutse bushigikirwa gusa ku madosiye yo gutanguza ya .exe, .bat, na .cmd. Gushira mu ngiro inyandiko yo gutanguza gusa igihe umukoresha ashobora gushiraho no gukoresha inyandiko yo gutanguza isubirwamwo hanze ya Synix. Ubutumwa buvuga ko umukino uriko uritegurwa bwerekanwa inyuma y'aho urukino ruba rumaze kuroranirwa. Ivyo bibanza vyerekana inyifato ya Synix yashizwemwo, kandi ntishobora gukora inyandiko canke ivyongeweko.
GUSUBIRA MU MUSI Andika inzira z'umutekano zijanye n'ububiko bwa seriveri yashizweko. Koresha * ku gice kimwe c'inzira canke izina ry'idosiye na ** ku madosiye yashizwe hamwe. {Identity}, {ServerName}, {WorldName}, {Port}, na {QueryPort}. Akarorero: logs\latest.log, Saved\Logs\*.log, profiles\{Identity}\logs\**\*.log. Synix irondera izo nzira gusa iyo umukoresha asavye kwugurura icegeranyo gishasha c'urukino.

data.name: Text.ED08E4C207A6FC2493D7
data.value: ◇ Imirima iteye akaga ikurikiza uburyo bw'ibanga Synix.

data.name: Text.4234688FB477D9CF1421
data.value: ◇ Ibikoresho vy'ugukoresha ivyitwa "template-aware controls": mu rukino uhisemwo, ibintu bitakoreshwa bica bihagarikwa.

data.name: Text.1B0142C80D27A3442046
data.value: ⚠ Guhindura iki kibanza ntibihanagura ama backups yo muri folder ya mbere.

data.name: Text.A9B62C4456D11AE0550C
data.value: 🔒 [REQUIRED] Andika izina rya seriveri uce uhitamwo igicapo c'urukino.

data.name: Text.1A759326BD5A56996BF1
data.value: 1 amakuru yanyu aguma atandukanijwe Servers, settings, backups, runtimes, na SteamCMD zibikwa munsi ya C:\Synix rero impinduka z'ibikoresho ntizisubirira.

data.name: Text.CD33F03B524794FFF78C
data.value: 2 ADD A SERVER Nuhitemwo urukino, ushireho ivy'urudandazwa, maze ureke Synix irwandikeko. Steam kwinjira birasabwa gusa iyo urwo rukino rubisavye.

data.name: Text.61A00FCEB996AF15FF21
data.value: 3 Gutangura, guhagarika no gusuzuma Synix yerekana impari z'ugutanguza neza, ikagenzura ugutanguza, ikoresha inyifato yo guhagarika mu mutekano aho ishigikiwe, kandi igumana inyandiko ziheruka kuboneka.

data.name: Text.CA9A7AA7C8AF17BABA8C
data.value: 4 ACCESS NETWORK Windows Uruhusha rw'uruzitiro rw'umuriro n'uguhererekanya urubuga rwa router biratandukanye. Synix iraba ko hari ukutumvikana mu karere, ariko ntiyigera ihindura router yawe.

data.name: Text.C638A97009ED3C9CCB29
data.value: 5 GUSUBIRA IBIKORWA NO KUBISUBIRA Koresha Imigambi > Amashusho y'ibiterasoni kugira usuzume neza ko ibintu bimeze neza wongere ukore ibikorwa vyo gusanura. Koresha Backup imbere yo kwimura Synix canke guhindura ibintu bikomeye.

data.name: Text.2B2D3EED7C841FFB78AA
data.value: Ubugenzuzi bw'ukwinjira, inyifato yo gutangura, n'ugushira hamwe

data.name: Text.74ECEE4668229DC04361
data.value: Izina ry'ikonte, atari izina ryawe ryo kwerekana Steam

data.name: Text.C404A6A32FD8F56893D3
data.value: Nushiremwo n'utundi dukoresho twose dukenewe mu rukino. Hindura ahantu hashirwako kugirango inzira yose ibe ifitaniye isano n'ububiko bwa seriveri bwashiriweho.

data.name: Text.8F2ED817BE8BBE23D64C
data.value: Ibimenyamenya vyigenga biva mu bikorwa vya Synix; impari zisaba isuzuma rya seriveri nyayo.

data.name: Text.A8BC53DE427A5E93DAED
data.value: Ikora mu buryo bw'imashini igicapo c'urukino/server gitekanye munsi y'inzira y'imikino yashizweho.

data.name: Text.FC52030FEF2C9AEC802D
data.value: Gutoranya mu buryo bwikora ama configurations y'umukino yakorewe

data.name: Text.1232008495CAD0B69745
data.value: Imirwi iratangura n'ubuyobozi butomoye bwa Microsoft bwo gukuramo igihe igihe c'ugukora kitariho.

data.name: Text.AAFE71EF1584DE2CA4E2
data.value: Ihagarika gushiraho n'ubutumwa butomoye iyo processor idashigikiye AVX2.

data.name: Text.ED928782624AFCE2078E
data.value: Gukuraho ikoreshwa ry'ivyo bikoresho ata nkomanzi...

data.name: Text.95E3AA6BFFB7545B20EF
data.value: Genzura igihe c'imikorere, amadosiye ya seriveri, ama configurations, ports, Windows Firewall, umwanya kuri disiki, ibikorwa vyahagaritswe, inyandiko ziheruka, na Synix update health mu kibanza kimwe.

data.name: Text.37923AD83E636BE4C27F
data.value: Genzura SteamCMD kugira ngo umenye amakuru agezweho imbere y'uko utanguza serveri.

data.name: Text.6B1DD744008E1B4658A6
data.value: Genzura SteamCMD, igihe co gukora, amadosiye ya seriveri, ama ports, Windows Firewall, disk space, interrupted processes, recent logs, na update health.

data.name: Text.1DF3BE2046D08A780F73
data.value: Iraraba ko ivyasohowe vy'ukuri vyasohotse ata gusubira kwubaka Synix, gutangura gusohora, canke gushika kuri C:\Synix.

data.name: Text.52A32013E2D94B00DBF7
data.value: Iragenzura ishirwa rya Windows .NET Framework imbere y'uko seriveri itangura.

data.name: Text.445F89C824FEC1E5E372
data.value: Iraba ko gushigikira ubuhinga bwa none (virtualisation) vyemewe kandi biboneka kuri Windows.

data.name: Text.B28F2358A90FE65BFCC8
data.value: Guhitamwo umurongo wo kwugurura igenzura rya seriveri

data.name: Text.58ECD5D931201294DE1E
data.value: Hitamwo ubwoko bw'umukozi kugira werekane kahise kiwe ko kugenzura.

data.name: Text.C9F72F8A6A3B6CC20F72
data.value: Hitamwo gusa uburyo bwo gutanguza bwinjiye bwemejwe kuri iyi seriveri yihariye.

data.name: Text.22FCE0291808752AD7BC
data.value: Nuhitemwo inyanduruko y'ivyandikano ikwiye gusubirira ivyandikano vy'ubu biri kuri serveri.

data.name: Text.30F3BBCB43AC48EBFD1C
data.value: Hitamwo ururimi rukoreshwa na Synix. Imirongo y'urukino be n'ibiharuro vy'imiterere biguma biri mu congereza.

data.name: Text.54FE09AF7E87A247A21A
data.value: Guhitamwo igihe Synix ikwiye gutangura gusubiramwo seriveri.

data.name: Text.7FF6D10F94CC3274F62A
data.value: Isuku ry'amategeko y'uruzitiro rwa seriveri ya Synix

data.name: Text.FC61CB13704E7289E632
data.value: Guteranya uburyo bwo gukina bwakozwe ubu

data.name: Text.B09F5332EE858BE57F71
data.value: Amabwirizwa aguma kuri iyo orodinateri kiretse mu gihe utegekanije n'ibigirankana Java RCON kugira ngo ushobore kuyikoresha uri kure.

data.name: Text.82A8EB3A96D059596D55
data.value: Kurangiza gushiraho dosiye isabwa imbere y'uko seriveri yihebeye ishobora gutangura.

data.name: Text.F0CDBB393CA93D39DF05
data.value: Inzira y'ugutunganya ifitaniye isano n'ububiko bwa seriveri bwashizweho

data.name: Text.773BE7BF4AC974A6FE2E
data.value: Raporo y'ukuntu ibintu vyagiye birerekanwa yarakopiwe muri ka gatabu.

data.name: Text.1315F512F1E9EDAD63BC
data.value: Kwemeza ikurwa ry'amategeko ya firewall yanditswe

data.name: Text.C2BD3BDCD4926716C67B
data.value: Nubandanye gusa umaze gusuzuma intambwe zisabwa zo gutunganya ibintu.

data.name: Text.07754DEE7F94A6CA31B1
data.value: Gukoporora Steam runtime files after installing

data.name: Text.DA14A0D982E06E70BB06
data.value: Gukoporora Steam runtime files yemewe nyuma yo kwinjiza

data.name: Text.A388F0CE16C067DFA8C5
data.value: Irimwo Microsoft runtime ikoreshwa na serveri 2015, 2017, 2019, na 2022.

data.name: Text.2196E21E8E2F8ABE522B
data.value: Gutegura icegeranyo c'ibikoresho bikingiwe imbere y'uko igikorwa cose gitangura.

data.name: Text.5D45286D0F2A822299E8
data.value: Niwishingire insobanuro y'urukino rwabugenewe, udakoresheje ama plugins canke ivyandikano. Ibisobanuro birazigamirwa mu mugambi kandi bigatangwa gusa inyuma yuko Synix isubiwemwo.

data.name: Text.1B96BBB49F73081D9DD4
data.value: Uko ibintu vyifashe ubu bitangazwa na moteri Synix

data.name: Text.1F9D51EC4BA893F84146
data.value: Ibiharuro vy'ugutanguza vy'ibisanzwe (ikintu cose inyuma y'igikorwa)

data.name: Text.692AE6A41D7574B63232
data.value: Raporo y'igeragezwa ry'insobanuro yanditswe ku rupapuro.

data.name: Text.9F67BB0F58790841820E
data.value: Vyanse ko igikorwa gitegekanijwe gikora gusa mu gihe Synix yuguruye.

data.name: Text.84A9F83EFC6F8A9F3401
data.value: Discord yugurutse. Nuhitemwo Icegeranyo gishasha mw'ishirahamwe ry'abamenyesha amakosa hanyuma ushireko icegeranyo cakopiwe.

data.name: Text.0BB9D8B879FB1885FD71
data.value: Ntimushireho ijambo ry'ibanga, webhooks, IP addresses, configure privé, canke commands zo gutangura. Synix ikuraho amabanga asanzwe imbere yo kurungika.

data.name: Text.E32BFB60FF5B5AA7759C
data.value: Ububiko bw'inkomoko y'inyandiko ku bijanye n'ukwinjiza mu buryo bwikora (ntibisabwa)

data.name: Text.89BF7052C30A2A455D98
data.value: Buri tegeko ryerekeza kuri dosiye ikurikizwa munsi ya C:\Synix\Games\[Umukino]\[Server], ariko iyo dosiye y'umukozi yazimye kandi nta mukozi wa Synix yashizweko afise inzira.

data.name: Text.46D0E2FA44635045064B
data.value: Hindura serverconfig.xml mu mutekano utarinze guhindura inyubako yayo ya XML.

data.name: Text.947BC568AF81FE33EC61
data.value: Gushira mu ngiro gusa igihe gushiraho SteamCMD bitazwi bitagenze neza kandi hakenewe konti ya Steam.

data.name: Text.2F7C7C280CF67E40627A
data.value: Gushiraho gusa igihe seriveri idashobora gukora neza itarinze kuzamura Windows.

data.name: Text.615A691F61191EE9C393
data.value: Nushireho RCON gusa ku bigereranyo vy'udukino dushigikira amategeko ya kure.

data.name: Text.64D3499BE4B6DBDA7DC0
data.value: Gushiraho uburyo bwo kugenzura inyishu za seriveri

data.name: Text.59AD73A66B0E19C3759F
data.value: Gushira mu ngiro igihe seriveri ifise ikibazo cemejwe canke isuzuma ry'umurongo Synix ishobora kugenzura.

data.name: Text.518F7A1D974E46AED149
data.value: Andika indangamuntu mu buryo zikwiye kwinjizwa. Koresha ibicapo, ibibanza canke ID imwe ku murongo. Synix ntikeneye ikigega c'amazina y'aba-mod.

data.name: Text.E486E8326F69B31FB7D5
data.value: Niwinjize amakuru y'urukino, uce wemeza imbere yo kuzigama.

data.name: Text.E83F8984B15353372DF8
data.value: Akarorero: Seriveri irafunga amasegonda makeyi inyuma yo gutangura

data.name: Text.6F9406E668F812A49DBB
data.value: Gushirwa hanze ni ku bikoresho vyo gutanguza canke imashini nyabwonko kandi birabuza gukurikirana ibibazo.

data.name: Text.0078A1C33BF28B41D89B
data.value: Irarondera amabwirizwa y'ishobora gushirwa mu ngiro yari munsi ya C:\Synix\Games\[Game]\[Server], ariko iyo serveri idasanzwe ntikizigamwe kandi n'ububiko bwayo bw'iyo serveri bwarazimanganye. Ama ports n'amafolda yo kwinjizamwo y'umwidondoro ntiyasuzumwe.

data.name: Text.07E7C9C515328484C872
data.value: Amategeko ashirwa muri firewall yiteguye gukurwaho

data.name: Text.6D27A85CB8D78F9F3B3E
data.value: Ubutumwa bwo gutangura bwa mbere bwerekanywe ku mukoresha

data.name: Text.3BE6A898F14F4D050AF5
data.value: Uburyo bwo gukina (igiciro kimwe kuri buri murongo)

data.name: Text.88ED3B522C4F0A8BD740
data.value: GitHub ntiyahujwe. Uburyo bwo gusubiramwo n'ubwa Discord buracariho.

data.name: Text.9942D957346A0E83C15C
data.value: GitHub yandika ivyo yanditse ata gufungura urubuga inyuma y'aho ifatiye kuri urwo rubuga.

data.name: Text.4E4DEFAC10984CADF571
data.value: Hisha aderese IP, ijambo ry'ibanga, n'ayandi makuru y'ibanga mu gihe uriko urahanahana isura.

data.name: Text.A8578B710044B649B2CD
data.value: Ukuntu umukoresha aronka akongera agashira amayagwa y'urukino akenewe

data.name: Text.4E469076738CB74F0877
data.value: Nemeje izina rya seriveri yerekanwa, amarembo, umupaka w'abakinyi, n'ibindi vyose bikoreshwa n'iyi nteguro, harimwo n'amajambo y'ibanga, RCON, uburyo, n'ikarata/isi aho bibereye.

data.name: Text.5D385B4C5044DA97B77C
data.value: IMPORT Nta paki yatoranijwe Nuhitemwo igikoresho co guharura umwanya n'ikibanza.

data.name: Text.44D7882A1ADBECC9092C
data.value: Nushire urwo rukino muri Synix imbere y'uko ugerageza uburyo nyabwo bwo kurugurura.

data.name: Text.70CAC3F03884A4946236
data.value: Gushiraho, gutangura, guhagarika, no kugenzura vyandikwa mu buryo bwikora. Kugenzura impari zikoresha seriveri y'ukuri n'igeragezwa ry'itegeko; uburyo bwo gutunganya ibintu buguma ari uburyo bwo gusuzuma amadosiye ku minwe.

data.name: Text.90C149B626C5531C627C
data.value: Ikiringo co kwinjiza kirahagaritswe. Nta madosiye yahinduwe.

data.name: Text.D3F2BA487FAA0A74E4A4
data.value: Ifasha umukoresha gukora dosiye yo gutanguza isubirwamwo. Kuzimya amabwirizwa yo gukwirakwiza ategerezwa kuguma muri Synix.

data.name: Text.2FD27154D5938042C2FF
data.value: Kugabanya igitigiri c'ama backups agumizwa kuri serveri.

data.name: Text.E749931070B84A1593D2
data.value: Gukora mu buryo buriko burakorwa kuri serveri yose y'urukino.

data.name: Text.908BFBA75F9F88B71363
data.value: Ibikoresho bikoreshwa mu gihe c'imibonano n'ibikoresho vyo gutunganya

data.name: Text.9E611113ECA35A604A41
data.value: Kurungika urutonde rw'abari ku rutonde rw'abakinyi...

data.name: Text.F31BBCEE0082BEEE372A
data.value: Ikarata be n'uburyo bwo guhitamwo biva mu buryo butaziguye mu gisata c'urukino catowe.

data.name: Text.FDA8F741D724B426C343
data.value: Amakarata canke ibintu bishobora gushika (ingero imwe kuri buri murongo)

data.name: Text.A5C1D46A9B2A472DF537
data.value: Ubutumwa bwerekanwa inyuma y'ugusuzumwa kw'ukwitegura bidasanzwe (si ngombwa)

data.name: Text.71F9139AF2A58247E590
data.value: Uburyo bw'ibisabwa RAM muri GB (0 bisobanura ko ata bisabwa)

data.name: Text.0F38AC5E2C273A4B6642
data.value: Nurabe ibibuga vy'abakozi bikora ku bijanye n'imipfunda y'udutabu turiko turaza kandi umenyeshe ibijanye n'uruja n'uruza rutari rwo.

data.name: Text.1C310A469AD1721A3E91
data.value: Nusuzume kandi ugenzure ivyuma vyose vy'ukwinonora imitsi bivuye mu kibanza kimwe.

data.name: Text.A6D637EAA965641CEB00
data.value: Niwihe izina ry'ico kibanza, ushireko uruzitiro rwaco rwa Discord, uce uhitamwo neza ivyabaye vya Synix ironka.

data.name: Text.39AA18B083CD39C1A64C
data.value: Nta kigeragezo co kwizigirwa cakozwe gushika ubu.

data.name: Text.8DDA097844BB6EDCFA10
data.value: Ntibihindutse: dosiye z'umukino, seriveri zibitswe, amategeko yo kwinjiza gusa, amadosiye yo kwinjiza yihariye, n'amategeko ya firewall hanze ya C:\Synix\Games.

data.name: Text.2BBA1B9B15644044B222
data.value: Gukoresha ubuhinga bwa internet mu kwemeza ko umuntu ari mu kuri

data.name: Text.4DC50DE227F1D75CFF26
data.value: Harerekanwa gusa indangamuntu ya webhook ifise agapfukamunwa. Fungura Imigambi y'umukozi kugira urabe canke uhindure aho ugiye.

data.name: Text.A8796566765C1117B49C
data.value: Agaciro uhinduye ni ko gusa gasubirizwa; Ivyiyumviro, ibice, ibiharuro, indongorazina, itandukaniro hagati y'amajambo be n'urutonde rw'amajambo nyamukuru ntibihinduka.

data.name: Text.8736DCB51A77046719F5
data.value: Fungura console y'imvukira igihe seriveri y'urukino itanguye. Kuzimya iki kugira ngo seriveri zikore mu gacerere.

data.name: Text.C8CF5C841F7BF2F1E0F3
data.value: Fungura igikoresho co gutorera umuti ingorane Synix

data.name: Text.656F6C1DD0569874658F
data.value: Amadosiye yo kwinjiza (inzira zisanzwe, imwe kuri buri murongo)

data.name: Text.CB904327966ABA4B8621
data.value: RCON syntaxe optionnelle: intambamyi zo gutangura zitegerezwa kuba zirimwo {rcon}

data.name: Text.36B18A6020F2CE06DF28
data.value: Ihindura uburyo bwa Synix bwo guhisha-console ku bakiriya bayoborwa biciye mw'idirisha ryabo bwite.

data.name: Text.F2492B6E06AE47BEB928
data.value: Ukuboneka kw'idandarizo kugenzurwa mu buryo bwikora ugereranije n'ibikorwa biriko birakorwa hamwe n'izindi seriveri za Synix.

data.name: Text.F13396A9BD6FFF26191D
data.value: Uburyo bw'ibanga buratwikira ubwo bubasha bwo kwinjira. Niwandike kode y'umwimerere, canke uyihebe ku ncuro ya mbere kugira ngo ureke Windrose ikore imwe.

data.name: Text.82F665628E2402225B0F
data.value: Kumenya ko umukino uriko urakoreshwa n'abakinyi bose.

data.name: Text.517D0391800FC8C55AD3
data.value: Yarakingiwe muri Synix kandi ntiyaboneka mu vyandikano vyayo. Amadosiye y'umurwi atunganijwe arimwo ikimenyetso gishobora gukoreshwa mu gisomwa gishobora gusomwa.

data.name: Text.49CDA0DED2FDB6421A49
data.value: Urutonde rw'impapuro rwatoranijwe. Ni mwitegure, muzoze murasuzuma.

data.name: Text.EC423125FB2CAF05C95B
data.value: Amabwirizwa yihuta: Hitamwo kimwe ukitegure, uce usuzuma hanyuma ukirungike

data.name: Text.15599B0016F3C3591CF5
data.value: Ibiciro vyo gusoma gusa birashobora gutoranywa no gusubirwamwo ku bw'ugupima

data.name: Text.69EDD9A74D913D8F77D6
data.value: Kugenzura ko inyanduruko y'inyandiko yo gusoma gusa, isubirwamwo, n'indangagaciro zibitswe muri Server Settings. Ibiciro vy'ijambo ry'ibanga ntibizigera vyerekanwa.

data.name: Text.D4BEB0C27C58D53CCFA7
data.value: Gusoma no kugerageza ububiko bw'ibitabu bwerekana ingene umukino utegurwa...

data.name: Text.54C8BBF4B91A6012A87B
data.value: Gutegura: Windows isaba uburenganzira bw'umuhagarikizi igihe gusa amategeko akeneye gukurwaho.

data.name: Text.2B2FF7B1710C1AE35612
data.value: Twiteguriye gusuzuma amadosiye yasohowe hamwe n'ivyangombwa vy'igerageza vyakozwe mu gihe co gusohora.

data.name: Text.FD866259C3EE73E57510
data.value: Twiteguriye kugerageza ububiko bw'ivyigwa bigize urukino.

data.name: Text.C0BAAF3EA26A1A69CE63
data.value: Twiteguriye. Mu gusuzuma ningoga, harasabwa gukora iminota 30 hamwe n'amasegonda 30.

data.name: Text.0C10BD130731730DDC5C
data.value: Nusubize ibintu mu buryo kugira ngo utware amakuru y'abakinyi uciye kuri serveri yo ng'aho.

data.name: Text.1DE733236BD0DED6BA11
data.value: Iciyumviro co kurekurwa kizoca gisohoka ngaha.

data.name: Text.696DA5B5195A0FB2544E
data.value: Raporo y'ugushira ibintu mu bubiko bw'ibitabu.

data.name: Text.4CB636A73FAD7D71BC94
data.value: Ikigeragezo co kwizigirwa carahagaritswe. Nta nsiguro y'umukozi yahinduwe.

data.name: Text.FE3F7B0A38B0EEDF20EB
data.value: Akenshi aragerageza Synix memory, handles, threads, hamwe na read-only server health checks. Ntizitangura, ntizihagarika, ntizishiraho, ntizivugurura canke ngo zihindure umusereva.

data.name: Text.D320B9FEE80C1B53C8BD
data.value: Bisaba idirishya ry'ubuyobozi bwa seriveri riboneka

data.name: Text.88E68081C6F4A7C6EEE2
data.value: Gusaba idirishya ry'umuyobozi wa seriveri ngo rigume riboneka

data.name: Text.9E09BE4B90E9259491DD
data.value: Ibibanza bisabwa bihindurwa bukwi na bukwi ku rukino rwatoranijwe.

data.name: Text.AD654849FC9CF1C6D997
data.value: Amadosiye asabwa hamwe n'ibishushanyo vyakozwe na Synix bica bitanga imburi.

data.name: Text.B0DAEADE1B96AB9F8EB5
data.value: Birakenewe ku bintu nka Hyper-V bitaboneka kuri Windows Home.

data.name: Text.5BA4DAF696F2453133A8
data.value: Imirongo ikenewe y'ugutangura ijanwa n'amakuru yawe imbere y'ugutangura. Urashobora gushiramwo ibindi bimenyetso vy'umurongo w'amabwirizwa bidashirwamwo n'urutonde rw'ibisanzwe mu gihimba ca Extra Arguments.

data.name: Text.5DC5CE2CCFBCC1F3AE31
data.value: Amadosiye yatanzwe n'abakoresha (inzira zisanzwe, imwe kuri buri murongo)

data.name: Text.2D41AABA41C2EF3FED5C
data.value: Gutangura imisi yatoranijwe ku gihe cashinzwe mu kubungabunga amakuru y'umugenzuzi w'umwanya.

data.name: Text.FE8445D560EC3691D1E1
data.value: Nusuzume ingene Synix yubaka itegeko rikoreshwa mu gutanguza iyi seriveri.

data.name: Text.FC0C7D5D72BB74B7579E
data.value: Nusuzume amategeko agenga uruhusha imbere y'uko wemera ko server itangura gukora.

data.name: Text.A2CBC7E3EEB055BE8AFC
data.value: Nusuzume ibi bintu bisabwa ku bijanye n'ugutunganya ibintu imbere y'uko ubandanya.

data.name: Text.B38F7F9752C285B4B90B
data.value: Turiko turakoresha urutonde rw'impapuro, SHA-256, hamwe n'ibipimo vya antivirus...

data.name: Text.5D719633D44DEE05A861
data.value: Kurondera ufatiye ku rukino, igicapo, canke uko ibintu vyifashe...

data.name: Text.6CAABA13463DFF403A37
data.value: Uburyo bwo kurondera, inzira canke ibiciro...

data.name: Text.4CDDB86B34725DFF943D
data.value: Abashinzwe umutekano barabujije uwo mupfuko kwinjira. Nta madosiye yahinduwe.

data.name: Text.8C5A71A792CF70840F4B
data.value: Raba neza ivyo Synix ishobora gushiraho, gutunganya, kugenzura no kubaza imbere y'uko irema umusereva.

data.name: Text.339761CAC4ADD79725CB
data.value: Raba Discord iyo ari yo ironka buri bwoko bw'ubutumwa bwa Synix kuri iyi seriveri.

data.name: Text.F00F8392B2C39AE7826E
data.value: Hitamwo igicapo co gusubiriza kugira ubandanye.

data.name: Text.FFF9C013BFE465B863CB
data.value: Hitamwo urukino kugira ngo usubiremwo ibimenyamenya vy'uko rwizewe.

data.name: Text.F576F35548B3364CBEDB
data.value: Nuhitemwo serveri yashizweho hanyuma ugenzure itegeko ryayo.

data.name: Text.DA03B7F52F79500329AF
data.value: Kurungika amakuru y'ukuntu ibintu vyifashe, gushigikira, kubungabunga, n'ibibazo ku mihora itandukanye ya Discord.

data.name: Text.B67782439FDBA86190F5
data.value: Inyandiko ikoreshwa na seriveri (inzira ifitaniye isano)

data.name: Text.A50A426E7FA853DA7584
data.value: Ahantu ivyandikano vy'abakozi biherereye (inzira imwe canke igishushanyo kimwe ku murongo)

data.name: Text.52D1EA9EC1761138D30F
data.value: Erekana imburi yo kwugurura ubwa mbere

data.name: Text.D72917FA7B697BD4F0E1
data.value: Bwerekanywe kugira ngo uboneke neza kugira ngo ushobore kwemeza ko igisabwa co gutangura kitagira imvugo zihishijwe.

data.name: Text.20C57F23AC717E8E040D
data.value: Gutangura seriveri biciye kuri Synix. Mu kurindira ko uwuriko aramwumviriza yishura...

data.name: Text.091C22C7EE122D76DAE4
data.value: Itangura kugenzura ibiri inyuma igihe winjiye muri Windows. Gufunga icegeranyo ca Synix vyama bihagarika Synix mu gihe c'ikiganiro.

data.name: Text.106E51E2A0CD985A0FBC
data.value: Ububiko bw'intumbero y'igihe co gutwara Steam (inzira isanzwe)

data.name: Text.AD5BE8100C99D831B948
data.value: SteamCMD umuvuduko wo gupakurura muri megabits kw'isegonda

data.name: Text.6DC2259A4335DB1F7C92
data.value: Guhagarika seriveri yo kugerageza biciye kuri Synix...

data.name: Text.AFC6E98203B42710D6D2
data.value: Gushira impapuro z'ububiko bw'ibikoresho vy'ubuhinga bwa none n'iz'ububiko bw'ibikoresho vy'ubuhinga bwa none mu kadirisha gakoreshwa.

data.name: Text.A03EE332F98F4733802C
data.value: Guhinduranya icuma co mu bwoko bwa Synix hagati y'ibishushanyo vy'umuco n'ivy'umwijima.

data.name: Text.1263E823649071566AFC
data.value: Synix ishiraho iryo tegeko ry'ukuri ikoresheje impagararo zirinzwe z'uwo mushakashatsi, igaca ihisha ijambo ry'ibanga ryose, igatangura nk'uko bisanzwe, hanyuma ikarindira ikimenyamenya c'uko uwo mushakashatsi yemeye ko irungikwa.

data.name: Text.2F4A3B0705E0D01E2F8F
data.value: Synix Configuration Application Check None None None

data.name: Text.030EBC77E93FA53151CE
data.value: Synix ntigurura irembo ryo kugenzura urubuga. Amajambo y'ibanga abikwa na Synix arakingirwa mu karere, kandi ibintu vy'ingenzi birahishwa ku mpapuro zayo zerekana ibikorwa.

data.name: Text.69B1390848A4F53A80A2
data.value: Synix ishiraho icuma co gupakira cacaguwe hamwe na Java igendanwa gihuye. Mwongere imiterere yanyu inyuma yo kuyishiramwo.

data.name: Text.93F24BC2C28FEF1DDC28
data.value: Synix yatunganijwe mu buryo butuma abantu batahura ingene umukino wo kuri serveri ukinwa ata guhisha ivyo uhindura kuri orodinateri yawe.

data.name: Text.DB74849CCDF411527A63
data.value: Synix iremeza ko ama backups akwije ibisabwa, igatondekanya neza ububiko bwatowe, kandi igaca isubira inyuma mu gihe ugusubizaho bitashobotse. Inyandiko ya serveri ya Synix n'imiterere yayo ntibihindurwa.

data.name: Text.F283ABEE58C3C5919882
data.value: Synix iremeza buri gikorwa mu buryo bwikora inyuma y'uko kiranguwe kuri iyo orodinateri.

data.name: Text.EED8C29183FC10F6FEC2
data.value: Impanuro yo gutorera umuti ingorane z'ivyuma n'iz'abasuku

data.name: Text.7083BACCFEE1C7E3CC47
data.value: Tubwire ico wacishije, ico Synix yerekanye, n'ingene twosubira kubikora.

data.name: Text.D25BF1DE94C6CFCB40D4
data.value: Turiko turagerageza ibisobanuro n'ibishushanyo vyose vyashizweko mu buryo butekanye...

data.name: Text.91657E9737A951B3ADA2
data.value: Igerageza umukino wose wubatse, ihagarikwa ry'ugushiraho, igishushanyo c'inyubako yuzuye, isubirwamwo, inzira, ikibanza c'umwimbu, hamwe n'ibikorwa vyemewe inyuma yo kwinjiza. Abaserveri bashirwako ntibigera bahinduka.

data.name: Text.9364F108EA4C3D297620
data.value: Raporo y'ukuntu ibintu vyifashe izoboneka ngaha.

data.name: Text.D1227935539D1BA6B9E6
data.value: Igikorwa ca seriveri y'umukino ntikiriko kirakorwa

data.name: Text.D613F5D4C11D7D3ACD78
data.value: Ivyigwa bijanye n'ingene urukino ruzoba rumeze ntivyashoboye kurangira.

data.name: Text.849FF4D03C300A88F143
data.value: Umuyagankuba wo ng'aho warahagaritswe. Gukuraho Synix ku rupapuro rwa GitHub rwuguruwe.

data.name: Text.199AA28C30C28597C6E2
data.value: Ico cegeranyo c'ibanga carasubirijwe kandi kiriteguriye kwinjizwa mw'ikoraniro ryo guhanahana ivyiyumviro ku ngorane zo muri Discord.

data.name: Text.CFA163A0DFA468756CF4
data.value: Raporo y'ukuntu ibintu vyifashe izoboneka ngaha.

data.name: Text.3CDC839AB03D7080ED58
data.value: Amasanamu y'ivyavuye mu matohoza ntiyashoboye kurangira.

data.name: Text.0117F5327FA39CD0DABB
data.value: Ikiringo co kurekurwa carakuweho. Nta madosiye yo kurekura yahinduwe.

data.name: Text.AB89F96B667CE80E48CB
data.value: Icegeranyo c'ubwizigirwa kizoboneka inyuma y'aho igikorwa gisabwe kirangiriye.

data.name: Text.D9718558CFBB91F44CFF
data.value: Urutonde rw'ibikorwa rurabikwa hamwe n'ibikoresho vy'iyi serveri.

data.name: Text.44D8326D9590F71F8B1B
data.value: Seriveri yatoranijwe irasaba konti ya Steam kugirango ishirweho. Andika izina ry'ikonte SteamCMD akwiye gukoresha.

data.name: Text.D305131EE6798E1D30FA
data.value: Seriveri igomba kuguma ihagaritswe mu gihe c'ugusubizaho

data.name: Text.BCB4E85BFE366942E9D4
data.value: Serveri yahagaze imbere y'uko itangurwa ry'igikorwa ryemezwa. Nusubire urabe amakuru aheruka gushikirizwa be n'insobanuro yayo.

data.name: Text.946FF9E0EB0FA926E2AF
data.value: Serveri y'ibigeragezo yahagaritswe. Ibimenyamenya vy'ivyiyumviro birangiye birazigamwa.

data.name: Text.7B3AC1F3AD7BA73ED0CC
data.value: Ibi biciro bikoreshwa gusa igihe inyandikorugero ya seriveri yatoranijwe ibishigikiye.

data.name: Text.7CB94F75343DF207439A
data.value: Iki gishushanyo c'amakuru cerekana impari zisanzwe Synix ikoresha mu kwubaka itegeko ryo gutangura.

data.name: Text.6440A1A6AB337CD371BA
data.value: Nushireho buri musi igihe co gusubira gutangura igikorwa gitegekanijwe.

data.name: Text.348C3C8FD21539135DB5
data.value: Amakuru mashasha ajanye n'umutekano araboneka ngaha.

data.name: Text.A8142050CBD33EE95F3F
data.value: Koresha umuvuduko ukwiye canke ugabanye uburyo bwo kwinjiza, gusubiramwo, gusanura n'ugusuzuma imbuga z'imikino.

data.name: Text.60ADFA0715E4E83522DF
data.value: Koresha webhook imwe kuri iyi serveri hanyuma uhitemwo ubutumwa ikwiye kwakira.

data.name: Text.4910EE68C0A14BD4AF19
data.value: Gukoresha gusa igihe gupima vyerekana ko seriveri ikeneye dosiye yemewe ya Steam DLL. Uwo mugambi utegerezwa kuguma muri iyo porogarama.

data.name: Text.1433E221238B95E942F7
data.value: Koresha gusa igihe seriveri ishirwa mu bikoresho vya Hyper-V canke Windows.

data.name: Text.F2029FAFB53EFFEE6890
data.value: Ikoresha isaha yo muri ako karere n'isaha 24.

data.name: Text.229193F097F563A43177
data.value: Urukurikirane rw'ugusuzuma rwasubiye gusubirwamwo ruvuye ku bimenyamenya vya Synix.

data.name: Text.A7678DBAFBD9E2842236
data.value: Ibikoresho vyemejwe hamwe n'ibisabwa Windows vyasuzumwe imbere yuko Synix ishiraho canke itanguza seriveri.

data.name: Text.16FB4FBCA9A11AC839AE
data.value: Kugenzura inzira z'ububiko n'ubunyangamugayo bwa SHA-256...

data.name: Text.95B4A7B23387C67FD233
data.value: Gutegereza igikorwa ca seriveri kiriko kirakorwa

data.name: Text.29CAE0D1FFE7D67CA266
data.value: Gutegereza icitegererezo ca mbere • Kwugurura buri masegonda 1

data.name: Text.9B1DF515009197F7B731
data.value: Ico Synix ubu izi co gushiraho, gutunganya, gutanguza, kugenzura no kurondera uru rukino.

data.name: Text.DDE7244B8E964BD733E4
data.value: Ico Synix yariko arakora igihe ikibazo cabaye

data.name: Text.C29162E9E78CEEA6A66B
data.value: Mu gihe vyemewe, gusiba seriveri bisaba uburenganzira bw'umuhagarikizi bwo gukuraho amategeko yayo ya Windows. Cisha ako gahimba kugira ngo wirengagize isuku ryikora mu gihe uriko urahanagura.

data.name: Text.84915063F51DB634577C
data.value: IGITUMA SYNIX yashize ahabona aya mategeko

data.name: Text.9D352A1132C068237394
data.value: Windows isaba uruhusha rw'umuhagarikizi. Synix ikuraho gusa amategeko ya firewall ahuye neza n'inzira zikurikizwa ziri hejuru hanyuma isubire isuzume kugira yemeze isuku.

data.name: DynamicText.2ECD4E03F90BD36A3ACB
data.value: • Ibikorwa vy'ukuri be n'utuntu tw'ingene bitunganijwe

data.name: DynamicText.C0DC4B8E2D0B8558D8E2
data.value: • Iyi ntambwe yandikwa n'igikorwa nyaco ca seriveri.

data.name: DynamicText.F36B8F89A6A8DD2ACEF1
data.value: Nimusubire mwumvirize ibivugwa muri iyo ngingo.

Synix izobanza ikingire amadosiye y'iki gihe kugira ngo n'uku kugarura gushobore gusubirwamwo.

data.value: Banza uhagarike iyi serveri. Mu gihe c'ukugerageza, hategerezwa kwihwezwa igikorwa gishasha c'ugutanguza kigizwe n'ivyiyumviro vyerekanywe.

data.value: Synix ntiyashoboye kubona dosiye y'umugambi. Kurungika iki gisata c'ugusuzuma kuva muri Visual Studio Build canke Rebuild y'umushinga Synix.

data.value: Synix izosubira kwubaka urutonde rwuzuye ruvuye ku gishushanyo cayo kizwi, yongere ikoreshe ibiharuro vya seriveri yazigamwe, yongere ibungabunge ububiko bw'inyongera. Kubandanya?

data.name: MessageText.3679B9A889A4F6F470DA
data.value: Inyongera yarashizweho kandi iremezwa. Mwiteguriye, nimutanguze iyo porogaramu.

data.name: MessageText.F23CB309225C503B6D8A
data.value: Inyongera yarashizweho kandi iremezwa. Muri rusangi, iyo porogarama irashobora kuyisubiriza itagikeneye gusubira gutangura neza.

data.name: MessageText.21619FB57FA1E3D42E43
data.value: Iryo bwirizwa ritegerezwa kurenza ivyemezwa vyose imbere y'uko Synix ishobora gutangura isuzuma ry'impari.

data.name: MessageText.EA2CD9B6AE3E2608F49E
data.value: Ubuhinga bw'ugutondora umukino bushobora gukoreshwa gusa mu bikorwa vy'iterambere.

data.name: MessageText.2A2FCD5BFFF42E6401AE
data.value: Urutonde rw'amazina y'abagize uwo mugwi rurateguwe. Urwo rukino ruzoca rukurura canke rugasubiramwo ibiri muri urwo rukino igihe serveri itanguye.

data.value: Igisata c'uguhererekanya cahitanywe nticari kuboneka. Nusubire uyitorere.

data.value: Iyi backup ifise urupapuro rutumvikana SHA-256 kandi ntishobora kugarurwa. Nuhitemwo ubundi buryo bwo gushigikira.

data.name: MessageText.379C1CF1A5975C5E0C37
data.value: Iyi dosiye si iy'ubusa. Kwishira ngaha vyoshobora gusubiramwo amadosiye. Kubandanya?

data.name: MessageText.F94014E8EAE83ED1AC43
data.value: Urwo rukino ruhagarikwa mu buryo bwose biciye ku ntambamyi z'ugutanguza, ni co gituma hakenerwa ikigeragezo c'inyanduruko y'ibikoresho.

data.name: MessageText.AC3B07BB575D129E2A12
data.value:
Ivyo bizosubira kwubaka ingene urukino rwatunganijwe hakurikijwe inyanduruko ya Synix kandi bikoreshe ibiharuro vyashizwe muri Server Settings.
Iyindi migambi yose y'ugutunganya ibintu izokurwaho.

data.value: Urindire ko installation, update, backup, canke transfer irangira imbere yo kwemeza ipaki.

data.value: Windows ntiyashoboye gusubiramwo raporo yo kwemeza.

data.value: Urafise impinduka z'ibikoresho zitazigamwe. Twoba dukwiye kuvyirengagiza maze tugaca dufunga?

data.value: Utegerezwa guhagarika seriveri imbere yo kuyisanura.
