data.name: ModManager.Error.LinkedPath
data.value: Iki gikorwa c'inyongera gikoresha dosiye canke idosiye ifitaniye isano. Hitamwo ububiko busanzwe; Synix ntizokurikiza uwo murongo.

data.name: ModManager.Error.PreviousFileMissing
data.value: Hari dosiye y'inyongera ikenewe kugira ngo isubirwemwo irabuze. Nta madosiye yahinduwe. Gusubizaho dosiye ya recovery yabuze canke ukoreshe backup ya serveri yemejwe imbere yo gukura iki kigega.

data.name: ModManager.Error.RecoveryRetained
data.value: Igikorwa co kwongerako nticashoboye kandi impinduka zimwe zimwe ntizishobora gusubirwamwo. Amadosiye yo gusubiza ibintu mu buryo yagumijwe kuri {0}. Gumiza seriveri ihagaritse hanyuma usubize ayo madosiye canke igicapo ca seriveri cemejwe imbere y'uko ugitangura.

data.name: LaunchCommand.Error.UnsafeBatchValue
data.value: Ikibanza co gutangurirako {0} ntigishobora kurengana ata nkomanzi iki gikoresho co gutangurirako Windows. Imvugo z'amajambo y'ivyiyumviro zibiri zashizwemwo, imvugo zo guhagarika imirongo, canke imvugo z'ibishobora guhinduka ntizishigikiwe ngaha. Agaciro kayo ntikarahindutse.

data.name: LaunchCommand.Error.UnsafeBatchArguments
data.value: Iryo bwirizwa rya batch ryuzuye ririmwo inyandiko y'ibwirizwa idatekanye canke ukwaguka kw'ibishobora guhinduka. Gusuzuma ibiciro vyo gutangura hamwe n'ivyiyumviro vy'inyongera; nta na kimwe catangujwe.

data.name: ServerStart.Arguments.CustomHidden
data.value: [Imburano z'imico n'akaranga zitangwa; [Ibikubiye mu gitabu ntibikurikizwe]

data.name: Configuration.Editor.Error.YamlUnsupported
data.value: YAML umurongo {0} ntiyujuje ibisabwa canke ukoresha akarusho iyi mpinyanyamakuru idashobora guhindura mu mutekano. Bishigikiwe: urupapuro rumwe rufise ibiharuro/urutonde rw'ibintu vyashizwe hamwe n'ibiciro vy'umurongo umwe. Ibikoranirizo vy'imigenderanire, ibiciro vy'imirongo myinshi, amatagisi, ibishingantahe, n'amazina y'uruharo ntibishigikiwe. Nta kintu na kimwe carokotse.

data.name: GameInput.WorldSeed.RequiredNumber
data.value: Urutonde rw'abakinyi bakomeye kw'isi rurakenewe kuri {0}: ukoreshe inomero yose kuva kuri {1} gushika kuri {2}. Gukosora mu Gushiraho Serveri > Kwubaka Isi.

data.name: ServerSetup.World.Seed.RangeHint
data.value: Imibare yose kuva {0} gushika {1}. Ku bijanye n'isi ibaho, nugumize imbuto yayo ya mbere.

data.name: ServerSetup.World.Seed.Hint
data.value: Nuvyarire imbuto z'isi nshasha, canke winjirire mu rwawe. Ku bijanye n'isi ibaho, nugumize imbuto yayo ya mbere.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.Profile
data.value: Ubwo buryo bwo gutondekanya impapuro burashigikirwa gusa ku mpapuro z'impapuro za Empyrion.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.FolderName
data.value: Koresha izina ry'ububiko bw'indome 1–80, hatagira imbonerakure, amazina ya Windows yabujijwe, canke ibibanza vy'imbere/inyuma. Izina ry'igiteramo ntirishobora kuba inomero y'ikigo gusa.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.Layout
data.value: Nuhitemwo icegeranyo c'ingene ibintu vyagenze cose canke igicapo c'ivyakozwe ku gisata, aho guhitamwo igicapo c'ukwinjizwa kw'urukino, igicapo co mu buhinga bwa none (Workshop collection), igicapo c'ukuntu ibintu vyagenda (blueprint), canke icegeranyo c'ibiri mu gisata.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ScenarioLayout
data.value: Ikintu cose gitegerezwa kuba gifise gameoptions.yaml hamwe n'ibikoresho vyaco vyitwa "Content", "Playfields", "Sectors" canke "Prefabs" biri kumwe, haba ku nkomoko ya ZIP canke mu kadirisha kamwe k'ikintu.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ScenarioCode
data.value: Uru rutonde rw'ibikogwa rurimwo DLL, C#, canke JAR code. Kwinjiza kode ya seriveri ukwayo biciye mu buryo bwa seriveri ya Empyrion nyuma yo gusuzuma amabwiriza y'umwanditsi.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ModLayout
data.value: Guhitamwo icombo c'imiterere yuzuye: DLL hamwe n'ibikoresho vyayo bitegerezwa kuba biri ku nkomoko y'igicapo canke mu madosiye y'imiterere. Amadosiye y'inyongera y'impapuro n'amasanamu yuzuye ya seriveri ntiyemerwa.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.MissingScenario
data.value: Ico kintu nticari bwashike. Ubwa mbere ni ugutwara ico gisomwa cose, hanyuma ukagitoranya ku rutonde rw'ibisomwa vyashizweko.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ConfigurationChanged
data.value: Ingene ibintu vyagenze canke uburyo bwo kuzigama vyarahindutse mugihe iri dirisha ryari ryuguruye. Nuwuhagarike maze uce usubira guhitamwo ico wokora.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ExistingSave
data.value: Iyo ntunganyo yo kurokora irahari. Ikintu gitandukanye n'ico gikenewe ni izina rishasha, ritakoreshwa. Synix ntiyasubiriye canke ngo ihindure isi yariho.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.Configuration
data.value: dedicated.yaml irabuze, ni nini cane, canke ntirimwo urutonde rumwe rwa GameConfig.CustomScenario na GameConfig.GameName. Banza utegure umusereva.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.SaveFailed
data.value: Synix ntiyashoboye kuzigama inyandiko ya seriveri. Uburyo bwari busanzwe bukoreshwa bwarasubiwemwo; igitabu c'inyongera kiragumijwe.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ProtectedScenario
data.value: Synix ntizokuraho ibintu vyatoranijwe canke ibintu vy'ibintu vyatoranijwe mu gihe isi yarokotse iba iriho. Izo si zishobora kuba zikiriho bivanye n'ayo madosiye. Nta madosiye y'ibintu vyabaye yakuweho.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.ImportedScenario
data.value: Amadosiye y'ivyanditswe yarinjijwe. Isi y'ubu hamwe n'ukuntu ibintu vyari vyifashe ntibihindutse. Koresha Choose Scenario kugira uhitemwo uburyo n'izina ryo kuzigama. Gumana izina ry'ububiko bw'ivyabaye igihe winjiza impinduka.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Picker.ModTitle
data.value: Kwinjiza impinduka za seriveri ya Empyrion

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Picker.ScenarioHelp
data.value: Wiyandikishe muri Steam hanyuma ureke ugukuraho birangire, uce uhitamwo agapapuro k'ibintu vyabaye munsi ya steamapps\workshop\content\383120, canke uhitemwo ZIP y'ibintu vyose vyabaye. Ivyo bitwara ikopi yo ng'aho; Steam ntizohindura ico gisomwa c'umukozi mu buryo bwikora.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Picker.ModHelp
data.value: Nuhitemwo ZIP canke ububiko bwuzuye bw'igisata cakozwe n'umwanditsi wizigira. Gumana DLLs, _Info.yaml (igihe zitangwa), dependencies na assets hamwe. Synix ntiyikuraho ivyisunga canke ngo ikore kode ya mod ubwayo.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Picker.FolderName
data.value: Izina ry'ububiko bwa Scenario kuri seriveri (koresha iri zina kugira ngo uhindure)

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Selection.Confirm
EmpyrionMods.Selection.Saved
data.value: Ikiganiro n'ihitamwo ryo kuzigama vyarazigamwe. Uhejeje gutangura, nuce usuzuma urutonde rw'abakinyi b'uwo mukino maze uhuze n'uwundi muntu. Amadosiye y'ivy'isi yari ahari yarazigamwe.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Selection.Help
EmpyrionMods.Selection.SaveName
data.value: Kubika izina (GameConfig.GameName ?? si izina rya seriveri ryo kwerekana)

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Selection.NewSaveNotice
data.value: Ikintu gitandukanye n'ico kiriko kiraba kirakeneye ubundi buryo bwo kurokora. Synix itanga iciyumviro c'izina rishasha kandi ntiyigera ikuraho canke ngo yandikire hejuru y'isi ihari.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Support.Scenarios
data.value: Kwinjiza agapapuro canke ZIP yakuwe. Koresha hitamwo Scenario inyuma yaho; ibigega biriho birakingirwa.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Support.Mods
data.value: Kwinjiza amakarata y'ivyandikano yuzuye canke ZIP. Nusuzume ivyo umwanditsi ashinzwe; kode ikoreshwa muri Empyrion.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Remove.Confirm
data.value: Gusubiza inyuma ivyo wozanye birimwo {0}? Amadosiye yose yashizweko n'iyo porogarama nyene azoca akurwaho canke asubirwemwo nk'uko yari asanzwe ameze, harimwo n'ayandi madosiye ari muri iyo porogarama. Amadosiye yahinduwe hanze ya Synix azohagarika gusubira inyuma. Ni mugire urutonde rwuzuye rw'amasandugu imbere yo kubandanya.

data.name: ModPackages.Error.FolderUnsupported
data.value: Iki gisata c'inyongera ntigifasha kwinjiza amadosiye. Nuhitemwo imwe mu madosiye y'ipakete ishigikiwe.

data.name: ModPackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Hitamwo agapapuro ka mod canke ka scenario karimwo impapuro z'ibikoresho bikenewe, aho guhitamwo urukurikirane rw'ibikoresho vyashizwe mu rukino canke urukurikirane rw'ibintu bitandukanijwe.

data.name: ModPackages.Error.Size
data.value: Urwo rupapuro rurengeye ibipimo vy'ukwinjiza muri iyo porogarama y'inyongera, canke ibiri muri rwo bihindutse igihe bariko barakurakuranwa. Nta kintu na kimwe cari gihari.

data.name: ModPackages.Picker.Help
data.value: Nuhitemwo ZIP canke ububiko bwuzuye bw'umukino n'urwego wahisemwo. Nugumize hamwe urutonde rw'ibintu ukeneye, ivyo ukeneye be n'ibintu vyawe. Nusuzume aho ugiye n'ivyavuye mu gusuzuma imbere yo kwinjiza.

data.name: ModPackages.Picker.SelectFolder
data.value: Guhitamwo agapapuro kose k'imiterere canke k'imiterere, aho guhitamwo igicapo c'umukino

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Import.ExistingScenario
data.value: Aka gapapuro k'inkuru karamaze kubaho. Ivyandikano bihuye bizosubirizwa, ivyo bishobora kugira ingaruka ku mibumbe ikoresha ico ciyumviro. Gumana inyanduruko ya serveri yuzuye kandi ukoreshe izina ry'ububiko butandukanye mu bihe bitandukanye. Amadosiye y'isi yarokotse ubwayo ntazohindurwa.

data.name: ModManager.Error.NewerInstallation
data.value: Ubu umuntu aherutse kwinjiza afise amadosiye ari muri ako gasandugu. Nubanze usubire inyuma ku vyaheruka kwinjizwa.

data.name: ModManager.Error.PreviousFileChanged
data.value: Idosiye yo mu ntango yarokowe yarahindutse. Gusubira inyuma kwahagaritswe imbere yo guhindura dosiye ya seriveri. Nibiba ngombwa, nuze usubire kw'isandugu y'ububiko yuzuye.

data.name: ModManager.Inventory.Search
data.value: Kurondera ivyongeweko muri aka karere ko kwinjiza...

data.name: ModManager.Inventory.Scanning
data.value: Gusuzuma ivyongeweko no gusuzuma amadosiye akurikiranwa...

data.name: ModManager.Progress.Installing
data.value: Gushiraho impapuro zisuzumwe no kuzigama impapuro z'inyuma...

data.name: ModManager.Progress.Removing
data.value: Gusuzuma impapuro zose hamwe no gusubizaho impapuro za kera...

data.name: ModManager.Progress.Framework
data.value: Gushiraho uruzitiro rw'ibikoresho vya seriveri. Ndakwinginze ugume wuguruye iryo dirisha...

data.name: ModManager.Framework.SaveFailed
data.value: Amadosiye y'urwego yarashizweho, ariko Synix ntiyashoboye kuzigama amahinguriro ya seriveri. Genzura uburenganzira bw'ububiko hanyuma usubire urinde uburyo bwa seriveri imbere yo gutangura. Amadosiye yashizweko ntiyasubiwemwo.

data.name: ModManager.Progress.Failed
data.value: Ico gikorwa nticari gushobora kurangira. Subira urabe ikosa, hanyuma usubiremwo imbere yo gusubira kugerageza.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Wait
data.value: Rindira gushika igikorwa kiriko kirakorwa kirangiye.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.OverviewHelp
data.value: Genzura seriveri ya Minecraft yatoranijwe ngaha. Nuhagarike imbere yo guhindura amadosiye, isi, impapuro, canke igihe co gutangura. Gutangura, guhagarika no gusubira gutangura gukoresha uburyo busanzwe bwo gukingira ubuzima bwa Synix.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.OverviewValues
MinecraftWorkspace.ScheduleHelp
data.value: Koresha urutonde rw'ibihe vyo gusubira gutangura no kubungabunga, harimwo kurindira abakinyi no kubanza gukora backup yuzuye. Amasaha akoresha isaha yo muri iki kibanza. Synix itegerezwa kuba iriko irakora kugira ngo imbonerakure yayo ikore.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ScheduleValues
MinecraftWorkspace.PlayersHelp
data.value: Nusubize ibintu ku rutonde kugira ngo urabe amazina y'abantu ari kuri Internet be n'amazina y'abantu bari ku rutonde. Nuhitemwo canke wandikemwo izina ry'umukinyi, uce usubira kuraba ivyo yakoze. Amabwirizwa asaba ko haba serveri ikora be n'umuhuza w'ikibanza gikoresha. Bedrock ntishigikiye amategeko yo kubuza Java.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.SettingsHelp
data.value: Hindura server.properties na mod/plugin configuration files. Ibiciro bikoreshwa na Synix birahuza igihe server.properties ibitswe. Izina ryatangajwe / MOTD ritandukanye n'izina ry'iki kibanza. Refresh isubira kwinjiza ama configure externe mu gihe yahagaritswe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.EditorHelp
data.value: Gukiza biratuma haboneka amakopi yo gusubiza ibintu mu buryo. Impinduka ku bibuga, isi, imbuto, uburyo bw'urukino, umupaka w'abakinyi, hamwe n'ibikoresho vyo gucunga Minecraft birashigikiwe navyo birahindura Synix. JSON, XML, na YAML zirasesengurwa imbere yo kuzigama; Izindi mpapuro zisaba gutunganywa witonze. Ntugire uwo ubiyagira.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.WorldsHelp
data.value: Kwinjiza ZIP y'isi ya Java canke Bedrock mw'ikarata nshasha, uce uyitoranya kugira uyikoreshe. Isi iriho ntishobora gusubirizwa. Ibisohokayandikiro ntibihindurwa. Guhinduranya si uguhindura ibintu, canke gusuzuma ko isi y'umukino/mod ihuje; banza usubire inyuma.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ModsHelp
data.value: Nusuzume metadata na dependencies za JAR, utegure ivyongeweko canke usubiremwo igiteramo cose ca serveri. Koresha ubwoko bw'umukino n'ubwoko bw'imashini. Amasanamu y'ugushira hamwe ni impanuro kandi ntiyerekana ko code itekanye canke ko mod yose izokora.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.BackupsHelp
data.value: Ama backups yuzuye arimwo agapapuro ka seriveri, isi, ivyongeweko hamwe n'ibikoresho. Nubanze uhagarike iyo serveur. Banza usuzume ko ata kintu na kimwe cakozwe imbere yo gusubiza ibintu mu buryo. Gusubizaho bisubiriza dosiye ya seriveri; Impapuro z'amakori ziremeza ko ivyandikano vy'ubuhinga bwa none ari ukuri, ntiziremeza ko hari ingorane yari isanzwe iri muri ubwo buhinga.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.RecoveryHelp
data.value: Ihinduka iryo ari ryo ryose ry'ibiri muri yo riguma ririmwo amayagwa ya kera be n'ivyahahora. Hitamwo impinduka yakoreshejwe canke yahagaritswe kugira ngo uyisubize. Banza usubiremwo impinduka nshasha. Amadosiye yahinduwe hanze hamwe n'isi yinjiye irakingirwa. Gumana inyandiko yuzuye y'inyongera y'ivyaryohowe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.DiagnosticsHelp
data.value: Rondera ingorane zisanzwe mu vyandikano vya vuba vya serveri be no muri raporo ya nyuma yerekeye ivyononekaye. Ivyatowe ni ibimenyetso, si imvo yemejwe. Igikorwa CPU/RAM si Minecraft TPS/MSPT; bakoresha uburyo bwo gutondesha amakuru buhuye n'ibiri muri seriveri mu gihe bagerageza gusuzuma ibikorwa vya tick.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmStop
data.value: Guhagarika iyi seriveri biciye kuri Synix ubu nyene?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmRestart
data.value: Urashobora gusubiramwo iyi seriveri ukoresheje Synix ubu nyene?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.RuntimeNotice
data.value: Nushireho impinduro y'urukino yahisemwo, uwuriko arayirungika, wongere uyikure ku masôko yabo yemewe? Ibi bishobora gupakurura Java hanyuma ugakoresha installer ya Forge/NeoForge. Amadosiye ya seriveri abanza gutunganywa; Amadosiye yasubirijwe imbere yaho arazigamwa kugira ngo asubire gukoreshwa. Isi n'ibikoresho vy'inyongera birazigamwa. Gira urutonde rwuzuye rw'ivyandikano imbere y'uko uhindura ubwoko bw'urukino. Nta gikoresho c'urukino gitanguye.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmPlayer
data.value: Kurungika itegeko ry'umukinyi yatowe? Ubuhinga bw'ukwinjiramwo butuma umuntu ashobora gucungera neza iserveri y'urukino.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmWorld
data.value: Gukoresha isi yatowe mu ntango ikurikira? Isi ya none iguma kuri disiki. Nuhitemwo gusa isi ihuye n'igisohokayandikiro, impinduro be n'amahinduka y'iyi serveri.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.PackNotice
data.value: Kwinjiza uru rupapuro rw'ibanga rwizewe? Umupaki wa Modrinth urashobora gukuramo amadosiye yatanzwe mu masoko yemewe ya HTTPS. Mods n'ivyandikano vy'urukino birasohora kode iri muri serveri y'urukino. Imigero, hash, guhuza, n'ibipimo vya antivirus biriho ntibitanga icemezo c'umutekano. Nusuzume amahinduka yose imbere yo kuyashira mu ngiro.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.CompatibilityNotice
data.value: Amasheke asoma metadata atarinze kwinjiza kode ya mod. Uturimbi tw'indimburo, ukwisunga ibintu bimwe bimwe, hamwe na metadata zimwe zimwe zashizwe hamwe/zikiriho zisaba gusuzumwa n'umuntu. Ivyo bigeragezo ntibitanga icemeza c'uko ivyo bikoresho bihuye n'ubuhinga bwa none canke ko ata bubisha burimwo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.BackupSpace
data.value: Nusuzume ikibanza co gusubiriza be n'ikibanza gihari.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmBackup
data.value: Gukora backup yuzuye y'iyi serveri yahagaritswe?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmRestore
data.value: Gusubizaho backup yuzuye yatoranijwe? Amadosiye ya seriveri ahari azosubirizwa. Nusuzume ivyandikano vya kera wongere ugumane amayagwa ya none ukeneye imbere y'uko ubandanya.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.UndoNotice
data.value: Nusubize amakarata ya mbere y'iyi mpinduka. Amadosiye yongewe n'iyi mpinduka akurwaho gusa mu gihe atahindutse. Amadosiye yahinduwe arabuza gukira. Bisaba ko hakorwa backup yuzuye kugira ngo ihindurwe ry'isi yose rikorwe inyuma yo gutangura ubwoko butandukanye bw'urukino.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoLogFindings
data.value: Nta kintu na kimwe kizwi cabonetse muri ayo makuru aheruka gushikirizwa. Iki si isuzuma ry'amagara ryuzuye. Koresha uburyo bwo kwitegura maze urabe ikosa rya mbere riri hafi y'igihe c'ikosa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.PreviewSummary
data.value: Nusuzume imbere yo kuyikoresha: {0} nshasha • {1} yasubirijwe • {2} yakuweho. Amadosiye ya kera arazigamwa kugira ngo asubirwemwo. Nta seriveri yatangujwe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Runtime
data.value: Inyubako ya seriveri idahungabana usavye canke metadata yayo y'ugukuraho ntibiriho. Huza amahitamwo y'impinduro/y'inyubako wongere ugerageze.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Size
data.value: Ibi bikubiyemo birarenze dosiye, metadata, canke ibipimo vy'ubunini bwose.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Recovery
data.value: Ibiharuro vy'abatowe ntibirimwo canke ntibihuza. Gumana iyo dosiye y'ugusubiza ibintu mu buryo kandi ukoreshe kopi yuzuye y'ububiko bwemewe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PendingRecovery
data.value: Igikorwa c'ibiri imbere kirakeneye gukosorwa. Fungura Gusubiza mu buryo Impinduka hanyuma uyitorere umuti imbere yo kugira iyindi mpinduka.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Changed
data.value: Inyandiko yahinduwe kuva isubirwamwo canke kuva ico gikorwa gitanguye. Nusubiremwo maze usubire urabe. Nta mpinduka zidasa zizosubirwamwo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Layout
data.value: Uburinganire bw'ipakete canke inzira yo kuyikoresha si nziza, ntiyumvikana neza, canke ntishigikiwe. Hitamwo igikoresho ca seriveri gifasha canke ububiko bw'isi yose.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.ActiveWorld
data.value: Iyi ni isi y'abantu bakora cane. Nimuhindukire ku yindi si imbere y'uko mukuraho ivyo mwinjiza.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldExists
data.value: Iyo dosiye y'isi irahari. Guhitamwo izina rishasha ry'ububiko; Isi iriho ntiyigera isubirwamwo n'ikindi kintu.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldLayout
data.value: Guhitamwo ububiko burimwo isi imwe na level.dat. Ibikoresho vy'ububiko bwuzuye hamwe n'ivy'isi vyinshi bikoresha inzira y'akazi yo gusubiramwo / kugarura.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldEdition
data.value: Iyi si ntihuza n'igisohokayandikiro ca serveri canke irabura amadosiye y'akarere/database yari itegerejwe. Isi ya Java na Bedrock ntiyahindutse.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldName
data.value: Koresha izina ry'ububiko bw'isi butekanye, butagira inzira canke amazina ya Windows yabujijwe. Ku bijanye n'ibiri mu yindi mibumbe, koresha indome, ibiharuro, ibibanza, utujambo tw'agacerere canke utujambo two munsi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.JavaOnly
data.value: Uru rutonde rw'ibikorwa ni urw'abakozi ba Java. Gukoresha uburyo bwo gukora bw'inyongera bwa Bedrock bwite; Java JARs ntizishobora gukora kuri Bedrock.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PackEmpty
data.value: Nta bikoresho vyo kuri serveri bifasha vyatowe. Ivyandikano vy'intango, amadosiye y'abakiriya, ibihe vyo gukora, isi, hamwe n'ibikoresho vy'umukozi w'umuzi ntibitwarwa n'igikorwa c'ibikorwa vya modpack.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.LoaderMismatch
data.value: Ubwoko bw'ivyanditse ntibuhuye na porogarama ya seriveri yatowe. Mods zikeneye mod loader ibereye; Ama plugins Bukkit/Paper akenera igihe co gukora.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.CurseForgeManifest
data.value: Iki ni icegeranyo c'abakiriya ba CurseForge, si igikoresho cose ca seriveri. Nimuvome ZIP y'umukozi w'umwanditsi irimwo ama mods n'ama config; amadosiye ataboneka ntasimburwa mu gacerere.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PackVersion
data.value: Inyanduruko ya Minecraft y'ipaki n'imashini yo kwinjiza/guhingura bikwiye guhuza n'iyi seriveri. Nubanze uhitemwo ico gihe nyene woshiramwo. Ibikoresho vyo gupakira bitashigikiwe ntibisubirwamwo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.DownloadSource
data.value: Gukuramo canke kurungika ahandi si isoko yemewe ya HTTPS. Koresha ZIP y'umukozi wo mu karere ashigikiwe n'umwanditsi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.DownloadHash
data.value: Idosiye yatororokanijwe ntiyahuye n'ubunini bwayo bwavuzwe canke SHA-512 hash. Nta kintu na kimwe cari gihari.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Properties
data.value: Agaciro ka Minecraft gakoreshwa na Synix ntigafise agaciro canke karahushanye. Imbere yo kuzigama, banza usuzume ibibanza, urugero rw'abakinyi, uburyo bwo gukina be n'uburyo bwo gucungera.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.SaveEntry
data.value: Synix ntiyashoboye kuzigama inyandiko y'umukozi yavuguruwe. Ico gikorwa nticemewe; amadosiye yo gusubiza ibintu mu buryo yaragumijwe aho vyari bikenewe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.ManagementLocal
data.value: Imigenderanire yo gucunga Minecraft ya Synix igomba kuguma kuri localhost. Ntureke ngo ako kantu k'icegeranyo k'ubuyobozi gafatwe n'ubuhinga bwa Internet.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PortConflict
data.value: Urubuga rwatunganijwe ni urw'uwundi mukoresha Synix. Hitamwo iyindi port imbere yo kuzigama.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Player
data.value: Hitamwo igikorwa gishigikiwe n'izina ry'umukinyi rifise ishingiro. Java kubuza si amabwirizwa ya Bedrock.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.StartFailed
data.value: Serveri ntiyatanguye. Nusuzume ivy'ukwitegura be n'ibiharuro vy'ibikorwa vyo mu bubiko bw'ibikoresho imbere yo gusubira kugerageza.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.MetadataUnknown
data.value: Ivya metadata ntivyashoboye gusomwa vyose. Nusuzume ivy'iyo dosiye n'ivyo umwanditsi wayo asaba ko bihuye.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.Duplicate
data.value: Abarenga umwe ku rwego rwo hejuru JAR batangaza iyi ID. Nusuzume wongere ukure igisomwa c'inyongera.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.ClientOnly
data.value: Iyi JAR ivuga ko ari iy'abakiriya gusa. Ntiwushire kuri serveri yihariye.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.WrongLoader
data.value: Imitahe y'iyi JAR ntihuza n'imashini/porogaramu yatowe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyMissing
data.value: Ibisabwa ntibishobora kuboneka muri metadata yasomwe: {0}. Nusuzume ko ata kintu na kimwe gifise aho gihagaze imbere y'uko ushirako ikintu ico ari co cose.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyVersion
data.value: Gushingira {0} bisaba {1}; inyandiko ya scan ni {2}.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyReview
data.value: Mu buryo bw'amaboko, kuraba ko hari ibiva mu gukoreshwa {0}: bisaba {1}, {2} isuzumwa. Ico gisata/iyo nteguro ntibiramenyekana neza.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Java
data.value: Ivyanditswe vyerekana ko ata tandukaniro riri hagati ya Java n'urukurikirane rw'umugwi. Koresha impinduro ya Java isabwa n'umukozi yatowe hamwe na mod loader.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Memory
data.value: Ivyanditswe vyerekana ko Java itashoboye gutanga ivyibutsa bihagije. Nusuzume RAM iboneka, urugero rw'abakozi, n'uko abandi bakozi bayikoresha.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Dependency
data.value: Urutonde rwerekana ibisabwa ku bijanye n'ukwisunga ibintu. Nusuzume ikosa rya mbere ry'imashini, uce usuzuma ukuntu imashini ikora neza, aho ihagaze, ubwoko bw'urukino, be n'ukuntu imashini ikora.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Port
data.value: Ivyandikano vyerekana ko hari ikivuko kiriko kirakoreshwa. Genzura iyindi migambi n'ibivuko vy'iyi seriveri vyashizweho; ntukingure ibibuga vy'uruhome rw'umuriro bitajanye.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Eula
data.value: Ikinyamakuru gisaba Minecraft EULA kwemera. Ubisomye kandi ukavyemera mu buryo busanzwe bw'ugutangura igikorwa ca mbere, nimba wemera.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Tick
data.value: Urutonde rw'ibintu vyabaye ruratanga amakuru y'ukuntu ibintu vyagiye birateba canke igihe vyagiye birakurikirana. Nusuzume ibibanza vya CPU, ivy'isi, ibiremwa be n'imiterere. Ibindi vyitwa RAM vyonyene bishobora kudatorera umuti ico kibazo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Mixin
data.value: Ikosa rya mixin rikunze kuba rijanye n'umuhuza w'imiterere y'ibikoresho. Nusuzume imvo ya mbere iri muri raporo y'isanganya hamwe n'ibisomwa vyasabwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.World
data.value: Urutonde rwerekana amakosa yo gusoma amakuru y'isi. Guhagarika seriveri no kuzigama amadosiye y'ubu imbere yo kugerageza backup yemewe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.RuntimeRecovery
data.value: Ubwo buhinga bwa kera ntibufise urutonde rw'igihe c'ugukoresha. Koresha igikoresho cose co gusubiriza kugira ugisubize; Synix ntizoshobora kumenya ivyari vyaraheze.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.RuntimeMismatch
data.value: Ikiringo c'ugushiraho ntigihura n'igisohokayandikiro catoranijwe, verisiyo, uwupakira, canke ibisabwa vya Java. Fungura Minecraft Control Center hanyuma ukoreshe Apply Runtime imbere yo gutangura.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.InvalidValue
data.value: Agaciro ka {0} ntikarimwo. Hindura iyi mpinduka imbere yo kuzigama.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Empty
data.value: Nta bintu vyo kwerekana. Nusubize inyuma y'ugushiraho ibirimwo canke uhinduye uburyo iyi seriveri yashizweho.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.CompatibilitySummary
data.value: {0} ivyongeweko vyatowe • {1} ivyabonetse vyo gusuzuma. Iryo genzura ntirihindura amadosiye.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoCompatibilityAddOns
data.value: Nta vyongeweko vyabonetse mu mpapuro z'inyongera canke mu mpapuro z'inyongera z'iyi porogaramu.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoCompatibilityFindings
data.value: Nta ngorane zabonetse mu gusuzuma ibiharuro vya metadata bihari. Ivyo ntibitanga icemezo c'uko ama mod canke ama plugin yose azokorana.

data.name: AsaPackages.Help
data.value: Hitamwo ZIP ya ASA Windows-server yakuwe canke ububiko bwakuwe. Synix irondera indondoro za mod imbere y'impapuro zisanzwe, zipfunyitse canke nyinshi kandi itegura CurseForge ID zabo kugira isubirwe. Amadosiye ya ZIP ntasubirwamwo canke ngo ashirwemwo. ASA ikuraho ikongera igashira ku rutonde rwa seriveri y'uwutanga izo seriveri igihe uyitanguje; ibi ntibikurikiza inyandiko ya ZIP.

data.name: AsaPackages.Choose
data.value: Hitamwo ZIP canke ububiko ushaka gusuzuma. Nta mahinduka y'ibikoresho canke amadosiye bizohinduka gushika igihe uzosuzuma urutonde rw'amazina y'abagize uwo mugwi ukongera ukaruzigama.

data.name: AsaPackages.Trust
data.value: Amasanamu y'ibiri muri ako gasandugu ni ayo kwizigirwa. Gutahura si ukuraba ko hari ububisha, gusuzuma ko buhuye canke kwerekana uwutanga ico gitabu.

data.name: AsaPackages.Reading
data.value: Gusoma metadata z'ipakete. Nta kode ya mod iriko irakoreshwa.

data.name: AsaPackages.Found
data.value: Mods {0} zisanzwe; {1} impapuro nshasha zo kwongerako. Amakarata y'amazina y'abapfuye arabandanya gukurikirana. Subira urabe urutonde rwose imbere yo kurubika.

data.name: AsaPackages.Timeout
data.value: Gusuzuma amapaki vyarahagaritswe canke vyafashe igihe kirekire cane. Hitamwo agapapuro k'ipakete gatoyi wongere ugerageze.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Source
data.value: Nuhitemwo ZIP ya moderi y'umukozi wa ARK canke ububiko bwa moderi yakuwemwo. Izindi mpapuro z'ivyandikano ntizishigikiwe n'iki gisomwa.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Limit
data.value: Uwo mugwi urarengeye akarimbi k'umusomyi wa metadata. Nuhitemwo agapapuro gatoyi canke ZIP itarenza 100.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Urwo rupapuro rurimwo inzira zidakingiwe, amahuza, inzira zibiri, amadosiye avuguruzanya, canke udupapuro tw'impapuro twinshi cane. Nta kintu na kimwe cahindutse.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Descriptor
data.value: Nta .uplugin mod descriptor yabonetse. Guhitamwo ZIP ya mod canke ububiko bwayo yakuwemwo; ibitabu vya kera bibanza gushirwa hamwe ni vyo bitegerezwa kubanza gukurwaho.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Metadata
data.value: Ikidondora mod ntikibereye, kitumvikana JSON. Nta kintu na kimwe cahindutse.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Game
data.value: Insiguro ntiyerekana umugambi ARK: Survival Ascended CurseForge. Synix ntishobora kumenya urukino canke indangamuntu ya mod.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Id
data.value: Insiguro y'igikorwa (descriptor) ntifise indangamuntu imwe yemewe y'igikorwa CurseForge (cf_ugcID). Koresha Manage Mod IDs hamwe na ID kuva ku rupapuro rwa CurseForge rw'umwanditsi.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.ServerBuild
data.value: Umu mod ntiyemerwa n'ipakete ya WindowsServer canke ifise dosiye .ucas/.utoc idahuye. Hitamwo Windows-server yo kwimura, ntiwihitiremwo client yo kwubaka.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.DuplicateMod
data.value: Umupfuko urimwo ibisobanuro birenze kimwe kuri ID ya mod imwe. Nuhitemwo ubwoko bumwe bw'iyo modoka maze usubire uyisuzume.

data.name: AsePackages.Help
data.value: Guhitamwo ZIP mod ARK: Survival Evolved canke agapapuro karimwo .mod descriptor hamwe n'agapapuro ka mod kateguwe gahuye. Synix isoma ID y'ikigo ivuye mu gisigura, si izina rya ZIP. Amadosiye ntasubirwamwo canke ngo ashirwemwo: inyuma yo gusuzuma, Synix irahindura ActiveMods na ModIDS ku nzira ya ARK y'ugukurura. Amakarata n'amahinduka yose ashobora gukenera gushiraho seriveri zitandukanye. Ibikoresho vyo mu bwoko bwa ASA CurseForge ntibisa neza.

data.name: AsePackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Iyi si mod export yuzuye yemewe na ASE. Nushiremwo indondoro ya .mod hamwe n'ububiko bwa mod buhuye na mod.info hamwe n'ibintu vyateguwe. ID yashizweko itegerezwa guhuza n'izina ry'idosiye yose y'igitigiri. Inyandiko za Raw Workshop .z zitagira dosiye .mod yateguwe ntizishigikiwe n'uyu musomyi; Koresha "Manage Mod IDs" mu gishingo.

data.name: ArkPackages.Error.WrongEdition
data.value: Uyu mupfuko urimwo insiguro y'ikindi gisomwa ca ARK. ASE Steam Workshop mods na ASA CurseForge mods ntizishobora guhinduranya. Guhitamwo iforoma y'umukozi yatowe.

data.name: UniversalMods.Locations.Help
data.value: Nushireho agapapuro ka mod canke ka plugin hamwe n'ubwoko bw'amadosiye nyamukuru yakiriwe ukoresheje ubu buyobozi bw'uru rukino canke bw'iki gikoresho co kwinjiza. Ibi birakora kuri iyi serveri gusa. Guhitamwo ikibanza kiriho kugira kivugururwe; nta madosiye ya mod ahindurwa ngaha.

data.name: UniversalMods.Locations.Warning
data.value: Kwimura dosiye ntiyishiraho imashini yo kwinjiza canke ngo yandike ama mods atunganijwe n'uwutanga. Nusuzume amabwirizwa y'ingene wokwinjiza uwo mukino.

data.name: UniversalMods.Locations.Ready
data.value: Kwimura dosiye y'umwimerere ugukenera gusuzumwa ku bijanye n'uguhuza

data.name: UniversalMods.Locations.Start
data.value: Koresha ibibanza vyo kwinjiza kugira ushobore gushiraho ububiko bwa mod canke plugin kuri iyi seriveri. Kwimura amadosiye ntibisigura ko urukino rushobora kuyatwara.

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Help
data.value: Hitamwo agapapuro kari muri pakete karimwo ibintu biri mu kibanza c'umukozi wahisemwo. Amadosiye y'inyongera arazigamwa. Urashobora gukuraho impapuro zirimwo ivyo wavomye mu guhitamwo ububiko bwimbitse. Amadosiye ari kuri urwo rutonde ni yo gusa azotumizwa; amadosiye ahari araronka amakopi yo gusubiza mu buryo. Ibi ntibihindura ama mods adahuye.

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Reading
data.value: Gusoma impapuro z'inzira no gutegura inzira y'inzira...

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Summary
data.value: {0} amafayili yatowe; {1} amadosiye ahari azosubirwamwo imbere yo gusubirizwa. Nta kintu na kimwe gishirwa mu bubiko gushika habaye ikimenyamenya gikurikira.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.InvalidLocations
data.value: Ibibanza vyo kwinjizamwo vyazigamwe ntibikora canke biri ku yindi game ya serveri. Nta madosiye yahinduwe.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.InstallFolder
data.value: Nushire iyi seriveri imbere yo gushiraho ibibanza vyo kwinjiza.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.LocationLimit
data.value: Serveri imwe ishobora kuba ifise ibibanza vyo kwinjiza 32.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.LocationName
data.value: Andika izina ry'ahantu mu ndome 1–80 uce uhitamwo Mod canke Plugin.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.Extensions
data.value: Niwandike 1–32 amazina y'inyongera y'amadosiye y'ibanze, harimwo n'uduti twazo, nk'akarorero .dll canke .pak. Ibikoresho vyo kwinjiza n'ivyandikano vy'amabwirizwa ntivyemerwa.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.Collision
data.value: Uru rupapuro rurimwo ikibazo c'ububiko n'ububiko. Nuhitemwo ibintu vyose biri kumwe kandi bitagira amahinyu.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.NoFiles
data.value: Ububiko bw'ipakete bwahisemwo ntibufise ubwoko bwa dosiye nyamukuru y'iki kibanza. Hitamwo iyindi dosiye y'ibiri muri yo canke usubire urabe ubwoko bw'ibiri muri iyo dosiye.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.PackageRoot
data.value: Hitamwo agapapuro gashobora gukoreshwa muri ako gasandugu. Inzira ziri hanze y'ipaki ntizemerwa.

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Done
data.value: Amadosiye yarinjijwe. Ivyandikano vyasubirwamwo vyazigamwe ku bw'ivyandikano vyasubirijwe. Nusuzume ibisabwa mu kwinjiza n'ugukoresha urwo rukino imbere yo gutangura. Nta seriveri yatangujwe.

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Rollback
data.value: Gusubiza inyuma ipaki yose yinjiye "{0}" ({1} files)? Ivyo biragarura amadosiye yahoze kandi bikuraho amadosiye yongewe n'ipakete. Biragira ingaruka kw'ipakete yose, atari gusa ku mpapuro zatoranijwe.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Help
data.value: Nuhitemwo ZIP, dosiye ya mod yakuwe kuri internet, canke ububiko bwakuwemwo. Synix isoma ipaki ya {0} ikerekana ingene izokwongerwa imbere yo guhindura ikintu na kimwe.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Filter
data.value: Impapuro za ZIP (*.zip)|*.zip|Amadosiye ya Mod canke Plugin (*.*)|*.*

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Empty
data.value: Banza uhitemwo ZIP yawe canke ububiko wavomye. Ntibikenewe ko ubanza gushiraho ibibanza vyo kwinjiza.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.DestinationHelp
data.value: Nuhitemwo ububiko bwa mod buri muri iyi serveri, ukurikije amabwirizwa yo kwinjiza urwo rukino.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Reading
data.value: Gusoma ipaki no gusuzuma ingene imeze... nta madosiye yo kuri serveri ahindurwa.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Unknown
data.value: Soma impapuro {0}. Synix ntiyashoboye kumenya aho urwo rukino rugana. Hitamwo agapapuro ka mod ya seriveri; ubwoko bw'amadosiye buzuzwa bukwi na bukwi. Ntimukigere mutegera iyo dosiye.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Ambiguous
data.value: Soma impapuro {0}. Ahantu harenze hamwe harashobora gukoreshwa. Nuhitemwo uburyo bwo guhinyanyura canke bwo kwongeramwo buhuye n'ubwo uri aho hejuru kugira ngo urabe imbere y'igihe.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Cancelled
data.value: Igisomwa c'ipakete carahagaritswe. Nta kintu na kimwe cazanwe hanze.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.ProviderDetails
UniversalMods.Wizard.ProviderWarning
data.value: Twasanze {0} mod IDs. Ubukurikira, nurabe urutonde rw'ibiranga umuntu. ARK ikuraho ama modes mu ntango yayo ikurikira; ibi si ugushiraho dosiye y'akarere. Nta seriveri itangurwa ubwayo.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.LoaderMissing
data.value: Uru rupapuro rurakeneye uburyo bwo kwinjiza kuri seriveri buhuye. Nushireho ico gikoresho co kwinjiza mu bikoresho vyo kuri serveri, uce wugurura ca gikoresho co kwinjiza. Amadosiye ntiyahinduwe.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Summary
data.value: {0} files will be imported; {1} amadosiye ahari azosubirwamwo imbere yo gusubirizwa. Nusuzume ibibanza bikurikira. Nta mushakashatsi n'umwe utangura ubwawo.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.ManualWarning
data.value: Amadosiye azosubirizwa muri {0}. Nusuzume urutonde rw'abakinyi n'amabwirizwa y'urukino: guhitamwo agapapuro ntibituma umuntu ashiramwo ivyongeweko canke ngo bitume haboneka ama mods atunganijwe n'uwutanga izo nkino. Ico kibanza kizokwibukwa gusa inyuma yo kwemezwa.

data.name: ModSupport.ImportRules
data.value: Synix ifise amategeko yo kwinjiza muri urwo rukino. Iyo pakete itegerezwa kuba igihuye n'igikoresho c'ugupakira, igisata ca seriveri hamwe n'ibisanzwe.

data.name: ModSupport.ManualSetup
data.value: Nta tegeko ryo kwinjiza ry'umudendezo ririho kuri urwo rukino. Soma uburyo bukurikira imbere y'uko uhitamwo iyo uja; Amadosiye arashobora kandi gukenera kwugururwa mu buryo bw'ugutunganya canke mu mugwi w'abatanga serivisi.

data.name: ModSupport.EvidenceNote
data.value: Imfashanyo y'ivyandikano si igerageza ry'ugukorana n'abasuku. Ama mods y'amaserveri, ama mods y'abakiliya n'abashira ibibanza vy'ibikoresho ni ibintu bitandukanye. Nta kintu na kimwe gikururwa, gishirwa canke gitangurwa n'uru rutonde.

data.name: ModSupport.UnverifiedNote
data.value: Nta buryo bwizewe bw'ugushira muri serveri bwemejwe gushika ubu. Ivyo ntibisigura ko uwo mukino udashobora guhindurwa. Nuhitemwo ZIP canke ububiko kugira ubusuzume, uce ukoresha amabwirizwa y'umukozi w'umwanditsi kugira ngo umenye aho uriko uraja n'aho ukorera.

data.name: ModSupport.Sources
data.value: Imirongo yo kwinjiza (fungura uruzitiro kugira usome)

data.name: ModSupport.GuidedImport
data.value: Uburyo bwo guhinduranya ibintu kuri serveri buranditswe. Koresha Mod support & setup kugira umenye amabwiriza yo kwugurura, hanyuma ukore Import ZIP / folder kugira usuzume ipaki yawe.

data.name: ModSupport.UnverifiedImport
data.value: Nuhitemwo Importera ZIP / ububiko kugira usuzume ipaki. Gushigikira seriveri bisaba kwemezwa; Imfashanyo ya Mod & Setup isigura aho ubushobozi bugarukira.

data.name: ModSupport.InvalidCatalog
data.value: Urutonde rw'ibikoresho vyo gushigikira udukino ntirushobora gusomwa. Raba neza ko Synix yawe yuzuye.

data.name: Configuration.Sync.Changed
data.value: Iyo porogarama yarahindutse kuva yuguruwe. Subira uyugurure imbere yo kuzigama.

data.name: Configuration.Sync.SaveEntry
data.value: Inyandiko ya seriveri Synix ntiyashoboye kuzigamwa. Ihingurwa ry'amasanamu n'amasanamu ya seriveri vyasubijweho.

data.name: Configuration.Sync.Ambiguous
data.value: Agaciro ka '{0}' gatangwa n'abantu benshi karerekana ibigereranyo canke ko bidahuza. Bishire mu ngiro imbere yo kuzigama kugira Synix ishobore kuvugurura agaciro k'umukozi gakwiye.

data.name: Configuration.Sync.InvalidValue
data.value: Ingingo ya "{0}" ifise agaciro k'ubusa kuri Synix. Gukosora imbere yo kuzigama.

data.name: Configuration.Sync.RollbackFailed
data.value: Ukuzigama vyarananiwe kandi imiterere y'intango ntiyashoboye kugarurwa mu buryo bwikora. Ntutanguze seriveri gushika usuzumye uburyo bwo kuyitunganya n'igicapo cayo: {0}

data.name: ModInstallGuide.PendingCompatibility
data.value: Nuhitemwo igipfunsi n'aho kija kugira urabe ico Synix ishobora gusuzuma.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.PendingDestination
data.value: Nta kibanza catoranijwe. Nta madosiye canke amahinguriro y'umukozi yahindutse.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.PendingActivation
data.value: Kwinjiza nta na rimwe bitangura seriveri ubwayo. Gushira mu ngiro biterwa n'urukino rwatowe hamwe na sisitemu ya mod.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.PendingRecovery
data.value: Gira isubiramwo rya seriveri n'isi imbere y'uko ukoresha ama mods mashasha. Inzira yatowe izosigura ico umuntu ashobora guhindura.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.LayoutRecognized
data.value: Uburyo bwo kwinjiza/gushira ibintu buramenyekana. Imigwi y'imikino, ibiyishingira hamwe n'ibisabwa n'abakiriya ntibiremezwa neza ngaha; Nusuzume ivyo uwanditse ico gitabu asaba.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ManualCompatibility
data.value: Ubuhinga bukoreshwa n'intoke ‡ ubushobora gukoreshwa n'intoke ntibwemejwe. Ubuhinga bw'ivyandikano buhuye ntiburerekana ko iyo mod ikorana n'urwo rukino canke ico gikoresho co kwinjiza.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.LoaderMissing
data.value: Kwinjiza birabujijwe: imashini yo gupakira irabuze canke ipaki ntihuza n'iyatoranijwe. Nusuzume impagararo za seriveri na Mod support & setup.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ProviderCompatibility
data.value: Impapuro zerekana uwutanga amakuru gusa. Mod versions, dependencies na platform compatibility ntibirasuzumwa. Nusuzume ko buri kintu c'uwutanga imfashanyo gifasha iyi seriveri.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ProviderDestination
data.value: Synix ibika urutonde rwa {0} ID, ntabwo ari dosiye mod ya ZIP. Umukino/uwutanga izo nkino ni we agenzura ikibanza ico gikino gikorerwamwo.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.FileChanges
data.value: {0} files in the plan; {1} amadosiye ahari azosubirwamwo imbere yo gusubirizwa.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.FilePreview
data.value: Hitamwo dosiye iri ibubamfu kugira umenye aho igiye. Nta kintu na kimwe kizosubirwamwo gushika hemejwe irindi suzuma.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ProviderActivation
data.value: Gumiza indangamuntu zasabwe, uce utanguza wewe nyene serveri wongere usuzume inyandiko yayo y'ugukura/gutangura. ZIP yatoranijwe ntishiraho verisiyo yakurutswe n'umukino/uwutanga.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ManualActivation
data.value: Gukoporora amadosiye ntibituma umuntu yandika canke ngo ashobore gukora mod. Nukurikize ubuyobozi bwatanzwe n'uwatunganije iyo porogarama, uce utanguza wewe nyene iyo porogarama wongere usuzume ivyanditse muri yo.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ScenarioActivation
data.value: Kwinjiza ibintu ntibihindura isi y'ibikorwa. Koresha Choose Scenario kugira uhitemwo iki gisomwa n'igicapo caco imbere yo gutangura. Amasezerano y'amahera ahari ntiyahinduwe mu buryo bw'imikorere.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.FileActivation
data.value: Iyo porogaramu yatoranijwe yo kwinjiza/gushiraho ibitabo irasoma amafayili yinjijwe igihe utanguje seriveri. Nubanze utegure neza ivy'uwo mwanditsi n'ivyo akeneye, uce uraba mu rutonde rw'abanditsi. Synix ntiyatanguje seriveri.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.FileRecovery
data.value: Guhagarika seriveri, guhitamwo igikoresho c'inyongera kandi ukoresheje Roll Back Import. Ibi bisubirira amafayili yasubirijwe kandi bikuraho amafayili mashasha y'iyo dosiye; Amahinduka yo hanyuma arashobora kubuza gusubirwamwo. Ntirisubiza ibintu mu buryo kw'isi. Nushire ibintu vyose mu bubiko imbere y'uko utangura.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ProviderRecovery
data.value: Hagarika seriveri hanyuma uhindure urutonde rwa ID kugirango ukure ivyongeweko canke usubize urutonde rwayo rwa mbere. Ivyo ntibikuraho amadosiye y'abatanga imfashanyo canke ngo bisubire mu mpinduro za kera z'imfashanyo. Imbere yo gutangura, niwitwararike urutonde rwa kera rw'indangamuntu be n'isubiramwo ry'ivyanditse vyose vyo kuri serveri.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ScenarioRecovery
data.value: Ikintu kiriko kiraba canke ibintu biriho bishobora kubuza ko bikurwaho.

data.name: Backup.Retention.Warning
data.value: Inyanduruko nshasha irakijijwe, ariko isuku ry'inyanduruko rikeneye kwitonderwa kuri {0}: {1}

data.name: Backup.Creation.Failed
data.value: Igikoresho co gusubiriza ntikirarangira. Imbere y'uko ubandanya, banza urabe imvo yatumye ivyo bintu biba.

data.name: ServerStart.Maintenance.BackupFailed
data.value: Gutangura guhagarikwa: ubufasha bwasabwe ntibwakozwe. Nta kintu na kimwe cakozwe canke ngo serveri itangure. Nusuzume ikosa ryo gusubiriza hanyuma usubire ugerageze.

data.name: ServerStart.Maintenance.UpdateFailed
data.value: Gutangura guhagarikwa: isubirwamwo ryasabwe ntiryarangiye. Iserveri iguma ihagaritse. Subira urabe ikosa ry'ivugurura imbere y'uko ugerageza.

data.name: ServerActions.Operation.RequiresStopped
data.value: Guhagarika seriveri no kwemeza ko inzira zayo zavuye imbere yo kuvugurura canke kwemeza amadosiye yayo.

data.name: Backup.Error.CustomFolderUnavailable
data.value: Ububiko bw'ububiko bwa backup bwatowe ntiburaboneka. Subira uyihuze canke uhitemwo iyindi dosiye yo gusubiriza. Synix ntizokoresha mu gacerere ahantu hatandukanye.

data.name: Configuration.Sync.TooLarge
data.value: Imiterere yasubiwemwo ni minini cane ku buryo idashobora guhuza neza. Subira urabe iyo dosiye imbere yo gutangura seriveri.

data.name: Backup.Progress.Synchronizing
data.value: Guhindura impagararo za Synix mu buryo bwasubiwemwo...

data.name: Backup.Restore.SettingsPending
data.value: Amadosiye yo gusubiriza yasubijweho, ariko Synix ntiyashoboye kurangiza kuvugurura impagararo za seriveri. Amadosiye yo gusubiza ibintu mu buryo yaragumijwe. Gukosora ikibazo wongere ugerageze Start; itanguriro riguma rihagaritswe gushika uguhuza kuroraniwe. Amakuru: {0}

data.name: Backup.Error.RestartForRecovery
data.value: Igikorwa c'ugusubiza ibintu mu buryo cari carahagaze. Subira utanguze Synix kugira uyisubize imbere y'uko utangura canke usubizaho iyi seriveri.

data.name: Backup.Restore.PreviousPending
data.value: Igikorwa c'ugusubiza ibintu mu buryo cari cakozwe imbere y'aho kiracakeneye kwitwararikwa. Ico gikorwa co gusubiza ibintu mu buryo ntikiratangura. Ido n'ido: {0}

data.name: Language.PreviewNotice
data.value: Intangamarara: Ibikoresho nyamukuru vyo gucungera vyarahinduwe. Imfashanyo zimwezimwe be n'ivyuma vyo gusuzuma indwara biracari mu congereza.

data.name: GameText.Introduction
data.value: Synix yemera inyandiko mpuzamakungu. Ibisata vyose biri munsi y'iyi ngingo bifise akaranga kavyo k'ibimenyamenya; gushigikira izina ry'uruharo ntibiranga gushigikira ijambo ry'ibanga. Ntivyemejwe ntibisigura ko bidashigikiwe kandi ntibitegeka ko hakoreshwa ururimi rw'icongereza gusa. Inyandiko si ukugerageza buri gisomwa c'urukino, inyuguti z'umukiriya canke uburyo bwo kwinjiza.

data.name: GameText.SafetyNote
data.value: Gumana amajambo y'ibanga neza na neza nk'uko yashizwe: ibimenyetso bisa n'ivyo bishobora kuba bifise uburyo butandukanye bwo kwandika. Ibibanza vyategekanirijwe kurondera n'ibibujijwe biracabaho. Ibimenyetso vyemeza ko umuntu ari we, indangamuntu, amazina y'amadosiye hamwe n'amazina y'abakoresha y'abakinyi birafise amategeko atandukanye.

data.name: GameText.SearchQuery
data.value: Uburyo bwo kurondera bujanye n'ubwoko bw'ibikoko

data.name: GameText.UnverifiedNote
data.value: Kurondera kuri internet ntivyerekanye ko ico kibanza gishigikiwe ku rwego mpuzamakungu. Nusuzume ibitabu vy'urwo rukino, wongere ugerageze abo bantu imbere y'uko uvyemera. Umupira wahagaritswe muri Synix si ngombwa ngo uhagarikwe mu rukino.

data.name: Content.007253C01F3D240BCA85
data.value: Euro Truck Simulator 2 itegerezwa kwinjiza amakarata yayo, DLC, n'impapuro z'ibikoresho vyo gukina imbere y'uko seriveri yihariye ishobora gutangura. Kurikiza intambwe zerekanywe zo gushiraho; Synix izokwinjiza ayo madosiye kuri iyo serveri.

data.name: Content.00DEEBB0AC0CF305D39F
data.value: Hariho uburyo bwo guhinyanyura kode yo ku ruhande rw'umukozi, harimwo n'uburyo bw'uguhinyanyura ivyimburwa vy'umwubatsi. Imigwi y'ibikoresho, ibikenewe hamwe n'ugukoreshwa kw'isi bivana n'umukino/umwimerere w'urukino; nta generique DLL destination yiyumviriwe.

data.name: Content.046758F1CA21BD9F666A
data.value:
Koresha aka gatabu kugira ngo utanguze umusereva wawe wa mbere. Synix iriko ikorera kuri iyi PC, ku bw'ivyo mu gihe abantu bariko barakina, mureke iyo PC igume iriho. Ntibikenewe ko wandika itegeko ryo gutanguza ku buryo busanzwe bwemewe.
1. Fungura Synix hanyuma ureke SteamCMD irangize gusuzuma. 2. Hitamwo Add Server, hanyuma ukore server nshasha. Nimba ayo madosiye y'umukozi asanzwe ariho, hitamwo Import Existing Server mu kibanza cayo. 3. Kuri General, andika izina ridasanzwe ry'umukozi hanyuma uhitemwo urukino. Nuhitemwo igisomwa, igisomwa c'urukino, canke igishobora kwinjiza ayo makuru nimba biboneka. 4. Nugume wisunga ibipimo vyatanzwe kiretse gusa hari ikindi kintu ukeneye. Nusuzume impapuro z'ugushiraho n'ukugurura maze uhitemwo neza ubutumwa bw'ugushiraho bukenewe ku mpera. 5. Nuhitemwo Gucungura Server. Ivyo vyongerako inyandiko kuri dashboard; ntibisigura ko urukino rwuzuye kwinjizwa. 6. Nuhitemwo ico canditswe uce uhitamwo Start. Mureke igikorwa co kwinjiza n'ugutanguza ubwa mbere gihere, mukurikiza ivyo Synix ibabwira. 7. Kurangiza uburyo bwose bw'ukwinjira muri urwo rukino, nk'amasezerano, kwinjira kuri konte, canke kurema ikiganiro mu buyobozi bwa seriveri yo mu rukino. 8. Niwifatanye n'uwo muhora ukoresheje iyo orodinateri canke ikindi gikoresho co kuri internet ukoresha i muhira. Uhejeje gukora ico kintu, nuce utegura agakaye imbere y'uko wongerako ama mods canke mbere imbere y'uko ugira ibindi bintu bihambaye uhinduye.
HAMWE WOMENYWA Fungura Readiness kuri serveri yatoranijwe hanyuma usome Activity & Diagnostics. Kurikira ikosa ryihariye aho gukomanga Start incuro nyinshi. Ku bijanye na Minecraft canke Satisfactory, mu gisata c'Inama zerekeye inkino harasigura intambwe z'inyongera.
Gucumbikira abantu batari mu mugwi wanyu ni intambwe itandukanye yo gushinga umugwi. Ubwa mbere niwemeze ko iyo serveri ikorera ng'aho.

data.name: Content.04A9AB215D19FA573345
data.value:
Ikintu cose kiri muri dashboard gikeneye izina ryaco n'ububiko bw'ibikoresho. Synix ihindura izina rya seriveri muri Windows-identite itekanye ku madosiye ashigikiwe n'uburyo bwo gutanguza. Ivyo biratuma uduhimba dutandukanye tudashobora gusangira amadosiye atabishaka; si imashini nyabwonko canke urubibe rw'umutekano.
IBIKORWA BITANZWE • C:\Synix ‡ ikibanza nyamukuru c'akazi k'amakuru Synix. • C:\Synix\SteamCMD ‡ igikoresho co gupakurura udukino dukoreshwa n'abandi. • C:\Synix\Games\<umukino>\<server> ‡ ibibanza bisanzwe vyo kuri serveri. • C:\Synix\BackupGames ‡ umuzi usanzwe wo gusubiriza. • C:\Synix\SynixData\logs ‡ inyandiko z'ibikorwa n'amakuru y'impanuka.
Amadosiye ya porogaramu MSI asanzwe ari muri %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. Amahitamwo amwe n'indangagaciro zikingiwe na Windows nazo ziri muri konti yawe ya Windows.
IBIKORWA BIKURIKIRA ABAGIZE Koresha Install & Launch igihe uhitamwo ububiko bwa seriveri. Kugira ushobore kwinjiza ikintu gishasha, nuhitemwo agapapuro gashobora kwandikwamwo ata kintu kirimwo kugira ngo uronke ikibanza gihagije co gushiraho urwo rukino be n'ibintu bishasha. Ntugire urutonde rw'ibintu bibiri biboneka mu gitabu kimwe.
Open Server Folder yerekana ikibanza nyaco ca serveri yatowe. Gufungura Urupapuro rw'Inkingi rwerekana aho iyo nkingi iri; Ntiwibaze inzira iyo ari yo yose ufatiye kw'izina ryayo.
ABAKIRIZA BASHOBORA kuba ahandi hose Urwo rukino rushobora kuzigama isi muri AppData, Documents, iyindi drive, canke mu yindi mice. Niwisuzume kugira umenye neza aho urwo rukino rwari ruri imbere y'uko usubira kugifata canke ukagishira ahandi.
Guhindura amazina canke kwimura amadosiye muri File Explorer ntibitanga icemeza ko inzira yose ibitswe izosubirwamwo. Koresha Synix's supported import/transfer workflow hanyuma usubiremwo inzira imbere y'intango ikurikira. Hariho n'utundi turorero twoba dukeneye ivyambu vyo mu buhinga bwa none bitavuguruzanya.

Synix icungera ikivuko co gutangura hamwe n'igiciro ca MaxPlayers gishigikiwe muri Game.ini, ariko seriveri itegerezwa gukoreshwa n'umukoresha inyuma yo gutangura ubwa mbere.

data.name: Content.0AD494C5598090AE9CCD
data.value: Space Engineers ikoresha icegeranyo cayo gisanzwe (Dedicated Server Manager), iyo Synix igomba kugumiza ku mugaragaro. Igihe cuguruye ubwa mbere, hitamwo Local/Console, hitamwo Continue to server configuration, winjize impagararo za seriveri n'iz'isi, hanyuma uhitemwo Save & start. Koresha umuyobozi w'ibikoresho vy'inyongera, isi, ama mods, abategetsi be n'igiteramo cayo. Synix ibika iyi instance munsi y'ububiko bwa Instance bwa seriveri. Uburyo bwa mbere Local/Console ntibukeneye uburenganzira bw'umuyobozi; Ariko rero, kurema serivisi yitwa Windows ni vyo vyovyo. Ibisabwa n'abategetsi ni .NET Framework 4.8 canke nshasha, Visual C++ Redistributables 2013 na 2017, n'imiburiburi 6 GB ya sisitemu RAM, na UDP port 27016 yemerewe biciye muri Windows Firewall kandi yandikirwa muri router ku bakinyi ba Internet. Ubuyobozi bwemewe: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

data.name: Content.0B2D550B207DD25F9B2D
data.value:
Uwo mugwi w'abacungezi uracungera ibikorwa vy'abasuku bizwi kandi urashobora gutanguza isubirwamwo ryashizweho inyuma y'aho habonetse ingorane itari yitezwe canke ikibazo catowe.
UMURIMO usanzwe Koresha Synix's Stop and Restart controls kugirango uhindure ibintu. Synix irahuza ivyo bikorwa n'umugwi w'abacungera umutekano ku buryo ugusama kwasabwe kutafatwa nk'isanganya.
Gufunga icegeranyo c'urukino, kugihagarika muri Task Manager, canke kugihagarika ukoresheje iyindi manager vyoshobora gusa n'ibitari vyitezwe kandi bigatuma hakoreshwa uburyo bwo gusubiza ibintu mu buryo.
INTANGURIRO Zisubirwamwo Guhagarika seriveri biciye kuri Synix, hanyuma ugasuzuma urutonde rw'abakinyi baheruka. Gutorera umuti ikibazo c'igihe co gutangura, ic'itunganywa, ic'ikibanza, ic'ukwibuka canke ic'uburyo imbere y'uko usubira gutangura. Gusubiza ibintu mu buryo ntibishobora gusanura uburyo budahuza canke uburyo butararangira bw'urukino.
Ukutumvikana kw'igikorwa n'isubiramwo ritaboneka ni ingorane zitandukanye. Gusubiza ibintu mu buryo bivana n'urwo rukino be n'ukuntu ibintu vyifashe, ku bw'ivyo ntiwibaze ko igihe cose hazoba hari ikinyuranyo c'umwanya.
IBIGERANIRWA Synix ikurikirana ibiterwa vyashigikiwe hamwe n'ibikorwa vy'abana bigize seriveri. Imashini nyabwonko ziyoborwa hanze canke serivisi z'ugushiraho zishobora kurenza umuriro wo gutanguza umukino kandi zikeneye kugenzurwa n'umukino.
Uwo mugwi w'abacungezi ntushobora gusubirira ama backups yemewe canke gucungera serveri iherutse guhindurwa mu gihe iriko iratangura neza.

2. Hindura 'Game.ini' kugirango ushyireho amategeko ya seriveri y'ishami rya kera n'amajambo y'ibanga ya admin.
3. Inyandiko yemewe: https://theisle.wiki.gg/

data.name: Content.0D2E92094CEB8EC48551
data.value:
Koresha Synix's lifecycle buttons ku gikorwa gisanzwe ca seriveri. Ivyo biratuma uwo murinzi ashobora gutandukanya uguterana n'umuduga n'uguterana n'umuduga atabishaka.
GUTANGURA Nucagure ico wandika uce uhitamwo Start once. Synix iragenzura ibisabwa, inzira, amarembo, hamwe n'ibikenewe imbere y'ugutanguza, itegura amadosiye ataboneka, hanyuma igatanguza seriveri. Rindira ico bizovamwo imbere y'uko usubira kugerageza.
Hagarara Nuhitemwo guhagarika maze ureke umwanya w'urukino ngo ugumeho hanyuma uheze. Synix ikoresha uburyo bwo guhagarika neza aho bishoboka, hanyuma igakoresha uburyo bwo guhagarika ibikorwa bugabanije nimba bikenewe. Guhagarika ku gahato birashobora gutuma umuntu atakaza intambwe atazigamye.
GUSUBIRAHO Nuhitemwo Gutangura gusubiramwo kugira uhagarike umugwi w'ibikorwa uriko urakora hanyuma utanguze ikindi kintu gishasha. Ntugire ikindi kintu wongerako mu gihe ivyo biriko biraba.
IGIHE IKINTU KITANZWE Uwundi muntu ashobora kuba asanzwe afise iyo serveri, igiteramo gishobora kuba kiri mu gihe c'amahinduka, canke urwo rukino rushobora kuba rukoresha uburyo bwo gukwiragiza hanze. Soma ubutumwa bw'ibikorwa n'ubushobozi bw'umwirondoro.
Niwirinde guhagarika seriveri muri Task Manager canke kuyihagarika ukoresheje igikoresho kitajanye n'igikorwa gisanzwe co kuyibungabunga. Ivyo vyoshobora gusa n'aho ari ugusohoka mu buryo butari bwitezwe maze bigatuma umuntu asubira kumera neza.
Imikino itunganijwe hakoreshejwe imashini nyabwonko canke serivisi zo hanze z'ugushira mu ngiro ikeneye gusuzumwa ubuzima bwayo. Kwugara ikibanza co gutangiramwo ibirwanisho ntibisigura ko ivyo bikorwa vyahagaze.

data.name: Content.14E361A374F9F14F65DD
data.value:
Satisfactory irasaba ko ibanza gutunganywa muri Server Manager yayo iri mu rukino. Synix irashobora kwinjiza no gutanguza seriveri yihariye, ariko ntishobora gusubirira gusaba seriveri canke kurema session yayo.
GUSUBIRA UMUGERAMIZO W'Urukino 1. Gushiraho inyandiko ya Satisfactory hanyuma uyitanguze muri Synix. 2. Rindira ko serveri yihariye irangiza kwuzuza. 3. Fungura Satisfactory's in-game Server Manager hanyuma wongere canke uhitemwo serveri. 4. Gusaba, shiraho ijambo ry'ibanga ry'umuhagarikizi, hanyuma winjire nk'umuhagarikizi. 5. Kora canke utore session ushaka gukoresha.
Synix icungera ibiciro vy'ugutanguza/guhuza, harimwo ikivuko co gutanguza na MaxPlayers. Inyandiko zikoreshwa ziri munsi ya FactoryGame\Saved\Config\WindowsServer.
CONNECT SYNIX 1. Gumana seriveri ikoresha -NewConsole. Genzura ivyinjijwe canke ivya kera; mu gihe wongeyeko ico ciyumviro, usubire kwugurura biciye kuri Synix. 2. Koresha urwego rumwe rw'uburenganzira bwa Windows kuri Synix no kuri seriveri, ni vyiza gukoresha uburenganzira busanzwe bw'abakoresha. 3. Guhitamwo iyo seriveri no gufungura Server Options → Satisfactory Control Center → Connect API. 4. Nuhitemwo "Kwihuza mu buryo bwikora" rimwe hanyuma urindire.
Synix irarungika server.GenerateAPIToken, igasoma amakuru yose yaheruka gusohoka, ikagenzura API yo ng'aho, igaca ibika ico kimenyetso mu buryo bwanditse kuri konti yawe ya Windows. Ico kimenyetso kiratanga uburenganzira bw'uwugikoresha, ntigiha gusa uburenganzira bwo kugikurikirana.
Raporo y'intsinzi Ikimenyetso cemejwe kandi kizigamwe neza maze gica gifungura Isanamu. Ntibikenewe ko ukoporora umurongo w'igicapo canke ngo ushireko ikimenyetso n'intoke.
Mu gihe iryo gerageza ryananiwe, Synix igumana uburyo bwose bwabanje kuzigamwa kandi ntisubire kugerageza iryo tegeko. Soma ico vyavuyemwo imbere y'uko usubira kugerageza.
Ibi bihuza na seriveri yatowe kuri iyi PC; ntibisaba itegeko rishasha ry'umuyoboro wa Synix. Gutangura, guhagarika no gusubira gutangura bisanzwe biracakora hatabayeho ikimenyetso ca API.

data.name: Content.1734B5184A8732EBE5C7
data.value:
Nuhitemwo icanditswe kiri mu bubiko bw'ibikoresho maze wugurure Ihitamwo ry'umukozi. Ibikoresho gusa bishigikiwe n'iyo profil be n'ukuntu imeze ubu ni vyo bitangwa.
IBIJANYE N'INKURU ZIBAZWE • Urutonde rw'ibikoresho n'Urutonde rw'ibikoresho vy'ubutabazi vyugurura ibibanza bikora. • Umwanditsi w'imiterere y'urukino arugurura amadosiye y'imiterere y'urukino ashigikiwe. • Server ya Update ikuraho impinduro y'urukino ishigikiwe. • Kwemeza ko Amadosiye y'urukino asuzuma canke asana amadosiye atunganijwe n'uwushiraho. • Backup na Restore bifasha kuzigama canke gusubiza mu buryo icegeranyo catowe. • Creat Batch File irungika inyandiko yo gutanguza igihe umwirondoro uyishigikiye. • Gusiba bikuraho inyandiko kandi bitanga gusa amahitamwo yo gukuraho dosiye yerekanywe mu kwemeza kwayo.
AMAHURIRO N'IBIKORWA VY'UBUHINGO Amakuru ajanye n'umuhuza yerekana aderese, ibivuko hamwe n'ibikorwa vyo gusubiramwo. Ibizamini vy'ubuhuza, Mod & Plugin Manager, ibikoresho vya Minecraft, hamwe na Satisfactory Control Center biraboneka aho bishigikiwe.
NUSUZUME SERVER iriko irakoreshwa Fyonda kabiri ku murongo wayo kugira umenye amakuru yerekeye serveri. Live Process Details yerekana ibibanza vy'ugutanguza, ivyitwa console hosts, hamwe n'ibikorwa vy'abakozi biri muri urwo rutonde. Umukino w'ibikorwa vyinshi urashobora kuba ufise ID y'ibikorwa irenga imwe.
Koresha icuma gikurikirana ibintu kugira usuzume CPU y'ico gisata be n'ivya kahise k'icibutso. Ivyo bisomwa biratandukanye n'ibisomwa vyerekana ingene PC yose imeze.
Gufunga idirishya ryerekana ido n'ido canke iryerekana uburyo bwo gucungera ibintu ntibihagarika urwo rukino. Nukoreshe akamenyetso kavuga ngo Hagarika mu gihe ivyo ari vyo ushaka.

data.name: Content.18D0D93C3EB881DA2D03
data.value:
Nuhitemwo impinduro ya Minecraft imbere y'uko uhitamwo uburyo bwo guhanahana amakuru canke uburyo bwo guhanahana amakuru. Java na Bedrock ni ubwoko bw'abakozi butandukanye; Bedrock si imashini yo gupakira Java.
Gushiraho SERVER 1. Gushiraho inyandiko Minecraft hanyuma uhitemwo Java canke Bedrock. 2. Kuri Java, hitamwo Minecraft version, loader, na compatible loader version zitangwa n'abahitamwo. 3. Nusuzume ingene isi imeze, uburyo bwo gukina bw'imvukira, urugero rw'abakinyi, ivyibutsa, ibivuko, n'ivyumba vy'umutekano. 4. Kubika no gutangura biciye kuri Synix. 5. Soma amasezerano ayo ari yo yose canke ivyasabwe mu ntango imbere y'uko wemera. 6. Nurindire isi irangize kwinjiza, hanyuma wifatanye n'igitabo c'abakiriya hamwe na verisiyo bihuye. 7. Gira isubirwamwo ry'isi ikora imbere yo kwongerako ama mods.
JAVA NA BEDROCK Amahitamwo ya Java arimwo Vanilla, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Paper, na Purpur aho inyubako ziboneka. Koresha verisiyo n'amahitamwo yo kwubaka; Paper na Purpur bakoresha plugins, mu gihe Fabric, Forge na NeoForge bakoresha mods zabo zihuye. Synix ikura igihe c'uguhitamwo mu gisata cayo gisanzwe.
Bedrock ikoresha pakete ya seriveri yihariye ya Bedrock kandi ntikoresha Java.
NIWISUZUME Nuhitemwo igikoresho co gupakira gikenewe n'imashini yawe. Gereranya verisiyo ya Minecraft, uwupakira ibintu, ibikenewe, n'ibikenewe ku ruhande rw'umukiriya.
Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, na plugin-server packages ntizishobora guhinduranya. Kurema agapapuro k'ama mods canke ama plugins ntibisigura gushiraho ico gikoresho canke ico gisata gisabwa. Browse Catalog si uburyo bwo gushiraho modpack canke ivyisunga.
IBIKORWA Configure icungera server.properties hamwe n'ibikoresho bihanitse. Java kandi itanga uburyo bwa Spectator. Ibiciro vy'ubuhinga n'amabwirizwa biguma mu buryo Minecraft yiteze.
Muri Server Options, fungura Minecraft Control Center. Urupapuro rwayo rwitwa "Settings" ruriko urutonde rw'amadosiye yo guhinyanyura ya seriveri. Edit File itanga gutunganya igisomwa; Structured Editor iratanga inyandiko y'inyanduruko ikoresha uburyo busanzwe. Vyompi birazigama amahinduka mu gihe serveri ihagaritswe. Ibiciro bizwi vya server.properties nka ports, player limit, world, seed, mode, hamwe na command-channel settings navyo birahindura ivyo Synix yaziganije. Izina ryatangajwe/MOTD ritandukanijwe n'izina ry'ikibanza. Ama moderi atazwi aguma mu madosiye yayo bwite.
Synix isubira gusoma izo nteguro imbere y'ugutunganya inyandiko canke kuyitanguza, no mu gihe Refresh ikoreshwa igihe ihagaritswe. Mu gihe ihinyanyurwa ry'inyuma ridafise agaciro canke rivuguruzanya n'ikindi canditswe, koresha ikibazo cavuzwe aho gusubira gutanguza seriveri. Umwanditsi yanse gusubiramwo dosiye yahinduwe kuva yuguruwe; Nusubire uyugurure kugira ngo utware ibiri muri yo bishasha.
Guhindura umwanya wa seriveri Niwitwararike ko ivyandikano vyawe vyose bibanza gusubirwamwo imbere y'uko uhindura impinduro canke ivyandikano vy'imashini. Nuhitemwo igihe gishasha co gutangurira muri Setup, usige inyandiko yasubiwemwo, uce uhitamwo Apply Runtime in Minecraft Control Center. Synix irategura igihe c'ugukoresha icegeranyo ukwaco, ikazigama server.properties hamwe n'amadosiye y'isi, kandi ikandika amakarata y'igihe c'ugukoresha yasubirijwe. Ntigutanguza icese serveri. Gutangura birabujijwe mugihe umwanya wo gukora wanditswe hamwe na profile yatoranijwe bidahuye.
Gusubira inyuma kw'idosiye ntiguhindura impinduka z'isi zakozwe nyuma y'uko seriveri itangura. Ntimwigere mwiyumvira ko isi yuguruwe na Minecraft nshasha canke n'izindi modes zishobora kwinjizwa n'inyuma y'igihe; mu gishingo c'ivyo, nuce usubiramwo inyandiko zose zisanzwe zihuye.
Guhagarika imbere yo guhindura amadosiye akeneye gutangurwa. Ntimusubirize isi iriho n'igishushanyo gishasha ngo kibe inzira ya hafi yo gusanura.
IGIHE ABAKINDI BADASHOBORA KWIYUNGERAMWO Genzura edition, version z'umukino/loaders, mods zikenewe, hamwe na port/protocol y'icegeranyo catowe. Kugira ngo usohoke hakiri kare, niwisuzume kugira urabe ko ata makosa y'uguhuza, y'igihe co gukina, y'ukwibuka canke y'ukwisunga ari mu gitabu c'urukino.

data.name: Content.29DD837D20479ABA0D1B
data.value:
Fungura Satisfactory Control Center umaze guhuza API yo mu karere. Hitamwo uruzitiro rw'igikorwa ukeneye.
INCAMAKURU Nuhitemwo Refresh kugira usome izina ry'ikoraniro, igitigiri c'abakinyi bafatanije/umurongo ntarengwa, ingene urukino rumeze, urugero rw'ibiharuro, umwanya wo gukina, n'urwego rw'ubuhinga.
Abakinyi ba dashboard baraharura update automatically mugihe connection ari nziza; Urutonde rw'ibisobanuro rusubirwamwo ku busabe. Iyi API iratanga ibiharuro, si urutonde rw'abakinyi bafise amazina. Ikiringo gihagaze canke seriveri irindiriye ikiganiro si igikorwa gihagaze.
INTEGURIZA Z'UMUZIMA Nuhitemwo Refresh, uhindure ibiciro bifasha, uce uhitamwo Apply changes. Subira usuzume ibiharuro vyategerejwe inyuma y'uguhindura. Amahitamwo amwamwe bisaba ko usubira gutangura; Gushira mu ngiro amahinduka ntibituma urukino rusubira gutangura.
Imfunguruzo z'ugushiraho n'ibiciro vyemewe biguma mu rurimi rw'ubuhinga bw'urukino.
IBIGANIRO VYAROKOTSE • Gumiza ubu: Andika izina canke ukoreshe izina ririmwo itariki Synix. Gukoresha izina rishobora gusubirira inyandiko yariho. • Umutwaro uratowe: Subira urabe ivyemejwe. Synix ibika intambwe iriko iragenda ubwa mbere igihe ikiringo kiriho; ugutwara ibintu birashobora guhagarika abakina urwo rukino. • Gushiraho ububiko: Bwongerako dosiye yatowe kandi ishobora gusubirira ububiko bw'izina rimwe. Ntiyiyicisha mu buryo bwikora. • Gukurura vyatoranijwe: Iraziganya ikopi ku nzira y'aho uba wahisemwo.
Imbere yo gusubiriza canke kwinjiza iyindi mibumbe ihambaye, niwame utegekanya iyindi. Ibikoresho vyo gukingira bifise igipimo c'umutekano 512 MB. API ishobora kuba itaboneka mu gihe ikiringo kiriko kiratangura.
IKINYAMARASO KIZIMYE Kurungika itegeko rimwe ry'umukino rishigikiwe hanyuma usome ikimenyamenya. Inyandiko, amabwirizwa y'igicapo/ijambo ry'ibanga, n'amahinduka yo kwinjira mu buryo butari bwizewe birabujijwe ngaha.
Amabwirizwa yo guhagarika ashigikiwe aca mu nzira y'ibikorwa vyo guhagarika Synix. Amajambo asohotse aguma muri ako kadirisha aho gusohorwa mu bubiko bw'ibikoresho canke mu bitabu vya Synix; Naho ari ukwo, urwo rukino rushobora kuguma rwandika amakuru yarwo bwite.

data.name: Content.29E9D2F428F5E2BA4705
data.value: Umuvugizi w'inyandiko z'amabanga y'ibikoresho vyo kuri serveri ya Java-edition. Inyandiko z'ubu n'iz'inyuma zikoresha API zitandukanye; imbere yo gukoresha aho ugiye kuraba, banza wisuzume kugira umenye neza ko iyo nteguro yashizweko be n'uburyo bwa plugin.

data.name: Content.2B0EFE8DBC3E9BEC09E3
data.value:
HARI ABAHAMBAYE GAKINDO K'ABANTU BABIRI:
Synix yashizeho uruzitiro rw'ibikoresho, ariko ntishobora kuvoma, gukoporora, canke gukwiragiza impapuro zifise uruhusha zivuye ku mukino usanzwe. Mu gihe seriveri itangaje ko hari ibintu bibuze mu gukina n'abakinyi benshi canke igatsitara igihe uriko urapakira canke uhindura amakarata, niwishingire Dark Messiah of Might & Magic Multiplayer ukoresheje Steam ukoresheje konti iyitunze. Niwandike ibintu vya mpsrc vy'abakinyi benshi bivuye muri urwo rukino mwinjije muri uru rupapuro rwanditse, hanyuma urabe neza ko mapcycle.txt na maplist.txt birimwo amakarata ushaka gukoresha.
Ico gikorwa gitegerezwa kurangurwa n'uwugikoresha mu kwinjiza ico gisata. Uburyo bw'imikino ni 0 Deathmatch, 1 Team Deathmatch, 2 Crusade, 3 Capture the Flag, na 4 Colosseum.

data.name: Content.2B637CF2169F0AD865CF
data.value:
Soma ivyavuye muri Connect mu buryo bwikora imbere yo gusubira kugerageza. Itegeko ryerekanwa mu gikoresho co gukinirako ntiryerekana ko igikorwa co gufata icandikano, kugenzura no kuzigama icandikano cabaye neza.
NUSUZUME IKINTU KIZIHAMBAYE • Console itaboneka: Emera -NewConsole, serveri yatoranijwe, n'ibibanza vy'uruhusha bihuye vya Windows. • Itegeko ritararangira mu vyo winjiza: Niwisuzume ubwawe. Synix ntishobora kuyisubiriza. • Itegeko ririko rirakorwa mugabo nta kimenyetso na kimwe gifashwe: Reka itanguriro rirangire, urabe ivyandikano vy'urukino bishobora kwandikwa, hanyuma ureke ibisohokayandikiro bishasha vyose bishike. • Ama filtres arabangamira: Nushire ahabona ama filtres yo kwinjiza/kuzimya hanyuma ureke console yishure. • Ikivuko ca API kiri mu kindi gikorwa: Gukosora ikivuko c'urukino catunganijwe ca seriveri yatowe. Nturungike ico kimenyetso ku muntu atajanye n'ivyo wumviriza. • Ikoreshwa ry'ikimenyetso ryanse canke ryatoranijwe ntirishobora kwugururwa: Niwuzuze urutonde rw'abakinyi, hanyuma usubire guhuza. • API ntishobora kuboneka: Nurindire ko itangura canke irinde kwuzuza maze usuzume urutonde rw'imikino.
Inyishu nshasha irashobora kuba ifise agaciro k'ikimenyetso nk'ak'inyishu ya mbere. Gufata bikoresha ibiva inyuma y'iryo tegeko, atari igicapo gishaje kiri mu rutonde rw'ibintu vyabaye.
GUKINGIRA CANDE GUSUBIRA KUGERA Satisfactory icapa ivyemeza ko ari umuhagarikizi muri console yayo ikongera ikandika. Nubirinde ku mugaragaro wongere ukure imirongo y'ibimenyetso mu mashusho n'amakuru.
Synix iremeza ko iherezo ryo mu karere ari iry'umukozi yatowe maze igashinga icemezo cayo. Ntureke gusuzuma ivyemeza kugira ngo ukemure ingorane.
Gukuraho ikimenyetso cazigamwe bihanagura ihurizo rya Synix ryahishijwe; ntikuraho ico kimenyetso ku mushakashatsi.
Kugira ngo ukureho impeta z'ibikoresho, koresha server.InvalidateAPITokens muri console ya Satisfactory canke muri console ya Server Manager. Ivyo biragira n'ingaruka ku bundi bufatanye bukoresha izo mpapuro.
Ku yindi konti ya Windows canke kw'ikoreshwa ryimuriwe ahandi, wongere uyinjiremwo nimba udashobora gukoresha ihuriro ryakingiwe.

data.name: Content.2E2BBD89AFEC2FD2B678
data.value:
Soma urutonde rw'ibikorwa n'urukino rwa nyuma rw'umukozi yatowe. Nurondere ikosa ry'ukuri rya mbere aho kurondera gusa ubutumwa bwo guhagarika bwa nyuma.
KWIYUMVIRIZA KU GUTANGURA KANDI KU GUSUBIRA IGIHE 1. Nushimike ku rupapuro rw'amabwirizwa rwatoranijwe rwo kwinjiza, urwandiko rushobora gutunganywa, urwandiko rw'urukino, n'urupapuro rw'amabwirizwa rushobora gutunganywa. 2. Nusuzume dosiye zikenewe, RAM y'ubusa/ahantu kuri disiki, n'ibivuko vyafashwe. 3. Niwuzuze amasezerano yose, ukwinjira muri konte, ibisabwa mu kugura icandikano, canke ugushiraho ikiganiro mu rukino. 4. Ku bijanye n'ama mods, gereranya umukino, uwutwara ibintu, ibikenewe, be n'ivyo umukiriya akeneye. 5. Imbere y'uko uhindura dosiye, banza uhagarike gukoresha Synix hanyuma ugerageze gutangura rimwe.
Uwuriko arakora arashobora kugumaho na nyuma y'aho umusuku nya musuku aburiye. Serveri nziza irashobora no kuba irindiriye kwinjizwa kw'isi canke ikaba ifise ikibazo kidashobora gukoreshwa/API. Nusuzume utwo turere ukwa twonyene.
GUSUBIRA IBIGURU canke KUBITANGURA BIRATWARUKA Udukino turakenera umwanya wo kuziganya no guhagarika ibikorwa vy'abakozi. Rindira ivyashikirijwe na Synix maze usome ubutumwa buvuga ko yahagaritswe. Umuntu arinze gusubirayo ku gahato, yoshobora kubura ivyo yari yarashoboye.
Ntimwice ibintu vyose icarimwe, mutangure ikindi gikopi, canke mukoreshe uwundi muyobozi ku bijanye n'iyo porogarama nyene.
Hari igikoresho canke ikintu kitariho Nusuzume ubushobozi bw'umwirondoro be n'ukuntu umeze ubu. Hariho ibintu bimwebimwe bidashobora gukoreshwa kubera ko ari ivy'uwo mukino canke kubera ko ata buryo bwo gucungera buhari. Kuba umukinyi ata makuru afise, ntibisigura ko vy'ukuri serveri yananiwe gukora.
Mu gihe iyo ngorane ibandanije, niwandike ico wakoze, ikosa ry'ukuri, hamwe n'agace gatoyi k'ivyabaye imbere y'uko ugira ayandi mahinduka adafitaniye isano.

data.name: Content.3111DCC7482FEADC74FC
data.value:
Gushiraho canke guhinyanyura MODPACK ya SERVER 1. Nimuze mugire isubiramwo rya seriveri yose maze muhagarike iyo seriveri. Koresha Synix ufise uburenganzira busanzwe bwa Windows. 2. Gushiraho no gushiraho impapuro z'impapuro z'impapuro Minecraft, uwutwara ibintu n'uwutwara ibintu ubwa mbere. 3. Muri Minecraft Control Center → Mods & Plugins, hitamwo Import Server Pack. Hitamwo Modrinth .mrpack canke ZIP ya seriveri yuzuye irimwo mods/plugins n'amadosiye y'ibikoresho. 4. Ama mods y'amaserveri y'amahitamwo arirengagizwa kiretse habanje guharurwa ama mods y'amaserveri y'amahitamwo. Inyandiko z'abakiriya gusa Modrinth n'izirengagiza abakiriya ntizijanwa. 5. Nusuzume ivyavuye mu gusuzuma, ibiharuro vya metadata, ibintu vyirengagijwe, n'amafayili yose yokwongerwa, agasubirizwa canke akurwaho. Wemeze gusa nimba isoko n'amahinduka bibereye. 6. Uhejeje kwinjiza, nuce utangura ku ntoke, usome ico gisomwa, hanyuma ugerageze ikoranabuhanga rihuye n'iry'uwo ukoresha.
Umudandaza w'ibidandazwa ntakorera ivyandikano vyo gutanguza bitangwa mu mugwi, gusubiriza isi, canke gusubiriza umuzi server.properties. Nimuvome impapuro zose z'umwanditsi mu gihe CurseForge ikoreshwa n'umukiriya irimwo gusa urutonde rw'ibikoresho vyo kuvoma. Kwimura ku giti cawe, ama hosts adashigikiwe, canke ivyimura bidashigikiwe bisaba ko umwanditsi ashigikira amadosiye ya seriveri; Synix ntiyirengagiza ibibujijwe n'abatanga serivisi.
Modrinth ibishirwa kuri internet birasuzumwa. Ametadata ya JAR ashigikiwe aragenzurwa kugira ngo haboneke uwupakira, ibirimwo umukiriya gusa, ID z'inyongera, hamwe n'ibimenyeshejwe ko bikurikirana ata JAR iriko irakorwa. Ibiharuro bitamenyekana hamwe n'ubwoko butandukanye bw'ibisomwa bisaba ko bisubirwamwo. Gusuzuma neza canke kutabona ibintu bivuguruzanya ntibitanga icemeza c'uko iyo moderi ata co itwaye canke ko idahuza n'izindi. Ivyandikano bitagira aho biherereye ntibikururwa mu gacerere.
Kwongera kwinjiza icupa ry'amazina amwe birashobora gukuraho JARs zayo zari zaratunganijwe kera zitakiriho, ariko igihe gusa ayo madosiye agendana na hashes zabo zanditswe. JARs n'amadosiye y'isi idatunganijwe ntizikurwaho. Amadosiye y'ibikoresho yatanzwe n'akagwi gashasha arashobora gusubirira aya kera; imbere y'uko wemeza. Gumana izina rya dosiye ya ZIP ya seriveri igihe uriko uravugurura ako gakaye kugira ngo kamenyekane ko ari ako gakaye.
UMUGAMBI W'ISI Koresha Isi kugira utange urutonde rw'isi zizwi. Import World ZIP ikora kopi y'isi imwe yo mu gisomwa gihuye n'ikindi mw isandugu nshasha ifise izina; Ntigisubiramwo isi iriho canke ngo gihindure hagati ya Java na Bedrock. Nuhitemwo isi yashizwe hamwe na Activate World kugira uhindure izina ry'urwego hamwe n'ibikoresho vy'isi ya Synix. Intango ikurikira iratwara isi yatowe. Guhindura nya mbuto biragira ico bikoze ku kuremwa kw'isi nshasha, ntibigira ico bikoze ku kibanza kiriho ubu.
GUSUBIRA Inyuma Gusubiza ibintu mu buryo birerekana impinduka zakozwe n'iki kibanza c'akazi. Gusubiza inyuma bisubirira amafayili yari yanditswe canke bikuraho amafayili yashizweho n'iryo hinduka. Niwitandukanye n'isi y'inyamahanga imbere y'uko uyihindura. Iyo dosiye ihinduwe mu nyuma, Synix iranka kuyisubiramwo; kuzigama ivyahinduwe no gukoresha backup yuzuye ikwiye nimba bikenewe.
Igisata c'ugusubiza ibintu mu buryo kirindiriye gutangura gushika igikorwa c'ugusubiza ibintu mu buryo kirangiye kandi ivyinjijwe bihuye n'amadosiye yasubiwemwo. Ibikoresho vya kera bidafise umwirondoro w'ingene biriko birakorwa bisaba gusubirizwa mu buryo bwuzuye kugira bikoreshwe igihe biriko birakora. Ubuzigamyi buguma ari ubuzigamyi bwuzuye bwa seriveri ya dosiye, butandukanye n'inyandiko z'ihindagurika ry'umuntu ku giti ciwe.
Inyuma yo gusubirana neza, inyandiko za kera z'ihindagurika ry'ikibanza c'akazi ziragaragazwa nk'izasubirijwe n'iyo backup. Izo mpapuro zirashobora kuboneka, ariko ntizishobora gusubirwamwo ngo zihuzwe n'ivyandikano vyasubiwemwo. Kwinjiza canke guhindura ibintu inyuma y'ugusubizaho biratuma haboneka inyandiko nshasha zo gusubizaho.
UBUHINGA BWO KWIYIGIZA N'UBUHINGA BWO GUSUBIRA Ubuhinga bwo gusuzuma indwara burasoma amakuru aheruka n'amakuru y'impanuka ku bibazo bikunze kwibonekeza vya Java, ukwibuka, ukwisunga, ikivuko, isi, hamwe n'ibibazo vy'umwanya. Kuba ata karorero kabonetse, ntibisigura ko iyo serveri itameze nabi. Ibikorwa vyugurura urukurikirane rw'ibikoresho; Ibipimo vya CPU na RAM ntibishobora gusubirira ibipimo vy'imbeba.
Urutonde rw'ibihe rurugurura Synix's igenamigambi ryo gusubira gutangura n'iryo kubungabunga. Nuhitemwo imisi wipfuza, isaha, ukuntu umukinyi yokwifata mu kurindira, uburyo bwo gusubiriza n'ubw'ugusubiza ibintu ku murongo, hanyuma usubiremwo wongere uzigame. Ikibanza c'akazi ntikirema uwugira kabiri canke ngo gihindure urutonde rwawe mu buryo bwikora.

data.name: Content.34AD8EEA90B225512F6F
data.value:
Hitamwo serveri ya Minecraft, uce wugurura Server Options → Minecraft Control Center. Urupapuro rwa Console n'urw'abakinyi ni rwo ruhuza ibikoresho vy'abakinyi n'ivy'abategeka. Izindi mpapuro zirimwo ivyerekeye amahinguriro, isi, ivy'inyongera, ivy'ugukingira (backups) vy'isandugu yose, ivy'ugusubiza ibintu mu buryo, ivy'ugusubiza ibintu mu buryo hamwe n'ivy'ugupima indwara.
INKURU Z'UBUTEGETSI Ama configurations ashigikiwe ashobora gukoresha console itwarwa na Synix, umuyoboro wo gucunga localhost ushigikiwe, canke RCON y'amahitamwo. Urutonde rw'ibikoresho biboneka bivana n'igisohokayandikiro be n'ukuntu umusereva yatunganijwe.
Ibaraza ry'imvukira ryihishe rishobora kugumiza inzira y'ibwirizwa yo ng'aho ikoreshwa. Mu gihe udukoresho two gucungera ibintu twabujijwe gukora, niwisuzume kugira umenye ko serveri iriko irakora be n'uko amahitamwo y'ugucungera ibintu ari ay'ukuri.
IBIKORWA BITEGUWE Mu gihe Synix ishigikiwe, iratanga amatangazo, urutonde rw'abakinyi, kugenzura, guhinduranya umurongo w'abakoresha hamwe n'abemerewe, kugenzura umwanya / ikirere, no kuzigama.
Nucagure umukinyi utegekanya hanyuma usome igikorwa imbere y'uko uvyemeza. Gutanga uruhusha rwo kwinjira ku mukinyi bituma aronka uburenganzira bukomeye bwo gukina. Ntumuhe ngo ni ukugira gusa ngo ukemure ingorane y'umuyagankuba.
IBIGENZEKO BITUMWA RAW Nukoreshe indimburo y'amajambo nk'uko vyitezwe muri ico gisomwa. Amabwirizwa nka liste na save-all ni yo yinjizwa mu rukino kandi ntasubirwamwo hamwe na interface ya Synix. Nusuzume amategeko y'urukino imbere yo kurungika itegeko rihindura isi canke uruhusha.
ABARUNDI N'AMAZINA Ikibazo kirashobora gutanga igitigiri c'abakinyi badafise urutonde rw'abakinyi. Urutonde rw'amazina atagira ico ruvuze ubwarwo ntirwerekana ko ata muntu n'umwe afitaniye isano.
Koresha igikoresho co guhagarika canke gusubiramwo ibikorwa ku mpinduka z'ubuzima bw'imashini kugira umugenzuzi amenye ko guhagarika bikorwa n'ibigirankana.
Niwaguma ufata RCON canke utundi tuntu two kugenzura ko umuti uriko uratangwa mu karere, kiretse ufise uburyo bwo kuwugenzura uvuye kure. Urwo rukino ntirusaba gushira ahabona izo mpapuro z'inzira canke uturusho.
