data.name: Content.F91F63CB8463862C6775
data.value:
SYNIX CONTROL PANEL ‡ LICENSE YIGENYE N'UBUZIMA BWO KURONDESHWA-IYO GUShobora Kuboneka
Ihindurwa ry'uruhusha 1.4 1 Munyonyo 11, 2026
Iyi ni impinduka y'uruhusha, si impinduro ya porogarama Synix. Uburenganzira bwose burasubitswe © 2026 Jason Turner. Uburenganzira bwose burabitswe. U.S. Gusaba kwandikisha uburenganzira bw'ivyandikano: Birarindiriye
Uru ruhusha rukora kuri porogaramu ya Synix Control Panel, harimwo n'ibiri muri iyo porogaramu (code source), ibidondagu vyayo (binaries), interfaces y'abakoresha (interface utilisateur), inyandiko, amasanamu, ibirango, hamwe n'ibindi bikoresho biri muri iyo porogaramu.
Ibice 13 na 14 birasigura n'imikorere y'ibanga ry'urubuga rwemewe rwa Synix, igitigiri c'ibikorwa, hamwe n'umuyobozi wa kure w'amahitamwo. Ziravuga igikorwa kiriko kirakorwa; ntibihindura uruhusha rw'umuntu ku giti ciwe, rutari urw'ubudandaji ruri aho hepfo.
1. Umutungo
Iyo porogarama irafise uruhusha, ntigurishwa.
Jason Turner arazigama uburenganzira bwose, uburenganzira bwo gutwara n'inyungu zose zijanye na porogarama, harimwo n'uburenganzira bwose bw'ivyandikano be n'ubundi burenganzira bwose mu bijanye n'ibintu vy'ubwenge. Nta burenganzira bwo kuba nyir'ico gikoresho buhabwa wewe hakurikijwe iryo tegeko.
2. Gutanga uruhusha ku rugero ruto
Ukurikije ingingo zose z'iri tegeko, uhabwa uruhusha rutoyi, rutagira aho ruhengamiye, rudashobora guhindurirwa irindi zina, rudashobora gusubirwamwo, kandi rushobora gukurwaho:
- Kuronka no gukoresha iyo porogarama ku bw'imvo zawe bwite, atari iz'ubudandaji. - Raba wongere wiyigishe ico gisomwa. - Nukore amakopi y'ivyandikano vyawe kugira ubikoreshe. - Guhindura kode y'isoko kugira uyikoreshe ku giti cawe, utagamije inyungu zawe bwite. - Gutegura no gushira mu ngiro amahinduka yawe bwite ku bikoresho ufise canke utegeka.
Uburenganzira bwose butavuzwe mu buryo butomoye muri uru ruhusha buzigamiwe n'uwabufise.
3. Amahinduka agirwa ku giti cacu
Urashobora guhindura iyo porogarama kugira ikurikize ivyo ukeneye ku giti cawe.
Ibihinduwe ku giti cawe bitegerezwa kugumizwa mw'ibanga kiretse Jason Turner aguhaye uruhusha imbere y'igihe rwo kubikwiragiza.
Ntushobora gusohora, kurungika, gusangira, gushira ahabona, gukwiragiza, canke gushira ku mugaragaro code source yahinduwe canke binaries zagiye zisanurwa nk'impinduro yihariye ya Synix.
4. Imbibe
Ntimushobora, ata ruhusha rwanditse Jason Turner yabahaye imbere y'igihe:
4.1 Ikoreshwa mu rudandazwa
- Kugurisha, kugurisha, kugurisha, guha uruhusha, gutanga uruhusha rw'inyongera, canke gutwara amahera kuri porogarama. - Kugurisha canke gukwiragiza ibitabu vya binari vyahinduwe canke bitarahinduwe. - Gukoresha porogarama canke igicapo cayo nk'igice c'igicuruzwa gitangwa ku giciro canke nk'umurimo w'ubudandaji. - Kwironkera inyungu mu buryo bugaragara canke butagaragara mu gukwiragiza, gutanga uruhusha, guhindura izina ry'urudandaza, canke gutanga uburyo bwo kuronka porogarama.
4.2 Isubirwamwo n'ukwakira abantu bose
- Kurungika, gusubiramwo, canke kwakira porogarama ku yindi mihora yo kuri Internet, mu bubiko bw'ibikoresho, mu buhinga bwo kuvoma, mu kibanza co gusangira amadosiye, canke mu bubiko bw'uduporogarama. - Gusubira gukwiragiza igicapo c'inkomoko canke ibitabu vya binari vyatunganijwe, vyaba vyahinduwe canke bitahinduwe. - Gushiraho canke gushira ahabona ivyuma bitemewe n'amategeko vy'ugushiraho ibintu, udupapuro tw'ibikoresho umuntu ashobora gutwara, ibigereranirizo, canke amazina y'ibibanza vyo kuvoma. - Gushira ahabona ivyasohowe bivuye muri porogarama canke mu makopi ya porogarama yahinduwe. - Gushikiriza iyindi nteguro y'igicapo, iyatunganijwe canke ivuye kuri yo nk'ikintu cigenga canke gihiganwa na co.
4.3 Guhindura izina n'inyito
- Gukuraho, guhisha, canke guhindura izina rya Synix, amatangazo yerekeye uburenganzira bw'ivyandikano, ivyemezo vy'uwanditse igitabu, amatangazo yerekeye uruhusha rw'ugukoresha ico gikoresho, ibirango, canke ivyemeza ko ico gikoresho ari icayo. - Guhindura izina rya porogarama canke izina ryayo kugira irekurwe ku mugaragaro canke ikwiragizwe. - Vuga ko ari wewe wakoze porogarama ya mbere. - Gukoresha izina Synix canke izina ry'iryo shirahamwe mu buryo butuma abantu biyumvira ko ari abaterankunga, abavyemera, abafatanyabikorwa, canke abafise ikibanza c'icubahiro.
4.4 Injeniyeri yo guhindukiza no gukingira Bypass
Mu buryo bushoboka bwose bwemewe n'amategeko, ntushobora guhinduranya, gutandukanya, gutandukanya canke kugerageza kurenga ibimenyeshamakuru vy'uruhusha, ivy'ugutanga uburenganzira, ivyerekeye umutekano, ivy'ugusuzuma ko ibintu vyavuguruwe, canke ivyerekeranye n'izina ry'igicapo biri mu butumwa bwemewe.
Iryo tegeko ntiribangamira uburenganzira ubwo ari bwo bwose bushobora gutangwa n'itegeko rikurikizwa.
5. GitHub Amashami n'intererano
Ububiko bwemewe bwa Synix bushobora kuboneka ku mugaragaro kuri GitHub. Urubuga rwa GitHub rushobora kwemerera abakoresha kurabira hamwe no gutandukanya ububiko bwa bose biciye ku bikorwa vyinjijwe muri GitHub.
GitHub fork ntiguha uburenganzira bwo:
- Gushira ahabona ikinyamakuru kitemewe ca Synix. - Gukwiragiza ibiharuro vy'ibiri vyahinduwe canke bitarahinduwe. - Guhindura izina Synix. - Koresha urubuga rw'abantu bose canke icirore. - Nushikirize ako gafuruka nk'imashini yawe bwite. - Gukwiragiza neza porogarama hanze y'ubuzi budafise aho bugarukira bwatanzwe na GitHub.
GitHub forks zishobora gukoreshwa gusa mu gusuzuma code, gutegura intererano, canke gutanga ubusabe bwo gukura ku bubiko bwemewe bwa Synix. Amahinduka y'umuntu ku giti ciwe atariko arashikirizwa nk'intererano ategerezwa kuguma ari ay'ahantu hamwe n'ay'ibanga.
Mu gushikiriza code source, documentation, artwork, canke ubundi bufasha ku bubiko bwemewe bwa Synix, werekana ko ufise uburenganzira bwo kubushikiriza no guha Jason Turner uruhusha rw'igihe cose, kw'isi yose, rudasobeka, rudashobora gusubirwamwo, rutariho amatagisi yo gukoresha, gusubiramwo, guhindura, gutangaza, gukwiragiza, gutanga uruhusha rusangi, no kwinjiza ubwo bufasha muri Synix.
6. Synix Izina n'ikimenyetso
Izina rya Synix, ikirango cayo, isura yayo, hamwe n'amazina y'ikirango afitaniye isano n'iryo zina, biguma ari ivya Jason Turner.
Nta ruhusha rw'ikimenyetso c'urudandazwa canke urudandazwa rutangwa n'iri tegeko-shingiro, kiretse kwerekana izina rya Synix ritarahinduwe hamwe n'izina ry'urudandazwa mu gihe umuntu ariko arakoresha porogarama.
Gukoresha izina Synix ata ruhusha bishobora gutuma umuntu arenga ku mategeko agenga uburenganzira bw'abahinguzi, ayerekeye ibimenyetso vy'urudandazwa, ayerekeye uguhiganwa mu buryo butabereye canke ayandi mategeko.
7. Gushiraho
Uburenganzira uhabwa n'iri tegeko buca buhagarara igihe urenze ku ngingo iyo ari yo yose iri muri iryo tegeko.
Inyuma yo guhagarika, utegerezwa:
- Reka gukoresha no guhindura iyo porogarama. - Reka gukwiragiza canke kwerekana impapuro ata ruhusha. - Kuraho amakopi y'abantu bose atabifitiye uruhusha, ivyasohowe, ivyerekanywe canke ivyakuwe ku rubuga mu buryo utegeka. - Gusiba amakopi yawe bwite igihe amategeko abisavye.
Ibice bivuga ibijanye n'ubunyangamugayo, ivyo umuntu yemerewe gukora, intererano, ukwirengagizwa kw'ibanga be n'ugushira mu ngiro amategeko birabandanya kubaho igihe igikorwa kirangiye.
8. Gushira mu ngiro
Uwufise uburenganzira bw'ivyandikano arashobora gukurikirana uburyo bwose bwo kurenganura bushoboka hisunzwe amategeko akoreshwa ku bijanye n'ugusubiramwo ata ruhusha, gukwiragiza, gushira ahabona ku mugaragaro, kugurisha, guhindura izina ry'urudandazwa, canke ubundi bugizi bwa nabi.
Uburyo bwo kurenganura bushobora kuba burimwo ugusaba gukurwaho, uburyo bwo gukuraho urubuga, ugutanga injunctive relief, ugutanga indishi y'akababaro hamwe n'ubundi buryo bwo kurenganura mu vy'amategeko igihe bibereye mu mategeko.
Nta kintu na kimwe kiri muri uru ruhusha cemeza ko hari ingingo kanaka y'ugushira mu ngiro canke uburyo bwo gukosora izoba iriho mu bihugu vyose.
9. Kudahana no kugabanya ibanga
UBUHINGA BURANGURWA uko buri be n'ukuntu bushobora kuboneka, hatabanje gutangwa ivyemeza vy'ubwoko ubwo ari bwo bwose, vyaba ivyerekanwa canke ivyumvikanyweko, ushizemwo ivyemeza vy'uko bugurishwa, ko bukoreshwa ku bw'intumbero idasanzwe, ko bufise izina ry'urudandazwa be n'uko ata kintu na kimwe canduye.
Gushika ku rugero rusumba urundi rwemewe n'amategeko, JASON TURNER NTAZOBA ARIYEMERWA INZAMBA ZIVUTSE, IZITARI IZUTSE, IZISANGANYE, IZIDasanzwe, IZIKOMOKOJE canke IZITARIZANYE, CANKA KUBURA IBIKORWA VYO KURONDA AMAKURU, IBINJURU, INTUNGURAMIZI, IBIGUMBO VYO KURI SERVER, IMIKINO Z'imikino, UMUGENZI, CANKE UKURONDA KURONDA IBIGUMBO biva kuri SOFTWARE canke ku kuntu ikoreshwa.
Wewe ubwawe ni wewe ubazwa ivy'ugukoresha ubuhinga bwo kuzigama (backup) no kuraba ko ubwo buhinga bukora neza ku buryo bushobora gukoreshwa n'imashini yawe be n'abakinyi b'udukino.
10. Ibikoresho vy'Abandi
Ibikoresho vy'ubuhinga bwa none, ububiko bw'ibitabu, amadosiye y'abakinyi b'inkino, ibihimba vya SteamCMD, ibirango n'ibindi bikoresho biva ku bandi bantu ni ivya benevyo kandi biguma bigengwa n'impapuro z'uruhusha be n'amabwirizwa yavyo.
Uru ruhusha rukora gusa ku bice vya Synix bifitaniye isano na Jason Turner.
11. Uruhusha rwanditse
Ivyirenga kuri urwo ruhusha birafise agaciro igihe gusa vyatanzwe mu nyandiko na Jason Turner.
Ibibazo canke ugusaba uruhusha bikwiye gutangwa hakoreshejwe ububiko bw'amakuru bwa Synix GitHub canke ubundi buryo bwo guhanahana amakuru na Synix.
12. Ibikoresho vyemewe vyo kuvoma
Kuronka Synix biciye gusa ku masoko yemewe:
- https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/releases - https://synix.info
Amakopi yatanzwe n'izindi mbuga ntiyemerwa na Jason Turner kandi ashobora kuba adakingiwe neza, ahinduwe, atagihuje n'igihe, canke arimwo porogarama idakenewe. Umutekano wabo be n'uko ari ivy'ukuri ntibitangwa na Jason Turner.
Gushira Synix ku rutonde, guhuza na GitHub, canke gutanga uburyo bwo kuyikura kuri internet ntibitanga uburenganzira canke ngo bisigure ko uhawe uruhusha, ko ufitaniye isano na yo, ko uyishigikiye, canke ko uri umutegetsi. Synix iguma ari itunga rya Jason Turner.
Kugira ngo umuntu ashobore gucungera, gusubiramwo, guserukira abandi, guhinduranya canke gupfunya ivyo yavomye bisaba ko abanza kuronka uruhusha rwanditse. Gushiraho umurongo werekeza ku gisata ca leta ntibitanga ubwo burenganzira.
Igice ca 4.2 ntigikumira amahuza asanzwe y'ukuri kuri ayo masoko yemewe yerekana neza ko Synix na Jason Turner ari abayo. Ubwo bucuti ntibutuma uwo muhora uba icitwazo.
Igikoresho ca WinGet ubidzz.Synix ni uburyo bwemewe bwo kwinjiza igihe gikura ivyuma vy'ukwinjiza bitahinduwe mu buryo butaziguye ku mpapuro z'icegeranyo za GitHub. Ibi ntibirekurira umuntu wa gatatu kubikoresha canke kubisubiramwo.
13. Ibikorwa vy'Ubuzima n'Ibanga
Synix irimwo uburyo bwo guharura ibikorwa mu buryo bw'amajwi (optional live activity counter) buharura igitigiri c'ibiganiro vya Synix biriko birakorwa kuri https://synix.info. Urashobora kuwuzimya igihe ico ari co cose muri Settings > Privacy & Security > Share active count utarinze kugabanya ibindi bintu vya Synix. Ivyipfuzo vyawe vy'ivya kera birubahirizwa.
Mu gihe Synix ifashwe, irungika ikimenyetso c'uko HTTPS iri kuri https://synix.info/api/presence igihe itanguye gukora n'inyuma y'iminota nka yose 10 mu gihe iyo porogaramu iriko irakoreshwa, harimwo no mu nyuma. Ikimenyetso kirimwo kode y'umwanya w'akaruhuko n'indangamuntu ya Synix ikoreshwa, ata mubiri w'ubutumwa. Iyo kode y'ikiganiro igumizwa mu bwenge gusa kandi isubirizwa igihe ikiganiro gishasha co gutanga raporo gitanguye; si indangamuntu ihoraho y'igikoresho.
Ico gitigiri ntikirungika izina ryawe, aderese ya e-mail, ijambo ry'ibanga, amakuru ya serveri canke y'umukinyi, agaciro k'itunganywa, amadosiye, canke ivyerekana imashini.
Kuri buri kiringo c'ikiganiro, agapima k'urubuga kazigama gusa urutonde rw'ibiri muri ico kiganiro be n'igihe ca nyuma c'ikiganiro. Urubuga rwa internet rw'abantu bose rwerekana gusa igitigiri c'ibihe vy'ibikorwa vyose, ni ukuvuga igitigiri kigereranywa aho kuba igitigiri c'abantu badasanzwe. Ikiganiro gihagarara guharura inyuma y'iminota 15 ata kimenyetso. Inyandiko z'ibiharuro zidakora zirashobora gusukurwa inyuma y'iminota 30 kandi zirakurwaho igihe ibisabwa vyo guharura bikurikiye gusukura. Synix ntishira isano hagati y'ivyo vyandikano vy'ibiharuro n'amakonte y'abayobozi ba kure canke indangamuntu za mudasobwa zifatanijwe.
Kuzimya ico gikoresho birahagarika ibindi bimenyetso vy'ukuhaba kandi bigatuma umuntu asabwa gukora uko ashoboye kwose kugira ngo akureho ikiganiro kiriko kiraba. Gufunga Synix na vyo nyene bigerageza gukuraho; mu gihe gukuraho bidashobora gushika ku rubuga, ikiringo gihagarikwa guharurwa mu buryo bwikora inyuma y'ikiringo c'ukutagira ibikorwa.
Nk'uko bigenda ku mihora yose ya internet, serivisi zo kwakira urubuga ziraronka amakuru asanzwe ajanye n'umuyagankuba, nk'inyishu y'ubutumire bwa IP hamwe n'umwanya w'ibisabwa, kandi zirashobora kubikora canke kuvyandika hakurikijwe amategeko y'ibanga ryazo. Ayo makuru ntashirwa mu gisata co guharura ibikorwa ca Synix canke ngo yerekanwe mu biharuro vy'abantu bose.
14. Umutekano be n'ibanga vy'ukwinjira kure
14.1 Uburyo bwo kwugurura n'ukudandaza amakuru
Ubuyobozi bwa kure kuri https://manager.synix.info si ngombwa kandi ntibushobora gukoreshwa gushika ushize hamwe mudasobwa hanyuma ukemeza konte isaba muri porogaramu ya Synix kuri iyo mudasobwa. Urashobora gukoresha Synix mu karere udafise konti y'umuyobozi. Ibara ry'ibikorwa vy'abanyagihugu ritandukanye kandi rishobora guhagarikwa ukwaryo.
Synix ntigurisha, ngo ikodeshe, ngo igurishe, canke ngo ihishure amakuru yerekeye konti yawe, amakuru yerekeye mudasobwa zisanzwe, ibikorwa vya kure, canke amakuru yerekeye seriveri ku bamenyeshamakuru canke ku badandaza b'amakuru. Synix ntikoresha ayo makuru mu kwamamaza ku bantu canke ngo ikore amasanamu y'abamamaza. Ayo makuru akoreshwa kugira ngo utange ibintu uhisemwo, wemeze ko ari vyo, ukoreshe uwo muhora, wongere uwukingire ibitagenze neza.
Uburyo bwo gushikayo uvuye kure si uburyo bwo kubika amakuru butagira aho bugarukira. Ikeneye konti ifise akarimbi, guhuza, ibikorwa, n'amakuru y'umutekano adondorwa aha hepfo. Izo nyandiko ntizishirwa mu gitabu c'ibikorwa vy'abanyagihugu canke ngo zishirwe ku zindi konti z'abajejwe ibikorwa biciye muri iyo serivisi.
14.2 Ibisigaye kuri Orudinateri yawe
Synix ntiyiyandikishiriza mu buryo bw'imashini amazina y'abakinyi, amasanamu ya seriveri y'umukino, ibiri muri dosiye yo gushiraho, ibiri mu bubiko bw'ibikoresho vyo gusubiriza (backup-archive contents), ibivuye ku gikoresho c'umukino, canke amazina y'ibanga ya seriveri y'umukino. Gukora backup kure no kugarura run kuri mudasobwa ifatanye; Amadosiye yo gusubiriza aguma mu bibanza vyashiriweho aho hantu. Igihe uhisemwo kwandika itegeko ryo gukoresha ku gikoresho co gukinirako kuri uwo muhora, ico gisomwa kiraheza kigasubirwamwo maze kigashikirizwa iyo orodinateri iri kumwe n'uwo muhora, ushizemwo n'ibiri muri ico gisomwa vyanditse mu buryo bworoshe gutahura. Umuyobozi si ububiko bwo kuzigama igicu kandi ntatanga desktop ya kure itagira imipaka, Windows command-prompt access, canke kuraba muri rusange dosiye.
Synix igumana impagararo zaho, urutonde rw'amaserveri, kahise, gusubiriza, hamwe n'uburyo bwo guhuza kuri mudasobwa yawe. Urufunguruzo rw'ugushirako umukono rw'imashini y'imashini iguma mu bubiko bw'urufunguruzo Windows. Synix ihitamwo ububiko bwashigikiwe na TPM igihe bihari kandi ubundi burashigikira urupfunguruzo rwa porogaramu rukingiwe na Windows, harimwo no kuri VMs zihuye. Kuba TPM ishobora kuboneka ntibitanga icemeza c'uko iyo orodinateri idashobora kwononekara.
Ayo majambo arasigura Synix kugenzura kure. Imikino, Steam, mods, Discord integrated, exports, na support reports uhitamwo gusangira bifise data flow yazo. Ntimushire amajambo y'ibanga canke ayandi makuru ateye akaga mu mazina ya orodinateri, amazina y'amaserveri, canke amazina y'amadosiye yo gusubiriza, kubera ko ayo mazina ashobora kuboneka muri iyo porogarama.
14.3 Amakuru umuyobozi atunganya kandi abika
- Izina ry'umukoresha wahisemwo, umwirondoro w'ikonte, igihe c'iremwa, ivyo ukunda mu bijanye n'umutekano, akabanga k'ijambo ry'ibanga gakoreshejwe umunyu, ibanga rya authenticator rikingiwe igihe ryemerewe, impapuro z'uruhusha zo kwinjira ku mugaragaro igihe ryemerewe, hamwe n'inyandiko z'igihe gito zo kwemeza/kwitaba. Amajambo y'ibanga n'amakarata yo kugenzura arakoreshwa mu gusuzuma ingene umuntu yinjiye; amajambo y'ibanga adahinduka ntiyabikwa nk'inyandiko ishobora gusomwa. Synix ntiyakira urutoke rwawe, ishusho y'isura yawe, urupfunguruzo rw'ibanga canke urupfunguruzo rwo gusinya rw'ibanga rw'imashini ifitaniye isano. Kwandikishwa ntibisaba izina nyakuri canke aderese ya e-mail. - Gushira hamwe no guhuza: Ikidodo ca mudasobwa uhitamwo, akamenyetso k'igikoresho kitagenewe, urupfunguruzo rusangi rw'ugushirako umukono, isano y'ikonte, ubwoko bw'uwatanze urufunguzo rwamenyeshejwe, uko ugushira hamwe kwemezwa, n'umwanya wa nyuma wo guhuza. Ubuhinga bwo guhanahana amakuru buciye bugufi bushobora kuguma bwuguruye mu gihe Synix iriko irakoreshwa kugira ngo urubuga rushobore gukangura ako kanya iyo porogaramu yashizwe hamwe. Urwo rukurikirane rurimwo amakuru yo kuvyura/guhagarika guhanahana amakuru be n'amakuru yerekeye uguhanahana amakuru, ntirurimwo amadosiye y'urukino canke amasanamu ya servere. - Uko ibintu vyifashe: Ibiharuro vy'abakinyi, amazina y'abakinyi, amazina y'udukino, uko ibintu bimeze, igitigiri c'abakinyi, umwanya w'akazi, ibikorwa bihari, igihe ca nyuma co gusubiriza/ukuntu ibintu vyifashe, ibiharuro vya CPU na RAM bivuye ku bikoresho vyo kuri seriveri y'umukino (harimwo n'ibikoresho vy'ugutanguza n'abakozi babikurikirana), hamwe n'ibiharuro vy'imashini yose CPU, ikoreshwa/igitigiri cose ca RAM, hamwe n'ibiciro vyo kurungika/kwakira. Ibiciro vy'umurongo wa mudasobwa birimwo uruja n'uruza rwa LAN ku mashini zikoresha uburyo bwo guhanahana amakuru; Ibiharuro vy'indangamuntu, aderese za IP, ibiri mu bipfunyika hamwe n'ahantu ho gutembera ntibirungikwa hamwe n'ivyo bisomwa. Iyo porogarama irarungika izo ncamake mu gihe uburyo bwo kwemeza ko umuntu ari umuhagarikizi bukora. CPU/RAM updates cover paired computers; amakuru y'ido n'ido yerekeye serveri yerekeye orodinateri yatowe. Amavugurura asanzwe akora buri masegonda 10 hanyuma agahagarara nyuma yo gufunga, guhagarika, guhera, canke guhishwa nkuko bikwiye. Ibindi biganiro vy'uruja n'uruza bikora birashobora kuguma bikoresha uburyo bwavyo bwo kuraba ibintu. - Ibikorwa vyasabwe hamwe n'amasanamu y'isubiramwo: Ivyerekana umusuku/igikorwa, igihe c'ibisabwa, iterambere/ivyavuyemwo, hamwe n'igihe usaba amahitamwo y'isubiramwo, ivyerekana isubiramwo, amazina y'amadosiye, amatariki, ubunini be n'amazina y'ubuziranenge. Ibiri muri backup hamwe n'inzira zisanzwe ntizirungikwa kuri iki gikoresho. - Amabwirizwa y'urukino: Urupapuro rwerekana ko uriko urakinisha urukino, uruhusha rwo kwugurura urwo rukino rw'igihe gito, be n'amajambo y'ibwirizwa wandika. Igisomwa kikirindiriye gica gikwiragizwa mu bubiko bw'amakuru bwa serivisi kandi kigacibwa muri ubwo buhinga igihe hatanzwe uruhusha. Ntigushirwa mu rutonde rw'ibikorwa biheruka canke mu nyandiko zerekeye amakonte. Ingaruka z'ugutanga ubutumwa zisigura ko ubutumwa bwatanzwe ku mukino, ntibisigura ko umukino wabwakiriye canke wabwujuje. Inyishu z'urukino hamwe n'igiti c'imikorere yo mu karere ntizirungikwa. - Umutekano n'ugukinga ikoreshwa nabi ry'ubuhinga: Ubwoko bw'abadashoboye kwinjira, igitigiri c'abagerageje kwinjira hamwe n'ibihe vyabo, ubwoko bw'ivyabaye mu bijanye n'ugusubiza ibintu mu buryo canke umutekano hamwe n'indangagaciro zikenewe kuri orodinateri. Inyandiko z'igihe gito zijanye n'urugero rw'ibiciro zishobora gukoresha hashes zifise impfunguruzo z'imihora IP hamwe n'ibiranga konti. Inyandiko z'amakuru y'amakonte ya Synix ntizirimwo amayeri yo gukoresha ijambo ry'ibanga, amakarata yo kugenzura, aderese za IP zidakoreshejwe, canke ibimenyetso vy'urubuga. Abatanga serivisi zo kwakira amakuru barashobora gutunganya umwirondoro w'umuhuza mu buryo butandukanye nk'uko bisigurwa mu ngingo ya 14.6.
Urubuga ngurukanabumenyi ruratunganya neza ibishushanyo vyemewe n'amabwirizwa kugira ngo rutange ubuyobozi bwa kure. HTTPS hamwe n'imiyoboro yo guhererekanya amakuru ikoresheje ubuhinga bwa none, bikingira uruja n'uruza rw'abantu; ibi sivyo kuvuga ko serivisi yo kwakira idashobora gutunganya amakuru.
14.4 Kubika no gusiba
- Amakuru y'ikonte be n'ibintu vyashizweho birabandanya gushika iyo konte ivuyeho. Ivyandikano vy'uguteranya vyemejwe bigumaho gushika iyo orodinateri itunganijwe canke iyo konti ivuyeho. - Amashusho y'ukuntu ibintu vyifashe hamwe n'ibiharuro vya CPU/RAM birasubirizwa n'ibiharuro bishasha maze bigashobora gukosorwa inyuma y'iminota ya 15 ata bindi bisubirijwe. Umwanya wa nyuma wo guhuza uguma ari igice c'inyandiko y'uguteranya. - Inyandiko zijanye n'ubuyobozi bwa kure, ivyavuyemwo, hamwe na metadata y'amahitamwo yo gusubiramwo irungikwa bica biba ibisabwa kugira bisukure inyuma y'amasaha 24. - Amabwirizwa y'urukino ategerezwa kurangira inyuma y'amasegonda 30. Igisomwa kitarungikwa kirashobora guhanagurwa igihe kirangiye canke igihe gihagaritswe; ugutanga ivyangombwa vyemejwe bica bihera ubwo nyene. Imfashanyo z'ivyuma bitanga amakuru zirarangira mu minota itatu. Ikiranga igikorwa hamwe n'ivyavuye mu gutanga biguma bikurikira amasaha 24 y'igihe co kwandika igikorwa. - Ivyashitse mu bijanye n'ugusubiza ibintu mu buryo/umutekano hamwe n'ivyagiye vyarananiwe mu kwinjiza amakuru birashobora gukosorwa inyuma y'imisi 90. Abadashoboye kwinjira bagumana imigwi ya 100 iheruka; utunenge two guhuza mu kiringo c'iminota 10 dushirwa hamwe. - Ikiringo co kurondera amakuru muri internet kirangira inyuma y'iminota 30 ata wusavye canke amasaha 8. Kugerageza kwemeza birarangira inyuma y'iminota 5; gusubiramwo ijambo ry'ibanga ry'agateganyo birarangira mu minota 10 kandi bikoreshwa rimwe gusa. Inyandiko zijanye n'ugusuzuma, gusubiramwo, gukingira gusubirwamwo, hamwe n'urugero rw'ibipimo vy'ibiciro zirakurwaho mu gihe c'isuku. Inyandiko z'amakonte zitari zuzuye zirashobora gukurwaho inyuma y'amasaha 24.
Igihe ikiringo kirangiye, uruhusha ruca rurahagarara n'imbere y'uko icegeranyo gikurwaho. Gusanura urutonde rw'ibisata vy'ubuhinga birakorwa mu gihe c'ibisabwa mu nyuma, incuro imwe mu minota 10 ku gusukura umuyobozi, rero ibiringo biri hejuru ni ibiringo vyo guhera canke gusukura-vyemerewe aho kuba amasezerano yo guhanagura ku mwanya ntabanduka. Ibinyamakuru vy'abatanga amakuru be n'amakopi y'ububiko birafise ubuzima butandukanye.
Unpairing ikuraho gukoraniriza hamwe kwatoranijwe hamwe n'inyandiko za kure zijanye na vyo mu bubiko bw'amakuru y'ibikorwa. Amateka y'ugusubiza hamwe/agakingirizo ashobora kuguma kuri konti muri ico kiringo cavuzwe haruguru. Gusiba konti y'umuhagarikizi bivanaho amakuru yayo, guhuza, amafoto, amategeko, hamwe n'inyandiko z'umutekano/gusubiza konti mu bubiko bw'ibikorwa. Ntirufuta ama serveri y'urukino rwawe, isi, impagararo canke amadosiye yo gusubiriza. Inyandiko z'igihe gito zijanye n'ukwirinda ikoreshwa nabi hamwe n'ivyandikano canke ibisigarira vy'ibintu bitunganijwe n'abatanga izo mfashanyo ntizica zihita zihanagurwa.
14.5 Ubugenzuzi bwawe n'ugukingira kwinjira
Kwinjira bisaba ijambo ry'ibanga ryawe hamwe n'urufunguzo rw'ibanga canke icemeza, nka Google Authenticator. Amakarata atunganijwe mu buryo bwo gusaba ubwo buryo bwompi arazigama ivyo bisabwa vyompi. Guhindura ijambo ry'ibanga, gutandukanya mudasobwa ukoresheje urubuga, no gusiba konti y'umuyobozi bisaba kwemeza bushasha iryo hinduka ridasanzwe.
Kwugurura uburyo bw'ukwinjira mu gikoresho c'urukino bisaba n'ijambo ry'ibanga ry'ikonte iriko ikoreshwa hamwe n'ugusuzumwa gushasha hakurikijwe uburyo bukenewe bw'ikonte. Kwemererwa gukoreshwa bivana n'ikibanza kimwe c'urubuga, orodinateri ifitaniye imigenderanire n'uwundi muntu, iserveri ibitswe hamwe n'urukino ruriko rurakinwa mu mwanya ungana n'iminota itatu. Guhagarika, gusubira gutangura, gufunga console, guhagarika gushiraho console canke kubura igikorwa bibuza ibwirizwa ry'inyongera. Guhagarika canke guhisha agapapuro k'umuyobozi bituma ako gapapuro katemerwa. Ibikoresho bisanzwe bikoreshwa mu gukorana n'abaserukira abandi biracagumana ivyo bisabwa kugira umuntu yinjire. Imigenderanire yo kwinjira mu mukino gusa niyo yemewe; indangamuntu idasanzwe yonyene ntiyemerera kwandika muri command prompt Windows.
Orodinateri ya mbere yemewe ishobora gutanga ijambo ry'ibanga ry'agateganyo mu gihe wibagiye ijambo ry'ibanga ry'urubuga rwawe. Ntashobora guhitamwo iyindi nkuru. Ijambo ry'ibanga ry'imfatakibanza ntirikuraho canke ngo rikureho ibisabwa vy'urufunguzo rw'ibanga/rw'uguhinyanyura, kandi utegerezwa guhitamwo ijambo ry'ibanga rishasha imbere yo kwinjira muri manager. Gusubiza ibintu mu buryo birasesa ibindi biganiro vyawe.
Umuyobozi wa Synix agumana ikimenyetso cayo co kwinjira muri browser mu bwenge bw'akaburimbo, atari mu makuki, mu bubiko bwaho canke mu bubiko bw'ikiganiro. Guhindura canke gufunga agapapuro biratuma utaronka ako karusho. Ibi ntibibuza browser yawe canke umuyobozi w'ijambo ry'ibanga kuzigama ibimenyetso nimba ubishaka, kandi ntibisigura cookies zashizwe ukwabo n'abatanga serivisi zo kwakira/iz'umutekano canke serivisi yo guhindura urubuga rwa bose.
Urashobora gusohoka, guhagarika ivyo ukoresha vyose, canke gutandukanya orodinateri n'izindi. Ubuhinga bwa Synix bwo ng'aho bushobora guhagarika no gufuta umurongo wa kure ata muntu yinjiye kuri urwo rubuga. Mu gihe atari ku muyoboro wa interineti, irahagarika gukoresha urubuga rwa kure kandi ikongera kugerageza gukuraho urubuga igihe hari umurongo uboneka. Ugusubira gutangura porogaramu canke Windows ntibikuraho mu buryo bw'imikorere ugusubiranamwo kwaciwe. Hariho uburyo bwo gukoreshwa mu karere gusa.
14.6 Ubuhinga bwo kwinjiza amakuru, imbuga abantu bose bashobora kwugurura be n'uturimbi tw'umutekano
Urubuga ngurukanabumenyi rukoresha OpenAI's Sites hosting na Cloudflare services mu gutanga, kubika, gucungera umutekano, no gukwirakwiza amakuru. Aba batanga izo serivisi bakoresha amakuru akenewe kugira bashobore gutanga izo serivisi kandi bashobora kuronka aderese za IP, imitwe y'ibisabwa, amasaha, n'ayandi makuru yerekeye uguhuza, canke bagumana inyandiko zabo bwite z'ibikorwa hamwe n'amakopi yo gusubiriza. Amategeko y'ibanga yabo arafata ku buryo bakorwako: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/ na https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/.
Guhindura mu buryo bw'imashini urupapuro rusangi hamwe n'ukurungika GitHub birimwo ababitanga. Umuyobozi yigenga atandukanijwe n'impapuro za bose kandi ntatwara umuhora wa bose w'ubuhinduzi canke inyandiko z'amatangazo. Synix ntivuga ko iyo umuntu asuye urubuga urwo ari rwo rwose, ata cookies, canke amakuru abikwa. Amakuru arashobora kandi guhishurwa mu gihe bisabwa n'amategeko; Ikiringo c'ukudandaza cavuzwe aho haruguru nticubuza ko habaho ubwikorezi bukenewe canke guhishurirwa mu buryo bwemewe.
Synix ikoresha authenticated pairing, gusinyira computer requests, encrypted network connections, account access checks, hamwe na short-lived approvals kugirango igabanye access itabifitiye uburenganzira. Izo nzirakarengane ntizituma umuntu ashobora kuronka amakuru biciye ku buhinga bwa none ata ngorane canke ngo zimukingire ibitero vyose, orodinateri canke ubuhinga bwo kurondera amakuru bwinjiye mu muntu, uburyo bwo kugenzura bwibwe, canke igikorwa canduye. Gumana Synix na Windows zigezweho, ukingire konti yawe n'uburyo bwo kugenzura, kandi wemere gusa mudasobwa n'amakonte ugenzura.
Iri tangazo riri ku mugaragaro kuri https://synix.info/license/ kandi ryarashizwe mu kigo c'imfashanyo ca porogaramu n'ikibanza co gushiraho. Ibibazo bijanye n'ibanga birashobora guhagurukirwa biciye mu buryo bwemewe bwo gushigikira kuri https://synix.info/support/. Ntimushire amajambo y'ibanga, amakarata y'ugusubiza ibintu mu buryo canke ayandi makuru yerekeye konti y'umuntu ku mugaragaro mu butumwa bwo gushigikira. Ibivuguruwe muri iri tangazo bifise igihe gishasha n'igenekerezo rishasha.

data.name: Content.3EDF002B53C15DD7A21D
data.value:
Fungura Settings → Report a Problem kugira utegure raporo, canke ukoreshe ibibanza vyemewe vyo gufashamwo biri hepfo.
GUSUBIRA IKI KINTU KU NGENZI Nushiremwo uburyo bwo kwinjiza, impinduro za Synix na Windows uriko urakoresha, urukino/umwirondoro, hamwe n'amakuru yerekeye isohorwa/inyandiko yo gupakira.
Sigura: • Ivyo wahinduye canke wagize ico uhinduye. • Ivyo wari witeze n'ivyabaye. • Ikosa ry'ukuri be n'agace gatoyi kavuye mu gitabu kijanye n'ico gihe. • Nimba iyo ntunganyo yakora imbere y'aho be n'ibyahindutse.
GUSUBIRA MU MUSI Imbere yo gusangira Niwikureko ijambo ry'ibanga, ibimenyetso, URL z'urubuga, inzira zawe bwite, n'amakuru y'umurongo udashaka ko ashirwa ahabona. Uburyo bw'ibanga ntibukuraho amadosiye yose yashizwe. Nturungike impapuro z'ingene ibintu vyagiye biragenda canke ingene urukino rwagenze utarinze kuzisuzuma.
Ku kibazo c'ubuhinduzi, shiramwo ururimi rwatowe, izina ry'idirisha, n'amajambo nyayo aboneka. Ku kibazo c'ingene urukino rwosobanurwa, nushiremwo urutonde rw'ukuntu urwo rukino rwoshirwako be n'ibitabu bijanye na rwo.
IBIKORWA VYO KU MUSHINGA Amaraporo y'ivyatanzwe: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/issues
Umuryango Discord: https://discord.gg/WduKEU3j8s
Ububiko bw'imigambi: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel
Gushiraho canke kwubaka porogaramu neza ntibishobora kugerageza umukino wose, mod, n'ibidukikije vy'umurongo. Intambuko zo gusubiramwo neza zirafasha gutandukanya ikibazo ca Synix n'ikibazo c'urukino canke ic'ugushiraho umuhora.

data.name: Content.3FCD178C083A4D548FE7
data.value:
Fyonda ku murongo wa seriveri imbere y'uko ukoresha ivyuma vyo ku ruhande rwo hasi. Urutonde rwatowe ni rwo rwerekana serveri igikorwa gifatiyeko.
NURONDERE SERVER Koresha uruzitiro rwo kurondera kugira ngo uce urutonde ukurikije izina ry'umukino canke iry'umukozi. Urutonde rwerekana ingene ibintu vyifashe rurongerekana. Nimba hari icanditswe gisa n'icatakaye, nuce usukura ivyo bisakuzo vyompi imbere yo kwiyumvira ko caciwe.
Soma incamake • Servers Installed iraharura ivyanditse kuri serveri. • "Running Now" yerekana ivyandikwa vyamenyeshejwe ko biriko birakorwa. • CPU Usage na RAM Usage bisigura PC yose, si Synix gusa. • Amakuru y'abakinyi araboneka igihe gusa urukino rwatowe rwerekana isoko ishigikiwe.
GUSUBIRA KU MUSI ku musi • Gutangura, Guhagarika, no Gusubira gutangura gucunga seriveri yatoranijwe. • Configure yugurura ibibanza vyo gushiraho. • Kwitegura kuraba ibintu bishobora gutuma idakora. • Amahitamwo y'amasereri arimwo ibikoresho vy'ivy'amadosiye, ivy'ugutunganya ibintu, ivy'uguhuza ibintu be n'ivy'udukino. • Kanda incuro zibiri ku murongo kugira usuzume uwo mushakashatsi mu ncamake.
Igisata c'ivyigwa n'ibiharuro kirerekana ingene ibintu biriko biragenda hamwe n'imburizi zijanye n'ico kibazo. Soma ubutumwa bwa nyuma imbere yo gusubiramwo igikorwa. CLEAR isukura ikibanza c'ibikorwa biboneka; si itegeko ryo guhanagura amadosiye yose y'ibiharuro.
Si ngombwa ngo igikorwa kiriko kirakorwa kibe categuwe ku bw'abakinyi. Gushiraho, kwinjiza isi, amasezerano, hamwe no gushiraho umukino birashobora kubandanya inyuma yuko igikorwa gisohotse. Mwereke ko witeguye mu kwandika mu rutonde rw'abakinyi be no mu kwifatanya na bo.

data.name: Content.3FDD32467F5AC4908CBA
data.value:
Fungura Server Options → Mod & Plugin Manager kugira ubone umwirondoro ushigikiwe. Synix irabona ibintu vyashizweko hamwe n'ahantu hemewe; si igitabu kirimwo amazina yose y'imigenzo.
NIMWISUZUME UBUHUNGU BWO MU KINTU 1. Gufungura isi, ivyongeweko biriho, hamwe n'uburyo bwakozwe. 2. Guhagarika seriveri biciye kuri Synix no kurindira ko umugwi wayo w'ibikorwa usohoka. 3. Nusuzume uburyo bwo kwongeramwo bwabonetse, ahantu ho kwinjiza, n'urutonde rw'umutekano. 4. Hitamwo Install From File canke Import Package ku mpapuro zishigikiwe, ZIP, canke ububiko bwa mod yose. Amahitamwo ashobora gutangwa bivana n'uburyo bw'ugukina. 5. Nusuzume aho ugiye, ivyavuye mu gusuzuma, imburi n'ivyemeza. 6. Tureke ibikorwa vyo gutunganya, gusubiramwo no gushiraho ivyo bikoresho birangire. 7. Synix isubiramwo urutonde igihe ishirwaho rirangiye. Nibiba ngombwa, nuce usubira gutangura, uce uraba mu rutonde rw'abakinyi be n'umuhuza w'abakiriya.
Urutonde rwerekana akarere k'ugushiraho katoranijwe. Ukoresheje ubuhinga bwo kurondera, urashobora kurondera ivyongeweko bivanye n'izina ryavyo, ubwoko bwavyo, aho biva canke inzira bicamwo. Gusubiza amaso inyuma ku vyo wahisemwo kandi ugasigara ufise ico wahisemwo igihe kikiriho. Uburyo bworoshe bwo kuraba burakinga utuntu tumwetumwe mu bijanye n'ubuhinga, ariko ntibutuma umuntu asuzuma ivyo bintu.
Nugumize ako kadirisha gakinguye igihe bariko barasuzuma canke bahindura ibintu. Synix irahagarika ibikorwa bivuguruzanya gushika irangiye. Mu gihe igikorwa kitagenze neza, soma ikosa ryaco wongere usubiremwo urutonde imbere y'uko usubira kugerageza.
UBUHINGA BWO GUKORERA Imirimo ishigikiwe irimwo impapuro Minecraft JAR, Rust Oxide/uMod plugins, 7 local Ibikoresho vya Days to Die, ibintu vya Empyrion be n'ibikoresho vyo guhinyanyura imbuga, ARK: Survival Evolved Workshop IDs, na ARK: Survival Ascended provider IDs. Hariho uburyo bumwe bumwe bwo kumenya gusa canke bukeneye kubanza gukoreshwa.
Kuri ID z'abatanga izo nkino, Synix ni yo icungera ingene izo nkino zitunganijwe mu gihe umukino/uwutanga izo nkino atanga ibirimwo. Ibirimwo bitaratorwa ntibishobora gusomwa imbere y'igihe mu karere.
IBINTU AMASHEKO ASHOBORA GUKORA N'IBITASHOBORA GUKORA Kwinjiza kuraba ingene impapuro zitunganijwe hamwe n'aho zija, no kwirukana inzira zidakingiwe, amahuza, ibirimwo bitemewe, impapuro zikomeye cane, aho zija incuro zibiri, hamwe n'ibimenyamenya vy'uko hari ububisha bwabonetse.
Amasanamu ya Defender ataboneka canke atagira ico avuze, ni imburizi, si ikimenyamenya c'uko hariho ububisha. Gusuzuma neza n'amajambo yanditswe na vyo nyene ntibiremeza ko urwandiko rwatanzwe n'umuntu wa gatatu ari urwo kwizigirwa. Mods zikoresha uburenganzira bwa Windows bwa seriveri.
IBIKORANIRO, GUSUBIRA hamwe no gusubiza ibintu mu buryo Kurondera Catalogue vyugurura urubuga rw'uwutanga. Ntigikora mu buryo bw'imikorere canke ngo ishobore gushiraho modpack yuzuye.
Guhagarika seriveri imbere y'ugusubiza inyuma kwinjiza. Ivyo bihindura ibintu vyose vyatoranijwe, bishobora kuba birimwo ivyongeweko vyinshi. Igarukana inyandiko z'umwimerere zazigamwe kandi ikuraho amadosiye yashizweho n'iyo mpapuro. Gutangura kubanza gusubiza inyuma ibintu bishasha vyinjijwe igihe bihanahana amadosiye; Synix iranka gusubiramwo dosiye yahinduwe hanze y'inyandiko yayo yo kwinjiza canke gukoresha inyandiko z'intango zakijijwe zidashobora gusuzumwa. Ivyandikano vya kera vy'ukwinjiza ibintu bishobora kuba bidafise hashes z'ivyandikano vy'umwimerere vyabitswe.
Kuri ID itunganywa na provider, Remove Selected ikura iyo ID muri configuration ishigikiwe ya Synix; si ugusubira inyuma kw'ipakete ryo ng'aho. Synix yandika impinduka ikora, ntabwo ari impinduka zose zikorwa n'intoki. Gumana inyanduruko y'ibanga y'umukozi yuzuye: gukuraho mod birashobora gutuma isi idashobora kwuzuzwa canke gukuraho ibintu vya mod.
Igisata c'ubusa bisigura ko ata vyongeweko bifasha bihuye n'akarere k'ishirwa mu ngiro hamwe no kurondera. Fyonda ahanditse Gushakisha maze usuzume umwirondoro, ububiko, n'igihimba imbere yo kwiyumvira ko amadosiye yose ari kuri disike yasuzumwe.

data.name: Content.3FFA3E0258F2F0369B0C
data.value:
Fungura Add Server → Game Support Catalog kugira urabe ivyo Synix izi ku vyerekeye urukino imbere yo kurwandika. Urwo rutonde rukoresha ibisobanuro biri muri porogarama washizeho.
1. Nurondere izina ry'urukino. 2. Koresha urutonde rw'abakinyi, amakuru y'abakinyi, uburyo bwo gukina hagati y'abakinyi, uburyo bwo guhanahana amakuru, canke uburyo bwo gusuzuma kugira ngo urondere abandi. 3. Hitamwo urukino maze wugurure amakuru yarwo, canke ukande kabiri ku murongo warwo. 4. Soma ivyerekeye uburyo bwo gushiraho, porogaramu ya seriveri, ibisabwa, n'amakuru yo kugenzura.
Niwamara kubona ko umukino utaba uriko urakinwa, nuce uhanagura utwo dukingirizo. Minecraft's Java and Bedrock amahitamwo ni igice c'igikorwa cayo co gushiraho aho kuba uburyo bubiri bwo guhinduranya.
NIWISOMERE UBUZIMA UBIKWIRIZE Umwirondoro ushobora gutanga uburyo bwo gutunganya ibintu, uburyo bwo gushiraho ibintu, uburyo bwo gutanguza ibintu, canke ugushigikira ku rugero ruto. A listed executable or Steam AppID isobanura ukuntu installation ikora; ntiyemera imikino yose isohotse.
Ibisabwa vyo kwemeza ko umuntu ari SteamCMD bisigura ko umwirondoro usaba kwinjira muri konti. Uwufise uwo mukino be n'amategeko y'uwumusohora yoshobora gushinga ibindi bisabwa.
IBIKORWA BITANZWE NTIBIBA BIRI UMURYANGO W'UBUHAMYA Agaciro k'ikibanza c'isubiramwo (query-port) kabitswe ntikaba kerekana ko uwumviriza isubiramwo (query listener) abaho canke ko ategerezwa kuboneka. Nukoreshe uburyo bwo gukina bwabayeho be n'ibisabwa ku bijanye n'amategeko.
Urwo rutonde ni rwo rufasha gusuzuma insobanuro zashizweho. Inyandiko z'ugusuzuma z'aho hantu zerekana ivyo vyabonetse kuri iyo PC, si ivyavuye ku mashini yose canke ku bwoko bwose bw'imashini.

Amadosiye y'ibikoresho vyo mu buhinga bwa none n'ay'ibikoresho vyo mu buhinga bwa none usanga ari ukwa vyonyene.

data.name: Content.45EB10CB4237CAC4A2E5
data.value:
Fungura ikimenyetso c'ibikoresho kiri ku meza y'ibikoresho kugira ushobore gushiraho uburyo bwose. Koresha buto ya Configure y'isandugu ku bisobanuro bifitaniye gusa n'iyo sandugu.
GUSUBIRA • Show Server Console Window icungera nimba servers zishigikiwe zerekana console zabo zisanzwe. Ibaraza ryihishe ntibisigura ko serveri yahagaritswe. • Dark Mode ihindura insanganyamatsiko ya porogaramu. • SteamCMD Download Speed ihitamwo umuvuduko wuzuye canke akarimbi k'ugukuraho gashigikiwe. • Guhindura indimi birashigikira amazina y'urubuga, ibiganiro, n'ubutumwa bw'ukuntu ibintu vyifashe.
Izindi mpapuro zirimwo ibibanza vyo gusubiriza hamwe n'uguhinduranya, amahitamwo y'ibanga/umutekano, gutanga amakuru y'ibibazo, hamwe n'amahinguriro y'imbere/inyuma. Ntibikenewe ko ushiramwo ivy'inyongera kugira ngo ukore serveri isanzwe.
IBIGENZEKO VY'INKURU Hitamwo mu ndimi zitangirwa muri ico gikoresho co guhitamwo. Synix controls, help articles, na app-generated messages zikoresha ururimi rwatowe. Amabwirizwa y'urukino, ibiharuro vy'amahinguriro, n'ivyavuye mu gisata c'intango ntibihindurwa. Amadosiye y'ivy'ubuhinga agumana amajambo y'ibanze yo gusuzuma indwara.
Igisomwa gihuye n'urukino ntigihindurwa: amabwirizwa, impfunguruzo z'ugutunganya hamwe n'indangagaciro, amazina y'ikarata, uburyo, amazina y'amadosiye, ibiharuro vyo gutanguza, ivyerekana, n'ibisomwa vy'ugutahura ivyasohotse bitegerezwa kuguma mu buryo urukino rwiteze.
Guhindura ururimi rw'urubuga ntibihindura imvugo y'ibwirizwa ry'urukino canke ngo bihindure ibiva muri console. Mu gihe icandikano gisanzwe ca Synix kidashobora guhindurwa mu buryo butari bwitezwe, bandika amajambo yaco, idirishya, n'ururimi rwatoranijwe.

data.name: Content.493BAB772B40AABA8979
data.value:
Fungura Settings → Privacy & Security imbere yo gusangira ecran canke gusuzuma amahitamwo y'umutekano.
UBUZIMA BW'INKURU Ubuhinga bwitwa Privacy Mode bwarashigikira ivyerekana amakuru y'ibanga, nka aderese n'ivyangombwa. Ntiguhindura IP yawe ya bose, ngo ihishe uruja n'uruza rw'urubuga, canke ngo isukuze ikinyamakuru cose c'urukino na dosiye y'ugutunganya ibintu.
Nusuzume amashusho imbere yo kuyagira abandi. Igikorwa co gusubiramwo ku murima wambaye agapfukamunwa gishobora gusubiramwo igiciro nyaco.
IBIGANIRO N'IBIGANIRO VYAROKOWE Synix ikingira abakiliya ba Windows. Urwo rukino rushobora kuba rukeneye ivyemeza vy'ugusoma mu buryo bwarwo bwite canke mu buryo bwo gutanguza.
Gukoporora dosiye ku yindi konte ya Windows ntibitanga icemezo c'uko ivyo bintu bikingiwe bishobora kwugururwa. Koresha uburyo bwo guhanahana amakuru bwanditseko (encrypted transfer workflow) mu kwimura impapuro z'umutsindo.
IBIKORWA vy'amadirisha Koresha Synix hamwe na serveri zisanzwe z'imikino zifise uburenganzira busanzwe bwa Windows. Ihinduka ry'uburyo kanaka canke uwutanguza urukino arashobora gusaba ihagarikwa ku giti ciwe; si imvo yo gutwara ibintu vyose ibihe vyose nk'umuhagarikizi.
Ingorane z'isuku ry'urukuta rw'umuriro zitari ngombwa zarashigikiye amategeko ya kera ya Synix. Nusuzume ingingo zatanzwe imbere y'uko wemera gukurwaho. Ntigitegura amafolda yose y'umwimerere canke ngo itange uruhusha rwo gusiba amategeko ya firewall adafitaniye isano.
Bishitse ibanga rikamenyekana, nuce urisubiriza canke urisubize mu minwe y'ikigo caritanze. Guhisha ikibanza canke gukuraho kopi ya Synix yazigamwe ntibitesha agaciro ubwo bubasha ahandi.

data.name: Content.5157BE079A5B48521112
data.value:
Gufunga idirishya ry'umwana, kugabanya Synix, no gusohoka mu buryo butomoye muri porogaramu ni ibikorwa bitandukanye. Nusuzume ukuntu wigenza hamwe n'ibikenewe vyose kugira usohoke.
GUSUBIRA UMURIRO W'INKURU Synix irashobora kumenya imikorere ya seriveri ishigikiwe ikiriho kandi igatorera nyeneyo. Reka isuzuma rya mbere ry'igikorwa rirangire imbere y'uko utangura ikindi kintu.
Ubuhinga bwo kumenyekanisha ibintu butegerezwa guhuza n'igikorwa catoranijwe, atari gusa izina risanzwe rikoreshwa. Ibikoresho vy'ugupfunyikira ibitabu canke ibikorwa bitunganywa n'abandi bishobora gukenera kwitwararikwa cane.
IBIKORWA BIKURIKIRA MU KARERE Amahitamwo y'ugutangura/inyuma-y'umukozi ashigikira igenzura ku kwinjira kwa Windows. Ntibasabwa kurema server yawe ya mbere.
Igikorwa gitegekanijwe gisaba uburyo canke igikoresho kijanye na Synix, ikiringo ca Windows kiriho, hamwe na PC ikiri maso. Gutangura kwinjira si umuhango w'uko igikorwa kizobandanya igihe imashini ihagaritswe.
IMBERE Y'Ukwongera Gutangura Amadirisha Nuhejeje gusubiriza, kuzimya no kuzimya ibintu. Guhagarika udukino duciye muri Synix kugira ngo dushobore kuzigama nk'uko bisanzwe, hanyuma ugasohoka canke ugasubira gutangura Windows.
Ntiwiyumvire ko igikoresho co gukinirako kinyegejwe cahagaze canke ko kwugara idirisha ryo gucungera ibintu bituma ico gikoresho gihagarika gukina. Nusuzume icuma gikoresha ivyuma (dashboard) maze ukoreshe uburyo bwo kugenzura ubuzima.

data.name: Content.57A2257D55B43047831A
data.value:
Fungura inyishu ya Readiness y'umukozi yatowe kugirango umenye ibisabwa bibuze. Ikiringo c'ugukina kiri muri Synix ntigisubirira ibisabwa ku rukino.
UBUHAMYA BURONDANYE Amakosa avuga MSVCP140.dll canke VCRUNTIME140.dll kenshi yerekana ko hakenewe igihe c'isubirwamwo rya Visual C++. Koresha amabwirizwa y'urukino hamwe n'igikoresho co gukwiragiza Microsoft.
Microsoft's redistributable information: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist
Nturungike dosiye imwe imwe ya DLL ku mbuga ngurukanabumenyi canke ngo ushire DLL zidasa n'izo iruhande y'inyandiko ikurikizwa kuri serveri.
IBIKURIKIRA BINDI Umukino ushobora gusaba konti, uburenganzira bwa seriveri, igihe c'imikorere ya Java, imikorere ya Windows, canke ivyuma bishigikiwe. Niwuzuze ivyo bisabwa imbere y'uguhindura amarembo adafitaniye isano canke ugusubira gushiraho uburyo.
Kuri Minecraft Java, koresha ubwoko bw'ibishobora gukoreshwa mu guhitamwo Synix. Bedrock ntikoresha Java.
Ku gikorwa gisaba Hyper-V canke ivyuma vy'ubuhinga bwa none (virtualisation du matériel), kuraba neza ko igikinisho gifise ibikenewe vyose. Ntureke ngo ibintu bimwebimwe vyo mu buhinga bikoreshwe canke ngo ukoreshe serveri yose nk'umuhagarikizi kugira gusa wirengagize imburi.
Umaze gukosora ico kintu gisabwa, nuce utangura urundi rukurikirane hanyuma usubire urabe ikosa rya mbere rihambaye ryo mu rutonde rw'urukino rwabaye.

data.name: Content.5C88F49381905FBD8C70
data.value:
GUSHIRIZA INTEGURIZA BIKENGEJE:
1. Synix yugurura Space Engineers Dedicated Server Manager kandi iguma iboneka.
2. Guhitamwo 'Local/Console', guhitamwo 'Continue to server configuration', kwinjiza server na world settings, hanyuma uhitemwo 'Save & start'.
3. Koresha umuyobozi w'ibikoresho vy'inyongera, isi, ama mods, abahagarikizi, hamwe n'ikibanza co gukoreramwo. Amakuru ya seriveri abikwa muri dosiye Instance ya seriveri ya Synix.
4. Uburyo bwambere bwa Local/Console ntibukeneye uburenganzira bw'umuyobozi. Windows service mode irabikora.
5. Ibisabwa: .NET Framework 4.8 canke nshasha, Visual C++ Redistributables 2013 na 2017, n'imiburiburi 6 GB ya sisitemu RAM, na UDP port 27016 yemerewe biciye muri Windows Firewall kandi yandikiwe abakinyi ba Internet.
6. Inyandiko yemewe: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

data.name: Content.5D3A53B459DA2A7A26AF
data.value:
Nukoreshe aka gatabu igihe ukoresheje umuhora wo mu karere (LAN) bikagenda neza ariko aho ukoresha umuhora w'abantu benshi bikagenda nabi.
UMURYANGO WAWE W'IBIJANYE N'ABAHISHUKA Imigende imwe n'imwe ntishigikira NAT loopback, yitwa kandi hairpinning. Ubuhinga bwo guhanahana amakuru hagati y'abantu bo mu nzu n'abo kuri iyo nyubakwa burashobora kudakora, naho nyene abakinyi bo hanze bashobora kubwinjiramwo.
Koresha aderese ya LAN i muhira uce usaba umuntu akoresheje ubundi buhinga bwa interineti ngo agerageze iyo aderese ya bose. Kuba ikoranabuhanga rya WAN ryo muri PC ryananiwe gukora si co kimenyamenya c'uko Internet yahagaze.
KUGURUZANIRWA IBIKORWA VYO MU BUNYARWANDA nta tandukaniro rihari Nusuzume ko ata yindi router iri haruguru, NAT zibiri, canke NAT zo ku rwego rwo hejuru (CGNAT). Gereranya amakuru ya WAN y'umuyoboro na aderese ya bose hanyuma ubaze ISP niba imihora yinjira ishigikiwe.
Ingingo y'uguhererekanya amakuru kuri router yawe ntishobora kwugurura umurongo wo hejuru wa NAT ukoreshwa na ISP. Bivanye n'uburyo bwo guhuza, hakenerwa serivisi y'ubutumwa bwa bose, VPN/tunnel ibereye, canke seriveri ikoreshwa. Ivyo ni ibintu vy'inyuma, si ibintu vy'imbere muri Synix.
NTUGATATATANYE UMUGENZI N'UBUHAMYA BW'UMUKINYI Umuyagankuba ukoreshwa n'umuntu ari kure be n'umuyagankuba ukoreshwa n'umukinyi w'urukino ni inzira zitandukanye. Gushiraho ubutumwa bwa API canke Discord ntibituma umukino uboneka kuri internet.
Ntugire aho uhengamiye mu gusuzuma ikoreshwa ry'umuyagankuba. Igihe usaba imfashanyo, ntushire ahabona amajambo y'ibanga akoreshwa mu guhanahana amakuru, ibimenyetso, amafoto ya ruteri canke amakuru ajanye n'urusobe rw'imbuga ngurukanabumenyi.

data.name: Content.6B534A2A8D64DD2115B8
data.value:
Koresha icandikano kiri ku gice cagize ingorane.
SYNIX ACTIVITY Activity & Diagnostics yerekana iterambere hamwe n'imburizi zijanye n'abakoresha kuri dashboard. Gusukura ako gace gusukura gusa ubutumwa buboneka; ntikuraho ibipimo vyose vyafashwe.
UBUHAMYA BWO GUSHIRIZA Synix inyandiko z'ivyabaye n'amakuru y'impanuka yahitanye abantu usanga mu buryo busanzwe: C:\Synix\SynixData\logs
Urukurikirane rw'amajambo rushobora kuvuga izina ry'idosiye kanaka. Koresha iyo nzira n'umwanya w'ikosa kugira uronke inyandiko ikenewe.
Ibitandukaniro vy'ugupima vyafashwe birashobora kwandikwa mu gitabo c'ivyanditswe ataco bibonetse kuri dashboard. Ikirenga cakozwe mu buryo bwanditse ntigica kiba ikimenyamenya c'uko porogarama yahagaritse gukora.
IBIKORANIRWA vy'inkino Koresha urutonde rw'abakinyi b'umukino wa server yatoranijwe kugira umenye amakosa yo kwinjiza mu isi, gutunganya ibintu, guhinyanyura ibintu n'ay'umwanya w'umukino. Aho iri bivana n'urwo rukino, kandi ishobora kuba iri hanze y'umuzi w'ikibanza.
GUSOMA MU KIGANIRO Niwitegereze ico kintu be n'umwanya vyabereyeko, uce usuzuma ubwo butumwa igihe habaye ikosa rihambaye rya mbere. Umugozi wo ku mpera ushobora kuba ari ingaruka y'ico kintu aho kuba ari co gitera.
Imbere yo gusangira agace, banza ukure amajambo y'ibanga, ibimenyetso, webhooks, aderese z'ibanga n'inzira bwite. Isandugu / ikinyamakuru ca Satisfactory gishobora kuba kirimwo agashimwe k'umuhagarikizi. Mugumane ikinyamakuru c'ibanga c'umwimerere ku bw'amatohoza yanyu bwite.

data.name: Content.72F10866249FA31A6B09
data.value:
Gusubizaho birashobora gusubirira ivyanditse kuri serveri yatoranijwe. Nuhitemwo serveri ibereye wongere uzigame ibintu vyose bishasha imbere yo kubandanya.
1. Hagarika seriveri maze ukore kopi y'inyongera y'amadosiye ushobora kuba ukeneye. 2. Fungura uruzitiro rw'ibikorwa vyo gusubiramwo muri Server Options. 3. Nuhitemwo ububiko wipfuza hanyuma usuzume ivyerekeye serveri, itariki, ubunini be n'ukuntu bukora. 4. Banza uvyemeze imbere y'uko usubiramwo. Synix udukingirizo turimwo SHA-256 ivyinjijwe birashobora gusuzumwa bivanye n'ivyo vyinjijwe; Ivyandikano vya kera bishobora kubonwa ko ari ivya kera. 5. Soma iyo ngabisho yo gusubiriza maze wemeze gusa ko ico ari co gihe c'ugusubiza ibintu mu buryo. 6. Reka gushiraho intambwe n'ugusubiza ibintu mu buryo birangire utarinze kwugara Synix canke guhagarika ububiko. 7. Tanguza seriveri hanyuma wemeze ko isi n'ibikoresho vyategekanijwe vyasubijweho.
IBIGIRANIRO BIVAMWO Gusuzuma ko ibintu ari ukuri birerekana ko hari ivyahindutse ku rupapuro rw'inzira. Si ikimenyamenya c'uko isi yari imeze neza igihe yarokoka canke c'uko ivyandikano vy'uwundi muntu ari ivyo kwizigirwa.
IGIHE INZAMBA ZIHAMBUYE Nugumize mu bubiko bwawe ivyandikano vya kera be n'ivyandikano vyose bivuga ibijanye n'ugusubiza ibintu inyuma canke ivyo gusubiza ibintu mu buryo. Soma ubutumwa bw'ugusubiza ibintu mu buryo imbere yo kugerageza ubundi buryo bwo gusubiza canke gukuraho amadosiye.
Ntimushire ZIP kuri serveri iriko iragenda. Mu gihe urukino rukigumiza hanze y'ububiko bw'ibikoresho, nubigarure ukoresheje uburyo bukoreshwa muri urwo rukino.
Gumana inyandiko y'inyanduruko gushika usuzumye serveri isubijweho hamwe n'umuhuza w'abakiriya.

data.name: Content.730545B3639C062E1741
data.value: Mods zisanzwe zikorana n'izo mods zija muri Mods/UserCode. Gereranya Eco na API kandi ugumane ibikoresho bikenewe.

data.name: Content.74448A2C2CBD821D56C4
data.value:
Import Existing Server yandikishije inyubako ishigikiwe iri kuri disiki. Si ugusubira kwinjiza kandi bitandukanye no kwinjiza Synix yose.
IMBERE Y'UKUZOMENYA Kora backup itandukanye, ushizemwo na save zose ziri hanze y'ububiko bwo kwinjiza. Guhagarika seriveri no guhagarika uwundi muyobozi canke uwutegura igihe yoshobora kuyitanguza mu gihe Synix iriko irayiyobora.
GUSUBIRA MU KABARU 1. Hitamwo Add Server → Import Existing Server. 2. Hitamwo ububiko bwo kwinjiza bwa seriveri, ntuhitemwo inzira ngufi, dosiye ya ZIP, canke ububiko bw'umukino. 3. Reka Synix bayisuzume, hanyuma yemeze urukino rwatowe, urwandiko rw'urwo rukino, urutonde rw'ibikoreshwa, be n'ibintu vyashizweho. 4. Gushira izina ridasanzwe ku rutonde rw'ibikenewe, wongere wuzuze ibibuze. 5. Nuhejeje kwinjiza, ufungure Configure, hanyuma usubiremwo inzira n'ibivuko vyayo. 6. Niwitegure, uce utangura igikorwa kimwe. Nusuzume ko isi itegekanijwe hamwe n'uburyo bwo kuyitunganya vyashizweko.
IBINTU VY'INGENZI Vyahindutse Kwiyandikisha ntibituma iyo porogaramu yimuka, ngo yongere kumanurwa canke ngo isubirizwe n'ayandi makuru. Ibikorwa vyo mu nyuma uhitamwo, nka Update, Validate, canke configuration repair, birashobora guhindura amadosiye.
Ama wrappers y'ugutanguza, modpacks, passwords, n'ama saves yo hanze ntibishobora kwibonekeza. Inzira imwe yo kwinjiza ntishobora kwandikwa kabiri.
IGIHE BITANZWE Nurabe ko wahisemwo urubuga rwihariye rwemewe n'umwirondoro wahisemwo. Ntimuhindure izina ry'igikorwa kitagira aho gihuriye n'ikindi kugira ngo gitume gihuza. Nimutange raporo y'urukino hamwe n'igihimba c'impapuro mwanditse kugira ngo dushobore gusuzuma ukuntu urwo rukino rwatunganijwe.

data.name: Content.749F8256FE4490AB39C8
data.value:
Koresha ubu buyobozi igihe umuyobozi w'ibikoresho atanga raporo y'umurima utariho, inyubako itagira agaciro, canke itandukaniro ry'ibishushanyo.
Gutahura amahitamwo • Ibiharuro bisanzwe vyo kuzigama vyashigikiye ibiciro mu buryo bwatoranijwe. • Gusanura bifasha gutorera umuti ingorane yavuzwe ko ishigikiwe. • Gusubizaho bisubirira impapuro zisanzwe kandi birashobora gukuraho impagararo zisanzwe.
Gusubiza ibintu ku murongo si co kintu ca mbere gikenewe igihe cose ivyuma vy'amaserveri vyanse gukora. Igihe c'urukino kitakiriho, ibibuga vyabujijwe gukora, n'ama mods avunitse ntibikosorwa mu gusubiriza incuro nyinshi amadosiye y'ibikoresho.
IMBERE yo gusanura Nuhagarike urwo rukino, ugumane kopi y'ibiri muri urwo rukurikirane, maze usome neza ivyahinduwe. Amasanamu amwamwe afise inyanduruko yuzuye; Abandi na bo biteze ko urwo rukino ruzotuma haboneka amadosiye ku ncuro ya mbere rwugurutse canke rugasaba ko rwatunganywa n'umuntu.
Synix imenyesha ko hari amatagisi yabuze aho kwiyumvira ko ishobora gusubiriza umurongo wose ata nkomanzi. Gushiraho ihinyanyurwa ry'igishushanyo kigenzurwa birashobora kuzigama ikopi imwe yitwa .synix.before-template-v<revision>.bak.
HAMBERE Y'UBUHINGA BWO GUSUBIRA AKAGARA KANDI UBWO GUSUBIRA Nugumize impapuro zo gukingira canke zo gusubiza ibintu mu buryo maze usome ubutumwa bw'ugusubiza ibintu mu buryo. Gereranya ukuntu ibintu vyari vyifashe mu ntango n'ukuntu vyahindutse imbere y'uko uhitamwo ico usubira gushiraho. Ntimuhere ku bundi buryo mu kugerageza gusubiramwo.
Uhejeje gukira, nuce utangura maze usuzume ivyanditse mu rukino. Nusuzume neza ko uriko urasoma inzira igororotse be n'uko impagararo zisanzwe ukeneye zikiriho.

data.name: Content.7871EA5C906D13E02997
data.value:
Dune ikoresha sisitemu yo gushiraho hanze hamwe n'imashini nyayo y'umukino hamwe n'urwego rw'umurwi w'intambara. Si igikoresho gisanzwe co gukina gifise uburyo bumwe gusa bwo gutunganya ibintu.
IBINTU BITEGEMWA Soma Synix'Ubuhinga bwa none bw'ubuhinga bwa none, AVX2, ivyuma vy'ubuhinga bwa none, Hyper-V, hamwe n'ubuhinga bwa Professional canke bukomeye gusumba Windows edition. Ibikenewe mu vy'ukwibuka bivana n'umurwi w'intambara ukoresha be n'amakarata ukoresha.
Synix ntishira mu ngiro ubuhinga bwa none canke ngo ishireho Hyper-V. Niwuzuze ibisabwa ku bijanye n'urukino imbere y'uko utangura gukina.
Gushiraho no gutanguza 1. Hindura inyandiko Dune: Awakening wongere usuzume ibisabwa n'ububiko bw'ibikoresho. 2. Kubika no gutangura. 3. Synix iratanguza igikoresho cemewe ca battlegroup.bat hamwe n'inyishu y'umuhagarikizi isabwa n'ico gikorwa. 4. Hitamwo initial-setup mu gikoresho c'urukino maze utange Ikimenyetso cawe co Kwikingira. 5. Niwuzuze ivy'ugushiraho imashini ngendanwa, umuhora be n'umugwi w'urugamba muri ico gikoresho.
Kuronka Self-Host Token ukoresheje urubuga rwemewe rwa Funcom ukoresheje uburyo bwo kwitegura/gushiraho: https://account.duneawakening.com/
Ntugire uwo ubwira ivy'ico kintu. Gushira hejuru ico gikoresho c'ugushira mu ngiro ntibisigura ko serveri yose ya Synix ikwiye gukoreshwa nk'umuhagarikizi.
UMURYANGO W'UBUZIMA N'ABIKORWA Koresha uburyo bw'umuyoboro bwa host/VM n'ibibuga bikenewe. Ivya metadata vyo mu gisata c'isubiramwo muri Synix bigereranya RMQ, si uwumviriza isubiramwo A2S isanzwe.
Gufunga icuma co gutanguza ikoranabuhanga ntibisobanura ko ivyuma vy'ikoranabuhanga vyaho vyahagaze. Nusuzume ko uriko urakora neza wongere ukore ibikorwa vy'umurwi w'intambara ukoresheje ivyuma vyo gucungera ikoreshwa ry'umukino.
Synix irashobora gushiraho, kuvugurura, gutanguza, no gushigikira ububiko bw'ibikoresho vyatoranijwe. Ntimwiyumvire ko igikorwa gisanzwe co guhagarika, ibibazo vy'abakinyi, canke gusubiza ibintu mu buryo bivuye ku barinzi bigenzura bimwe vyuzuye igikorwa c'inyuma. Kwugurura dosiye yo gutanguza ntibitangwa kuri iyi mpapuro.
Koresha uburyo bwo guhagarika n'ubwugingo bw'inyongera bukoreshwa n'urukino ku makuru y'imashini ngendanwa/database adahinduka. Umuduga w'iposita wonyene ntushobora kwemeza ko ari uw'ukuri.

data.name: Content.7B4987810DD3E78752A5
data.value:
Iki kiganiro ni ic'abakoresha n'abatanga intererano bakomeye. Ntibikenewe ko ukoresha ibikoresho vy'abategura ivyuma kugira ngo ukore serveri ukoresheje umwirondoro ushigikiwe.
UKUNTU IBIGERERANIRO BIKORWA Inyishu z'urukino zisanzwe zivuga ivy'ukuronka, ivy'ugukora, Steam AppIDs n'ibisabwa kugira umuntu yinjire, uburyo bwo gutanguza, ama ports, inyifato yo gushiraho, ibisabwa, hamwe n'ubushobozi bw'inderetsi.
Ibisobanuro birahitamwo inyifato yashizweho. Ntibikoresha uburyo butandukanye bwo kwinjiza ivyandikano, imiterere, canke inyandiko zatororokanijwe. Gushira ifayili JSON mw'isandugu y'igikoresho cashizweko ntibituma haboneka agace gashasha k'urukino.
GUSUBIRA KANDI GUSHIRIZA UMURYANGO 1. Tangura ufatiye ku mabwiriza y'umukozi wemewe be n'amadosiye y'ibikoresho vy'ukuri. 2. Koresha inzira zerekeranye n'umuzi wa seriveri aho bikenewe kandi ukoreshe indangamuntu zigenga umukino. 3. Nushiremwo inyanduruko z'ibisata vyose vyashizweho mu bibanza bikwiye. 4. Gushira ku rutonde ibisobanuro bikwiye/gutegura/guhindura inyanduruko y'ibishushanyo. 5. Kwemeza ububiko bw'ibitabo, kwubaka na SDK isabwa n'umushinga, no gukora ibipimo bikenewe. 6. Gerageza gushiraho, gutangura, guhagarika, no gukurikirana n'urukino nya rukino imbere yo kwandika kwemeza.
Igikoresho co gushiraho ibisobanuro ni igikoresho co kwubaka, si igisabwa gisanzwe c'ugushiraho ivyasohotse.
INTEGURIZA Y'IMVAHO • UI: Amadirisha y'ibikoresho. • ServerHandler: Abategura imikino n'abakorera kuri serveri. • SynixEngine: Ubuzima bwa porogaramu, kubungabunga, gushiraho imbuga ngurukanabumenyi, gushigikira, n'umutekano. • Igishushanyo c'inyubako: Imashini zikoreshwa n'abantu benshi, imvugo zikoreshwa n'abantu benshi be n'imfashanyo zijanye n'ukuntu inyubakwa imeze. • Database/GameDefinitions: Ibiranga inkino n'ibishushanyo. • Database/ModSystems: Imirimo y'inyongera ishigikiwe. • Gushira mu rurimi rw'imvukira: Imirongo yo guhanahana amakuru n'ibikoresho bitanga amakuru. • Ibigeragezo: Amasanamu yerekana ukuntu ibintu vyifashe.
Ku bijanye n'ubuhinduzi, nuvugurure urutonde rw'indimi zose hamwe wongere ugumane ibibanza vyanditse. Nushiremwo ibiganiro vy'imfashanyo, ivy'ugusuzuma indwara, ivyanditswe vyerekana ingene umuntu ashobora kuyironka be n'amajambo adondora uburyo bwo gushigikira udukino. Ntuhindure amabwirizwa, impfunguruzo, ibimenyetso, ibiharuro vy'abakoresha, canke ibimenyetso vy'ugutahura ivyasohotse. Inyandiko z'ivy'ugupima indwara zo mu ntango ntizihinduka.
Soma amategeko y'uruhusha n'amategeko agenga uburenganzira bw'umuntu imbere y'uko usubira gukwiragiza code canke builds. Ntugire aho uhereza amakuru y'ukuri be n'ivyandikano vyawe bwite.

data.name: Content.7C1660167D3419DD05A4
data.value:
Nushireho urutonde rw'ibikorwa vyo kubungabunga seriveri inyuma y'aho uhejeje kugerageza uburyo isanzwe ikoresha mu gusubiriza, mu gusanura, mu guhagarika no mu gutanguza.
1. Fungura impagarara zayo zo kwikora/gutegekanya hanyuma ukore igenamigambi. 2. Hitamwo imisi n'amasaha. 3. Nushireho Smart Maintenance hanyuma uhitemwo amahitamwo yo gusubiriza/gusubiramwo. 4. Niwishingire nimba worindira abakinyi n'igihe uzobamara. 5. Niwizigire wongere ugerageze mu gihe c'ikiringo co kubungabunga ushobora gucungera.
Imigwi ikoresha isaha yo muri ako karere. Nuzigame isaha n'ikibanza kirimwo amasaha bibereye.
IGIHE UMUSIGURO W'IBIGENZEKO UGIHE Synix irashobora kurindira abakinyi bahuje, hanyuma igatunganya guhagarika umurwi w'ibikorwa vyemejwe, gusubiramwo mugihe yahagaritswe, kuvugurura, no gusubira gutangura bivanye n'amahitamwo yatowe.
Ikiringo ntarengwa umuntu ashobora kurindira ni akarimbi, si umuhango wo kurindira ibihe bidahera. Umwanya wo kubungabunga urashobora kubandanya igihe uheze naho nyene abakinyi bagumaho. Ikiringo c'ukurindira kidakwije na kimwe ntigitanga ikiringo co kurindira.
UBUHAMYA BW'ABAKINDI BURI N'IBIGERANYO Gutegereza bivana n'amakuru urukino rwatoranijwe rushobora gutanga. Seriveri ya API ifitaniye isano na Satisfactory ifata ibiharuro vya kera canke bitaboneka mu gihe c'ikiringo co kurindira catunganijwe. Ivyo ntibituma amakuru y'ibibazo adashigikiwe aba ayo kwizigirwa.
Kumenyesha abakinyi imbere y'igihe no gusoma ubutumwa bw'ibikorwa bivamwo. Discord amatangazo ashobora gutanga amakuru y'ibikorwa vyo kubungabunga ashigikiwe igihe inzira zabo zisanzwe. Imenyesha ry'ibikorwa vyo kubungabunga bikurikizwa igihe inzira zabwo zisanzwe.
PC itegerezwa kuba ikiriho kandi igikorwa ca Synix kijanye na co canke igikoresho c'inyuma gikwiye kuba kiriko kirakora. Orudinateri yazimye canke iryamye ntishobora gukora ibikorwa bisanzwe vyategekanijwe vyo gukurura no gusubira gutangura.

data.name: Content.8579FAD0312C27797E9E
data.value:
Fungura terminal Windows canke PowerShell hanyuma ukoreshe indangamuntu nyayo y'ipakete iri hasi. Ayo mabwirizwa atwara Synix ubwayo, atari amaserveri y'urukino.
Gushiraho winget install --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
NUSUZUME UBUHUNGU BWASHIRIZWE winget list --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
GUSUBIZA Gufunga Synix no kurangiza igikorwa cayo imbere yo gukoresha: winget upgrade --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
GUSUBIRA IGIHAMBA winget uninstall --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
NIWIBUKE UBUGENZI BWAWE Ibikoresho vyo kwinjiza kuri serveri, ivyo kuzigama hamwe n'ivyo gusubiriza biri ukwa vyonyene. Ntimukazimye C:\Synix canke izindi dosiye z'amakuru y'umwimerere kiretse mugize umugambi wo gukuraho ayo makuru.
IBIGENZEKO BITANZE GUSHOBORA Nusome igituma vyavuzwe. Mu gihe WinGet imenyesha ko hash ya installer idahuza, ihagarike maze uyimenyeshe; nturengere igenzura ry'umugozi. Iterambere ridahari rishobora gusigura ko ububiko butarasohora impapuro nshasha.
Kwemeza WinGet hamwe n'igiharuro gihuye co gupakurura (hash) ntibitanga ikimenyetso ca kode Synix canke ngo bitange icemezo c'uko porogaramu y'umutekano ya Windows izoyizigira.

data.name: Content.89E9CF0E65B8EACE25DF
data.value:
Ubwa mbere niwerekane ko urwo rukino rukora ku rubuga rwawe bwite. Guhindura router ntibishobora gukosora urukino rutaratangura canke rutarangiza gushiraho.
Nuhitemwo ahantu habereye • Kuri PC y'umukozi: Koresha umuhora w'inkino ushigikiwe canke umuhora wo guhanahana amakuru. • Ku kindi gikoresho co mu buhinga bwa none: Koresha aderese ya LAN y'iyo mudasobwa. • Inyuma y'urusobe rwawe rwo muhira: Koresha aderese yawe ya bose canke uburyo bwo kurondera/kwifatanya bwashigikiwe n'urukino.
Fungura Connection Information y'ikintu catoranijwe kugira usuzume impera zaco. Aderese ya LAN yigenga ntishobora gukoreshwa n'abakinyi ba internet.
GUSUZUMIRA AHABANZA 1. Rindira ko urukino rurangiza kwinjiza. 2. Nusuzume aho uciye n'ivyavuye mu kwitegura kwa serveri. 3. Niwifatanye n'uwundi muntu ukoresheje orodinateri, hanyuma ukoresheje iyindi mudasobwa. 4. Mu gihe ukwinjira muri LAN ataco vyashitseko, kuraba mu rutonde rw'urukino n'ukwinjira muri Firewall ya Windows kugira ngo umenye neza ko ari serveri iriko irakora.
RIMENYA ABAKINDI BAKINDI KURI INTERNET 1. Muhe umurongo wa LAN uhamye, usanzwe ukoreshwa n'umuhuza DHCP. 2. Menya amarembo akenewe n'amasezerano TCP/UDP y'ingene urukino ruzoba rwatunganijwe. 3. Kurungika gusa izo mpera kuri aderese ya LAN y'uwo muntu. 4. Nureke uruja n'uruza rw'udukino ruhurikijwe na Windows Firewall ku mpapuro z'urubuga ukoresha. 5. Gupima ukoresheje umuhora w'ubuhinga bwa internet utandukaniye n'uwundi.
Ntiwemere ko umuyoboro wa DMZ ukoreshwa, ntureke uruzitiro rw'umuyagankuba, canke ngo urekure amarembo yose y'ubuyobozi nk'umuti rusange. Nugume utanga amakuru yerekeye uwo muyoboro w'ibanga.
Synix ni umuyobozi w'inyuma y'ububiko. Ntiririmwo urubuga rw'ivyuma vy'ubuhinga ngurukanabumenyi canke uburyo bwo guhanahana amakuru ku mugaragaro butuma ivyo bikenerwa mu bijanye n'imirongo y'ubuhinga bwa none bivaho.

data.name: Content.8B70E3569A9351B28D08
data.value:
SteamCMD ikuraho ikongera igashira ku murongo impapuro za seriveri zigenewe imikino ya Steam ishigikiwe. Synix itegura kopi yayo ikoreshwa na bose mu buryo bwikora; uburyo busanzwe bwo gushiraho seriveri ntibukeneye agapapuro kadasanzwe ka SteamCMD.
NIWIGIYE igikorwa kiriko kirakorwa Nuhitemwo umusereva maze usome Activity & Diagnostics. Amasanamu yerekana ko igikorwa co kwubaka kiriko kiraba. SteamCMD irashobora guhinduranya hagati yo gupakurura, kugabura, gutandukanya, no kwemeza, ku buryo ivyayo bitama bitanga igiharuro c'ibice bisigaye canke igihe kizwi gisigaye.
Nureke akazi k'idisiki karangize n'igihe uruja n'uruza rwo mu muyoboro rugabanutse. Soma ubutumwa bwa nyuma bw'uko igikorwa cagenze neza canke kitagenze neza imbere yo gutangura ikindi gikorwa.
KUREGERA UBUNTU BWO KUZAMUKA Fungura Settings → General → SteamCMD Download Speed. Hitamwo uburyo bushigikiwe bw'umuvuduko muto hanyuma wandike umuvuduko werekanwa, canke uhitemwo umuvuduko wose.
Ivyo bigira ingaruka ku vyazanwe na SteamCMD, ntibigira ingaruka kw'urudandazwa rw'abakinyi, ku vyazanwe n'abakina udukino tudashingiye kuri Steam, canke kw'uruja n'uruza rwose rwo kuri PC.
Kwinjira n'ukunanirwa Amasanamu amwe y'imikino arasaba konti yemewe ya Steam hamwe no kwemeza Umurinzi wa Steam. Koresha urupapuro rwo kwinjira rwa Synix; Ntimushire amakuru y'ikonte mu nyandiko canke mu maraporo.
Ku bijanye n'ikosa ry'ugukurura ryananiwe, soma ikosa ry'ukuri rya SteamCMD wongere ugenzure ikibanza kiri kuri disiki, uburyo bwo kwinjira mu madosiye, uburyo bwo kwinjira ku mbuga ngurukanabumenyi, hamwe n'ibisabwa vyose vy'ikonte. Kwemeza birashobora gusubiramwo amafayili atunganijwe n'uwushiraho, rero gumiza impinduka zisanzwe imbere yo kuyikoresha.

data.name: Content.8B7975E13D85AB64E0E6
data.value: plugin_list_file yashizweho (default default_plugins.txt) ihitamwo ama plugins ya AngelScript. Gukoporora inyandiko ntibituma yongerwa kuri urwo rutonde; kuzigama amakarata/inyandiko zo gushigikira no guhuza n'impinduro ya seriveri.

data.value:
GUSHIRIZA INTEGURIZA BIKENGEJE:

data.name: Content.8EBA131441C4B2AE1004
data.value: Windows dedicated-server mods zikenera Info.json ikorana na serveri, amadosiye muri directory ya Workshop yatoranijwe, hamwe n'inyandiko za PackageName hamwe na bGlobalEnableMod muri Mods/PalModSettings.ini. -workshopdir isubirira inzira na -NoMods ikumira mods. Urwo rukino rukoresha amategeko yo kwinjiza; Synix ntishira mu ngiro amabwirizwa ari muri ako gasandugu.

2. Guhitamwo indirimbo, amategeko yo gufasha hamwe n'urutonde rw'indangamuntu muri dosiye ya ini.
3. Inyandiko yemewe: https://www.assettocorsa.net/

data.name: Content.9A49DE43F45C43C2D5A1
data.value: Bisaba SML ihuye n'iyubakwa rya seriveri yihariye ya mods na dependencies. Ibikoresho vyose bikoresha FactoryGame/Mods. Ibigega vy'abakiriya gusa ntibikora; hakwiye gusuzumwa ko iyo mod ishigikiwe na serveri.

data.name: Content.9C3A77D42EDA0BF1010D
data.value:
Ivyiyumviro vya Empyrion be n'ibiri mu gisata c'ivy'ubuhinga bwa none biratandukanye. Muri Server Options → Mod & Plugin Manager, hitamwo Empyrion scenarios canke Empyrion server mods. Hagarika seriveri hanyuma ugire backup yuzuye y'iseriveri imbere yo guhindura.
Gushiraho IBIRANGO 1. Urutonde rw'ibitabu rurugurura Ikigo c'ivyigwa Steam. Niwiyandikishe kuri ico gisomwa maze urindire ko Steam irangiza kugikurura. Amashusho y'ibikoresho vyo mu buhinga bwa none be n'ibikoresho vy'ubuhinga bwa none ntibigereranywa n'ivy'abakozi. 2. Nuhitemwo Impapuro zo Kwinjiza, hanyuma uhitemwo Ububiko. Nuhitemwo agapapuro k'ivyabaye buri muntu ku giti ciwe kari mu kadirisha Steam k'ububiko bwanyu bwa steamapps\workshop\content\383120. Urashobora kandi guhitamwo uburyo bwose bushoboka. 3. Andika izina ry'ububiko bw'ibikoresho. Ntimukoreshe inomero zonyene zerekana ikibanza c'ubuhinyanyuzi. Gumana iryo zina ry'ububiko kugira uzoze urarisubiramwo. 4. Nusuzume aho ivyo bintu vyandikiwe be n'aho biherereye, uce wemeza ko vyinjijwe. Synix ikoporora ibintu vyose mu Content\Scenarios itarinze kuyikoresha canke ngo ihindure isi. 5. Guhitamwo Scenario vyerekana ivyashitsweko. Nuhitemwo kimwe hanyuma usubire urabe izina ry'igiharuro. Guhinduka ukoresheje ubundi buryo bisaba izina rishasha, ritakoreshwa; Synix ivuga ko ari yo, ariko ntihagire ico ikora ku bibanza vy'ububiko biriho. 6. Nushire mu ngiro ivyo wahisemwo, utanguze serveri, wongere usuzume icegeranyo cayo n'umuhuza w'abakiriya. Bimwe mu bintu bishobora gushika usanga birimwo ibindi bintu canke ibisabwa vyanditswe n'uwubatunganije.
Izina ry'igiteramo ni GameConfig.CustomScenario; izina ry'isi yarokowe ni GameConfig.GameName. Synix ikora backup ya dedicated.yaml imbere yuko ihindura ivyo bibanza kandi igatuma inyandiko ya serveri idahinduka. Ntigusubira gushiraho igiterwa, ijambo ry'ibanga canke ibindi bintu bitajanye n'ivyo.
Gushiraho uburyo bwa SERVER Koresha urubuga rwa Empyrion server mods profile hamwe na Import Package kugirango uhitemwo ZIP ya mod ikurikiranye canke urangize ububiko bwa mod. Nushiremwo DLLs zayo, imfashanyo z'ibikoresho, ibisanzwe, na _Info.yaml igihe bitangwa. Synix ishira ivyo munsi ya Content\Mods; Urwo rukino ruca rwugurura iyo kode igihe rwatanguye. Kwimura kode y'isoko n'abashira ku giti cabo ntibashigikiwe.
Synix ntishira mod loader canke ngo itume mod yahagaritswe ikora mu buryo bwikora. Nukurikize ibisabwa n'uwo mwanditsi, ushizemwo n'ibikoresho vy'inyongera vyo kwinjiza amakuru, uburyo bwo kuyakoresha, be n'uburyo bwo gushiraho umukiriya. Kwinjiza ikintu neza ntibiba vyerekana ko ico gikoresho gihuye n'urukino canke ibindi bikoresho.
INKURU ZIHERUKANYE N'INKURU ZIGISUBIRA Steam ihindura ikopi yayo yo muri Workshop, si iyo kuri serveri yazanwe na Synix. Kugirango uhindure,hagarika seriveri hanyuma winjize impapuro zisanzwe ukoresheje izina ry'ububiko bw'ibintu. Raba nimba uwanditse ico gisomwa akeneye kwinjiza ikindi gishasha. Amadosiye yasubirijwe araronka amakopi y'inyuma; Kwinjiza impinduka si ugusubira kwinjiza neza kandi ntibikuraho amadosiye yabuze muri pakete nshasha.
Urutonde rw'ibikoresho vyose ni rwo ruba rushasha aho kuba urutonde rw'ibintu vyose. Kwishiraho (ntivyasubiye kwemezwa) bisigura ko kwinjiza vyanditswe, ntibisobanura ko dosiye yose yashizweko yamaze gusubira gusuzumwa. Gusubiramwo (Roll Back Import) bihindura ibintu vyose vyatoranijwe, harimwo n'izindi mods ziri mu mugwi umwe, kandi biranka gusubiriza amadosiye yahinduwe hanze ya Synix. Ibikoresho vy'ibihe vyatoranijwe hamwe n'ibikoresho vy'ibihe bikenewe n'isi zakijijwe birakingirwa gukurwaho; umuntu ashobora gusubiramwo ibintu vyafashwe mu buryo bw'ivyitegererezo akabisubiramwo mu buryo bw'ivyitegererezo.

data.name: Content.9CA409AF86EBA5BEC5C1
data.value:
Fungura Configure → Network & RCON kugira usubire urabe ibibanza bikoreshwa n'urukino wahisemwo. Nukoreshe urutonde nyakuri rw'urwo rukino, aho gukoresha urutonde rusangi rw'ibivuko.
INKURU Z'IBIKORWA • Urubuga rw'umukino: Urubuga rw'abakinyi. • Ikiraro c'ubushakashatsi: Amakuru y'umukozi canke ukumenya, mu gihe iyo porotoke y'ubushakashatsi ishigikiwe. • RCON/admin port: Umuyoboro w'ubuyobozi udakenewe. • App/API port: Umurwi w'abakinyi canke wo gucungera inkino.
TCP na UDP ni uburyo butandukanye. Amategeko abiri atandukanye arashobora gukoresha inomero imwe y'ikivuko, ariko abaserura babiri ntibashobora gusangira iherezo ryo kwumviriza ridahuza. Synix iracagenzura kandi imyirondoro yarokotse ku bijanye n'amatati y'ibivuko, harimwo n'ivyatanzwe vyahagaritswe.
Gumana uturimbi twabugenewe twonyene ku bihe bitandukanye no kuzigama ubucuti ubwo ari bwo bwose bukenewe mu rukino hagati y'ibivuko. Ntimwiyumvire ko uburyo bwose bwo gukina ari UDP canke ko buri kibanza c'ibibazo kigereranya uwumviriza vy'ukuri.
KUGENDA si ugukina Akenshi abakinyi ntibakenera kwinjira muri RCON canke ahandi hantu. Mugume mutegura uburyo bwo kuvurwa aho muri, kiretse mufise umugambi udasanzwe wo kuvurwa uvuye kure.
INKURU ZIGENZWE URUKINDO • Minecraft Java na Bedrock zikoresha uburyo butandukanye bwo guhuza; nimukurikize integuro yatoranijwe. • Satisfactory yo mu karere API ikoresha igitsure cayo c'urukino / API; igiciro cayo mu gisata c'isubiramwo ca kera si ikindi gisabwa kuri Synix. • Dune's query-field metadata iserukira RMQ deployment port yayo, atari Steam A2S query service isanzwe. • Rust+ ikoresha igikoresho cayo bwite co gufatanya n'ikindi gikoresho co gukina.
Ibiharuro vy'ibisanzwe vy'ibishushanyo ni ibiharuro vy'intangamarara, si urutonde rw'ibiharuro vyo kwugurura umuyoboro wa internet. Genzura uwumviriza vy'ukuri imbere yo guhindura itegeko rya firewall.

data.name: Content.9D05F59E4F03A202388D
data.value: Dune: Awakening ikoresha uburyo bwemewe bwo gushiraho seriveri yihariye. Hyper-V na hardware virtualization bitegerezwa kuba vyemerewe, kandi Windows Pro canke Enterprise birakenewe. Ku ncuro ya mbere, Synix itangura battlegroup.bat nka Administrator. Nucagure initial-setup hanyuma utegure Ikimenyetso cawe co Kwikingira. Synix irashobora kwinjiza, guhinyanyura, gushigikira, no gutanguza ishirwa mu bikorwa, ariko urukino rufise imashini ziboneka hamwe n'ukuntu zikora. Igitabo c'amategeko: https://duneawakening.com/en/news/dedicated-server-how-to-guide

data.name: Content.A2B1D27FE31D2DC1D587
data.value:
Discord webhooks zirungika ibintu vyatoranijwe na serveri ku murongo. Ni amabwirizwa, si ubuhinga bwa Discord bugenzura kure Synix.
NIWISUBIZE aho ugiye 1. Gushiraho canke kuronka webhook ku nzira ufise uburenganzira bwo kuyobora. 2. Fungura urupapuro rwa Configure → Discord rwa seriveri yatoranijwe. 3. Injira muri webhook uce uhitamwo uburyo bwo gutwara ibintu. 4. Nugumize impagararo. 5. Koresha igikorwa co kugerageza nimba gitegekanijwe, canke wemeze ugutanga mu gihe c'igikorwa categuwe.
Ubutumwa bwo gutangura, guhagarika, kugarura, gusubiriza, no kubungabunga bivana n'inzira zashizwemwo hamwe n'uko igikorwa cabaye koko.
GUKINGIRA URL A webhook URL irimwo ikimenyamenya c'ugushira ahabona. Umuntu wese ayironse yoshobora kurungika ubutumwa kuri ubwo buhinga. Ntugire aho ubika amafoto, ibibazo, inyandiko, n'ibiganiro.
Synix irakingira webhook yayo yarokowe ku mukoresha Windows. Mu gihe urwandiko rwa URL rwerekanywe, nuruhindure canke urwisukure muri Discord, hanyuma uhindure aho urwandiko rwa Synix ruja. Nusuzume amazina y'abakozi n'amakuru y'ivyabaye yarungitswe ku murongo usangiwe.
HAMWE UTABA WARANDITSE ubutumwa Nusuzume inzira y'ibirori yahisemwo, URL, uburyo bwo gushikira umuhora, n'uko PC ishobora gushikira Discord. Gusuzuma ikosa ryatangajwe utarinze gusohora URL yuzuye.
Amenyesha bakoresha umuhora wo gusohoka kuri Discord. Ntibisaba kwugurura irembo ryo kugenzura umuyagankuba w'umuyagankuba winjira.

data.name: Content.A63ABCB912E7792C3276
data.value: Umwubatsi yandika urutonde rw'ijambo ry'ibanga, ariko ntashinga inyifato yo kwemeza inyuguti mpuzamakungu.

data.name: Content.A9DFF42CEEBFF58460BE
data.value: Umuhuza w'ijambo ry'ibanga ry'umwubatsi arandika ijambo ry'ibanga ryatunganijwe na UTF-8 imbere y'ugushira umunyu/ugugereranya. Ibi birashigikira igisomwa mpuzamakungu ku ruhande rwa seriveri; iryo genzura ntiryagerageje uburyo bwose bwa client/input. Amajambo y'ibanga ategerezwa kuba ahuye neza na neza, harimwo n'indome zirimwo.

data.name: Content.AA512DBD74E382E3BFBB
data.value: Uwatunganije ico gisata yashize mu buryo butomoye ibicapo vya UTF-8 mu mazina y'abakinyi b'ico gisata kandi yerekana ivyanditswe bitari mu kilatini. servername igarukira ku binyabuzima 260 harimwo n'uburyo bwo gutondekanya; servername_short kuri 128. Imyandikire y'indome iracahagaze ku bakiriya.

data.name: Content.AB86AD203BD5F34E025B
data.value: Ivyo bisaba ko bakoresha uburyo butandukanye. tModLoader ikoresha impapuro z'amajambo hamwe n'urutonde rw'abemerewe; TShock itwara DLLs zihuye na API ziva muri ServerPlugins. Vanilla Terraria na yo nyene ntishikana. Gushira mu ngiro inzira ya mod/save imbere yo kwinjiza.

data.name: Content.ABF079192878D94E6D93
data.value: Gutegura no kuzigama impapuro zo kwikingira

data.name: Content.AC2F6ED0F16118E96232
data.value:
Niwihitiremwo nimba uzokuraho gusa uruzitiro rw'ububiko bw'ibikoresho canke ko uzokuraho burundu n'amaserveri ukoresha. Ivyo ni ibintu bitandukanye.
GUSUBIRA APPLICATION gusa 1. Nurangize gushiraho, kwimura, canke gushigikira ibintu vyose biriko birakorwa. 2. Guhagarika seriveri zawe biciye kuri Synix, kurindira ko zirangiza kuzigama, hanyuma ukava muri Synix. 3. Nugumane impapuro zemeza ko ibiri ku mibumbe ihambaye ari ivy'ukuri, impapuro zerekana ukuntu ibintu vyagiye birategurwa be n'ivyerekeye uburenganzira bwo kuba muri uwo mubumbe. 4. Gukuraho Synix ukoresheje Windows Apps zashizweko canke umuyobozi w'impapuro.
Gumana C:\Synix, ibipapuro vy'amaserveri y'imigenzo, udukino tw'inyuma, n'ibibanza vyo kuzigama nimba utegekanya kubikoresha ukundi. Kwongera kwinjiza porogaramu ntibisaba gusiba ayo madosiye.
Gukuraho INYIGISHO ZIMWE Z'UMUZIMA Koresha igikorwa Delete c'umukozi yatowe muri Synix hanyuma usome ivyemeza. Gukuraho inyandiko iri ku mbuga ngurukanabumenyi si co kimwe no kwemera gusiba amadosiye y'ibikoresho canke ama backups. Nushimike neza na neza ku makuru azokurwaho.
Ntukoreshe gusiba nk'inzira ngufi yo gutorera umuti ingorane. Ubuhinga bwo kuzigama bubitswe gusa mu kadirisha uriko urafuta si ubwo gusubirana.
Nimba uriko urahindurira ku rindi bara, nurabe neza ko rishobora gutangura kwinjiza neza no kwinjiza isi itegekanijwe imbere yo gukuraho amakuru yawe ya kera.

data.value:
Nuhitemwo iciyumviro kiri ibubamfu kugira usome amabwirizwa ari muri co. Ibiganiro vyose vy'ubufasha bikora mu rurimi wahisemwo.
Ni bishasha kuri SYNIX? Fungura Inzira yo Gushiraho Akabuto ka Mbere muri Gutangura & Gushiraho.
KURONDORA umukozi wo kuri Internet? Nuhitemwo ubwoko bw'igikorwa, nk'ugutunganya ibintu, gukoresha imbuga ngurukanabumenyi, gusubiramwo amakuru canke kugenzura agakino kanaka.
WOBA urondera ikosa? Fyonda kuri Ctrl+F uce urondera ikintu, urukino canke agace gatoyi k'ubutumwa. Ubuhinga bwo kurondera burasuzuma imitwe y'ibiganiro be n'igisomwa cose maze bukerekana igisomwa gihuye.
Koresha buto yo kurondera kugira usubire ku biganiro vyose. Amajambo yo kuvyura n'ayo gushigikira yuguruka mu mushakashatsi wawe igihe gusa uyahisemwo.

data.name: Content.B6FC67DB36AEA1C2C9E1
data.value: ATLAS ikenera uruzitiro rw'amaserver rwatumijwe hamwe n'urushinge rw'amakuru rwa Redis rwarimwo imbere yuko ShooterGameServer.exe ishobora gutangura. Synix izobabuza gutangura gushika ShooterGame\ServerGrid.json na ShooterGame\ServerGrid.ServerOnly.json bihari. Ukoresheje Grapeshot Games ServerGridEditor, shira ayo madosiye muri folder ShooterGame, hanyuma utanguze AtlasTools\RedisDatabase\redis-server_start.bat imbere yo gutangura server ATLAS. Redis igomba kuguma mu karere ka 127.0.0.1 kandi ikivuko 6379 ntigikwiye kwerekanwa kuri Internet.

data.name: Content.B9AD3A6BF122B35896B1
data.value:
Nuhitemwo umusereva maze ukoreshe ibikoresho vyawo bifasha gusuzuma aho umuntu ahuriye n'uwundi canke bikoresha ivyuma vy'abakinyi igihe bihari. Synix ihitamwo ibipimo bihuye n'ikibazo cashigikiwe n'urukino, TCP / UDP / HTTP, API yo mu karere, hamwe n'ubushobozi bwo gutunganya.
IKI VYAVUYEMWO Inyishu y'umuhuza wo ku rwego rwo hasi ntiyerekana ko umukinyi ashobora kwemeza no kwifatanya. Vyongeye, kuba igikorwa kiriho ntibisigura ko ico gikorwa c'ugusaba amakuru categuwe.
Igitigiri c'abakinyi n'amazina y'abakinyi ni ibintu bitandukanye. Umukoresha arashobora gutanga raporo y'igitigiri c'abakinyi bakorana atarinze gushira ahabona urutonde rw'abakinyi. Urutonde rw'abakinyi batarimwo umukinyi n'umwe ntirwemezwa.
IBIKORWA VYAHISHWE CANKA N/A Hari uburyo bwo gukina bwa EOS-only canke crossplay budashira ku mugaragaro ikibazo cemewe canke umuyoboro wo gucunga abakinyi. Synix irashobora kwerekana N/A canke ikareka gukora isuzuma aho kwerekana inkurikizi itari yo.
Nusuzume igisomwa catoranijwe n'uburyo bwo gucunga bwashiriweho Minecraft. Imibare y'abakinyi ba Satisfactory ishingiye ku mwumvikano wa API. Ntiwihende ngo uhe EOS uburenganzira bw'uwuguhingura gusa kugira uhatire umuntu gukora isuzuma.
URUHURUKO RW'ABAGABO n'ABAGENZI Imikino myinshi ya Steam ikoresha ibibazo vya A2S, ariko ivyo sivyo kw'isi yose. Kwiyandikisha, uburyo ukoresha mu gukina n'uburyo ukoresha urubuga biragira ico bikoze ku kuntu umuntu abona ibintu, kandi nta gihe ntarengwa umuntu ashobora kumara abiraba.
Mu gihe umusatirizi adahari muri browser, gerageza uburyo bw'ukwinjira mu mukino kandi usubire urabe ivyanditse muri wo. Guhindura incuro n'izindi ama ports y'ubushakashatsi ata ho ahuriye n'ubundi bushobozi birashobora kuzana ibindi bibazo.
