data.name: Content.BDCE626AE85DA5ADC9CD
data.value:
Koresha Configure ku bibanza bisanzwe Synix icungera. Niwakenera gusuzuma canke guhindura ukuntu urukino rwatunganijwe, nuce ukoresha uburyo bwo guhinyanyura amasanamu y'ibikoresho (configuration-file editor) buri mu gisata ca Server Options.
1. Guhagarika seriveri mu gihe isoma iyo dosiye igihe itangurwa canke ikongera kuyandika igihe iriko irakoreshwa. 2. Gira icegeranyo c'ibiri mu bubiko uheze wemeze serveri na dosiye vyatoranijwe. 3. Soma ibiharuro bihari be n'ivyiyumviro vyatanzwe. 4. Hindura gusa ivyo ushaka guhindura. 5. Nimuvugurure amakosa y'umwanditsi, mwongere musubiremwo n'imburizi zayo. 6. Kubika, gutangura seriveri biciye kuri Synix, no kuraba urutonde rwa nyuma rw'urukino.
IMIYANDIKO YAShigikiwe Synix iratanga uburyo bwo gukwirikirana mu buryo bwemewe bwa INI/properties, JSON, XML, YAML, n'ubundi buryo bwihariye. Si buri dosiye canke ihitamwo ryose rifise umuyobozi arongowe. Ubuhinduzi bwa YAML burashigikira imiterere ya nested, urutonde rwa indented, hamwe n'ingero z'umurongo umwe mugihe ugumana commentaires na indentation. Ibintu bigoye YAML nk'inkingi, amazina y'amazina, amakusanyirizo y'umurongo, hamwe n'agaciro k'umurongo urenze umwe birahakwa kutabikwa.
Nugumize impfunguruzo z'ugutunganya ibintu, ibiciro vyemewe, amazina y'ikarata be n'amabwirizwa nk'uko vyitezwe mu rukino. Ntimuhindure kugira ngo bihuze n'ururimi rw'interface.
GUSUBIRA UMWANYA si ukwinonora imitsi Idosiye yatunganijwe neza irashobora kuba igifise impagararo zidashobora guhuza. Mods canke impinduka z'urukino zishobora kwongerako amahitamwo umu editeri atazi. Nusuzume ko urukino rwatwaye dosiye n'isi vyategekanijwe inyuma yo gutangura.
Nimba hari uwundi muntu canke urukino ruhinduye iyo dosiye igihe iriko iruguruka, nuce uyisubiramwo wongere uyigereranye imbere y'uko uyibika. Amadosiye y'urukino ashobora kuba arimwo impapuro z'ibanga canke ibimenyetso bishobora gusomwa; gusubiramwo no kuzigorora imbere y'uko usangira na zo.
SatisfactoryUbu ni muzima API Uburyo bwo guhitamwo buva mu Kigo cayo kijejwe gucungera ibintu kandi butandukaniye n'uguhindura amakarata y'ibikoresho biri kuri disike.

data.name: Content.C3732C45553C69AA02C1
data.value:
Nuhitemwo Configure for an existing server, canke ukoreshe idirisha ryo gushiraho mu gihe uriko urarema irindi. Hindura gusa ibijanye n'urukino rwawe.
Uburyo bwo gutangura n'ubw'inyongera Uburyo bwo gutangura bushimika ku mahitamwo asanzwe hamwe n'itegeko ryo gutangura ryasabwe. Uburyo bwateye imbere bwerekana izindi nzego z'ubuhinga, harimwo RCON ishigikiwe hamwe n'amahitamwo yo gutanguza. Guhindura uburyo ntibikuraho ibiharuro vyazigamwe. Amenyesha Discord araboneka mu buryo bwose.
IBIKURU BIKURIKIRA • Muri rusangi: Izina rya seriveri, urukino, urukurikirane rw'urukino, n'amahitamwo y'uburyo bwo gukina bukoreshwa. • Umutekano: Ijambo ry'ibanga hamwe n'izindi ngingo zo kwinjira zishigikiwe na template. • Ihingurwa ry'isi: Izina ry'isi, imbuto, ubunini be n'amahitamwo y'isi. • Network & RCON: Imikino ishigikiwe, ibibazo, mugenzi/API, hamwe n'impande z'ubuyobozi. • Automation: Backup/update-on-start na maintenance itegekanijwe. • Discord: Ibibanza vyo kubimenyesha n'inzira y'ivyabaye. • Install & Launch: Ububiko bwo kwinjiza hamwe n'amahitamwo yo kwinjiza ashigikiwe.
Imirima y'imikino itemewe n'amategeko ni iy'ibigirankana. Urwo rukino rushobora kuba rufise ico rwisunga canke rukaba rudashigikiwe; Gushira ibindi bisobanuro muri iryo tegeko si uburyo bubereye bwo gusubiriza.
IBIKURU BINDI BIVUGA Amakuru yerekeye seriveri → Amagenamiterere asabwa → Gusuzuma → Kubika seriveri
Ubwo buryo bwo gutunganya ibarabara burerekana ko ryiteguye, ntiburerekana ukuntu igikorwa co kuyarimura canke kuyishiramwo kiriko kiragenda. Mu gihe impinduka zikenewe zimaze kwemezwa, Synix irafungura intambwe 3 kugira ngo ushobore gusuzuma amahitamwo yawe, hanyuma ikureko uruzitiro rwa "Save Server". Guhindura impfunguruzo z'ibikoresho Bisubize mu bubiko gushika aho amahitamwo yasubiwemwo yerekanwa mu Gusuzuma. Utegerezwa guhitamwo Gukiza ubuzima bwawe; kwugurura Isubiramwo ntiyigera ibika mu buryo bwikora. Igihe hari ikintu gikeneye kwitwararikwa, nuze urasoma neza na neza ubutumwa buri mu ntango y'ico gisomwa.
Igihe uriko uragira ico uhinduye kuri serveri, banza uhagarike iyo mpinduka igira ingaruka ku madosiye canke ku mahitamwo asomwa igihe iriko iratangura. Gushiraho impinduka z'umwirondoro wiwe; ntibitanga icemeza c'uko urukino ruriko rurakoreshwa rwakurikije izo ngingo ngenderwako. Subira usubire kwugurura biciye kuri Synix igihe urukino rubisavye.

data.name: Content.CBFC11B8C03869110CF7
data.value:
Fungura Configure → Automation kugirango seriveri yatoranijwe ihitemwo akazi gakorwa imbere yuko ishirwa mu ngiro.
GUSUBIRA MU NTANGO Nushireho aka kamenyetso kugira ngo gashobore gukora backup y'igisata gihagaze imbere yuko igikorwa gitangura. Gushiraho umuzi w'igicapo n'ugukomeza muri porogaramu Settings → Backups.
Gusubiza ibintu mu buryo iyo habaye impanuka bica bitangura mu buryo bw'ibigirankana mu kureka ibikorwa bisanzwe vyo gusubiriza. Ama backups y'intango ntasubirira kugumana uturimbi twigenga two kugarura ibintu imbere y'amahinduka akomeye.
UPDATE ON START Nushireho aka kamenyetso kugira ngo ushobore gusuzuma ko urukino rwemewe imbere y'uko rutangura. Ihindura amakarata y'umukino, si porogarama ya Synix.
Gusuzuma ko ibintu vyahindutse si icemeza yuko igihe cose umuntu atanguye gukora ikintu, ico kintu kizoca gihera. SteamCMD hamwe n'uwutunganya urwo rukino ni bo bafata ingingo y'ibikenewe.
IBIGENZEKO VY'UBUHAMYA N'IBIGENDERWA Igikorwa co Kwemeza cakozwe n'intoki gishobora gusanura canke gusubiramwo gupakurura amadosiye atunganijwe n'uwashizeho. Kubungabunga impinduka imbere yo kuvugurura canke kwemeza; ntiwiyumvire ko amadosiye y'imigenzo yama aguma ataho ahengamiye.
Nusuzume ivyo wohitamwo Nugumize impagararo maze ukore igikorwa co kwugurura. Soma ivyavuye mu gikorwa kugira ushobore gusubiramwo, gusanura, no gutanguza. Kurangiza ico gikino ntibiba vyerekana ko isi yaco yarungitswe neza.
Nushireho umwanya uhagije w'ivyandikano vya kera, ivy'ibibanza vyo kuvoma, ivy'imfashanyo z'igihe gito be n'ivy'urukino rwashiriweho. Mu gihe igikorwa c'imbere y'ugutangura kimenyesheje ko hari ikitagenda neza, nurondere imvo yavuzwe aho gutanguza seriveri imwe hanze ya Synix kugira ngo uyirengere.

data.name: Content.CD4007BB408F0C6825C6
data.value: Fungura Documents\American Truck Simulator\config.cfg maze usete uset g_console "1". Tangura urukino rusanzwe rwa American Truck Simulator, ufyonde umwirondoro n'ikarata vyawe, ufyonde ~ kugira ufungure console, hanyuma ukore export_server_packages. Funga urukino, uce ufyonda kuri Start in Synix. Synix izokwinjiza amadosiye yashizweho mu buryo bwikora.

data.name: Content.CEBB295EB1521FABB36D
data.value:
Fungura Imyiteguro y'umukozi yatowe imbere y'uko itangura ubwa mbere canke igihe hari ikitagenda neza. Igereranya ivyemezwa n'iyo profil, nk'amadosiye, ibihe vyo gukora, uburyo, ikibanza kiri kuri disiki, ibibuga, uko igikorwa kimeze, hamwe n'ivyandikano bijanye.
NIWITONDERE IKI VYAVUTSE • Kwitegura: Nta kibazo c'uguhagarika cabonetse mu gusuzuma kwariho. • Gusuzuma: Nusome icegeranyo maze uhitemwo nimba hari ico ukeneye gukora. • Blocked: Gutorera inyishu ikibazo cavuzwe imbere yo kubandanya.
Kuba umuntu yiteguriye gukora ikintu ntibisigura ko yokora ibintu vyose vyavuzwe. Nusuzume ingingo utegekanya gufata be n'icemeza ko yafashwe.
IGIHE UHEZE GUSUBIRA UMURYANGO MUSHYA Intango ya mbere irashobora kuvoma amadosiye, gushiraho igihe c'imikorere gishigikiwe, gutanguza uburyo, no kurindira ko umukino utangura. Nukurikize ubuyobozi bw'ugutangura bwa mbere n'ubw'ibikorwa n'ibipimo vyo gusuzuma aho gufata icegeranyo ca dashboard gishizwe nk'urukino rwashizweko.
Imikino imwimwe ikenera amasezerano, kwemeza ko umuntu ari mu mugwi w'abakinyi, canke gushiraho uburyo bw'ukwinjira muri uwo mugwi imbere y'uko umuntu yinjira. Nushitse iyo ntambwe mu kibanza urwo rukino rusaba.
GUSHINZURA UKWISUZUMANA Gushiraho, gutangura, guhagarika, no kugenzura ibiva mu bikorwa vy'igitabu Synix yabonye. Ntibiremezwa bisigura ko ata musaruro wanditswe; ntibisigura ko uwo mukino uzwi ko utoroshe.
Ivyashitsweko n'aba Ready canke ivyaranguwe n'abari mu karere ntibitanga icemeza c'uko umuntu azoronka internet, Mods nziza canke izoshobora gukorana n'abakiriya bose. Mu gusozera, ni ukugerageza isano n'isi vyategekanijwe.

data.name: Content.D04B8B2F340C3B82596E
data.value:
Inyanduruko y'ivyandikano ya seriveri yatowe irazigama amadosiye ari muri dosiye y'ivyandikano y'iyo seriveri. Nusuzume aho urwo rukino rurokora isi yarwo imbere y'uko wishingira kuri rwo.
GUSUBIRA IBIKURIKIRA 1. Guhagarika seriveri biciye kuri Synix no kurindira ko inzira zayo ziva. 2. Guhitamwo igikorwa co gusubiriza mu matora y'umukozi. 3. Nusuzume aho uriko urava, iyo uriko uraja, ingene woba ungana be n'ikibanza kihari. 4. Nushimike maze urindire ko birangira. 5. Nuhitemwo ahanditse Open Backup Folder kugira ngo uronke inyandiko y'ububiko. Nugumane urupapuro rwerekana ko ico kintu kitanduye.
UBUHAMYA Iyo backup irimwo n'ububiko bwo kwinjiza, atari gusa ububiko buto bwo kuzigama. Imikino mininiminini irashobora gukenera umwanya munini n'ibibanza vyinshi vyo kubikwamwo.
Ibibanza vyo muri AppData, Documents, iyindi drive, canke imashini nyabwonko y'umukino ishobora kuba iri hanze y'iyo dosiye. Nushire ivyo vyandikano mu gakaye ukoresheje uburyo buzwi muri urwo rukino.
KURONDEREZA no kubungabunga Umuzi usanzwe w'isubiramwo ni C:\Synix\BackupGames. Settings → Backups uragufasha guhitamwo iyindi mizi no gushiraho urugero rw'ibisubirwamwo.
Ahantu uriko uraja hategerezwa kuba hanze y'ububiko bwa seriveri y'inkomoko. Guhindura umuzi wo gusubiriza ntibikuraho canke ngo bihanagure ububiko buriho; Nusuzume aho hantu ha kera urabe ko hari ivyandikano vya kera.
Kubungabunga bikuraho inyandiko zishaje igihe igipimo catanzwe kirengewe mugihe co gukora backup. Nugumane ibibanza vyamaho vyo gutabarizamwo hanze y'ico kibanza co gutabarizamwo.
Nushire iyindi kopi y'ibiriho bihambaye mu bubiko butandukanye. Iyo disike yananiwe, irashobora gusambura serveri be n'amasanamu y'ivyandikano vyazigamwe kuri iyo disike nyene. ZIP y'ububiko bw'ugushirwa mu ngiro hanze ntiyica buhoro buhoro igikoresho c'imashini canke uruzitiro rw'amakuru.

data.name: Content.D2EE952679F0F36E81E6
data.value:
Soma ubutumwa bwa Windows imbere yo guhitamwo ico uhindura. Imfashanyo y'igicapo yahagaritswe, ikosa ry'ugushikira idosiye, be n'igihe c'urukino kidahari ni ingorane zitandukanye.
SYNIX NTAKIZOKWISHIRIZWA canke ngo Yugururwe Koresha icegeranyo c'ivyavuye mu bushakashatsi bwagizwe WinGet impapuro ubidzz.Synix. Mu gihe ugusubiriza dosiye vyerekana ko uruhusha rwabujijwe, funga ikoreshwa rya Synix ukoresheje iyo nzira bisanzwe hanyuma wongere ugerageze. Nusuzume uburyo bwo kwinjira mu madosiye n'ubutumwa bwa porogaramu y'umutekano mu gihe iyo ngorane ibandanije.
Ntuzimye amakuru ya seriveri canke ngo uhagarike gukingira nk'igikorwa co gusanura.
IJAMBO RY'UBUZIMA Impanuro y'icubahiro irashobora gutanga More info → Run anyway, bivanye na politike ya Windows. Kuba hariho ubwo bushobozi si ikimenyamenya c'uko idosiye itekanye. Nurabe neza ko ari iryavuzwe n'abategetsi, wongere usuzume neza iyo mburi imbere y'uko ufata ingingo yo kubandanya.
SMART APP CONTROL Ibi birashobora guhagarika porogaramu igihe Windows idashobora gushiraho umwizero ukwiye. Nta porogarama y'umuntu n'umwe ifise yo guca mu nzira z'iyindi nka Run ya SmartScreen. Ntuhagarike ibintu vy'umutekano vya Windows kugira gusa ukore Synix.
ANTIVIRUS OR HASH FAILURE Nusuzume neza aho yafatiwe n'aho yaguye. Ntiwiyumvire ko imburi ari iy'ikinyoma kubera ko iyo dosiye yitwa Synix. Hash SHA-256 ihwanye irerekana dosiye yakurutswe; ntibituma umuntu yizigirwa canke ngo hagirwe amasezerano y'ugushira umukono kuri kode.
Nushire ahabona uburyo nyabwo bwo kugabisha no kwinjiza ibintu mu buryo butarimwo amakuru y'ibanga. Niwirinde kutagira aho uhuriye n'abandi canke guca mu nzira y'ukugenzura uruzitiro rw'abashiraho.

data.name: Content.DEF7504305FCA62C7644
data.value:
Koresha Settings → Backups kugirango ushobore guheza Synix export/import. Ivyo biratandukanye n'ugushira ku rutonde urupapuro rw'impapuro rumwe ruriho.
NURONDERE IBIKwiye kwimuka Ibidandazwa bitumizwa mu mahanga birimwo igiti nyamukuru ca C:\Synix. Serveri canke amadosiye yo gusubiriza hanze yayo hamwe n'udukino tw'inyuma birakenera gukoreshwa ukwavyo. Niwandike aho bagiye imbere y'uko batangura. Ama preferences asanzwe ya Windows na yo nyene ashobora gukenera gusuzumwa ku kibanza c'ugushikirwako.
KUVA mu mahanga 1. Nuhagarike amaserveri wongere urangize ibikorwa vyo kuyibungabunga, ivyo kuyikuraho be n'ivyo kuyisubiriza. 2. Hitamwo gusohora mu buryo bwanditse canke busanzwe. 3. Nucagure aho uherereye hanze y'igiti c'inkomoko wongere usuzume ingano be n'ibibanza vy'imfatakibanza. 4. Kugira ushobore kwinjiza amakuru mu buryo bw'ibanga, hitamwo ijambo ry'ibanga rikomeye ryo kwimurira abantu n'ibintu kandi uribike ukwavyo. 5. Rindira ko igicapo ca .synix backup kirangira, uce ugisuzuma.
Nuhitemwo uburyo bwo kwikingira bubereye Ikoreshwa ry'ubuhinga bwo guhishira amakuru mu buryo bw'ibanga rirakingira ipaki kandi rigashigikira uburyo bwo kwimurira ku mbuga ngurukanabumenyi amakuru yemewe kuri konti ya Windows.
Kwinjiza ibidandazwa mu mahanga mu buryo busanzwe ntibihishurirwa. Amadosiye y'urukino be n'ivyandikano biri muri yo birashobora guhishura amabanga. Gukoporora Windows-bonded encrypted values ntibituma ubwavyo bikoreshwa mu yindi compte.
IMPORT 1. Nubanze usubire inyuma amakuru ya Synix y'aho uriko uraja. 2. Fungura ibipimo vyo kwinjiza/kugenzura hanyuma uhitemwo igipfunyika wifuza. 3. Tanga ijambo ry'ibanga ryo kurungika mu gihe ribisabwe, wongere ugenzure ipaki. 4. Nusuzume aho uriko uraja, ivyo ukeneye kuri disiki, n'imburizi zo gusubiriza. 5. Nureke igikorwa co guharura, gusuzuma no gusubiza ibintu mu buryo kirangire. 6. Nusuzume inzira ya seriveri, amarembo, urutonde rw'ibizokorwa, ibibanza vyo gusubiriza, be n'ivyemeza imbere y'uko utangura ikintu ico ari co cose.
Nusubize Satisfactory mu gihe ideni ryayo ryo mu karere canke ihuriro ryayo rikingiwe ritakigenderanye. Nugumane agapapuro k'inyanduruko be n'amakuru ya kera gushika amaserveri yinjijwe asuzumwe.
Ibijanye no kwimura amakuru biriko birashigikirwa birazigama ikopi y'ububiko bw'amakuru imbere y'uko bimurwa. Mu gihe kwinjiza canke kwimura bitashobotse, gumiza iyo kopi n'ubutumwa bwo kugarura aho gusubiriza urubuga rukora mu gihe Synix iriko irakoreshwa.

data.name: Content.E03D856AEDD6B1B81DFD
data.value:
Install & Launch irimwo agapapuro k'umukozi yatowe hamwe n'amahitamwo y'ugutanguza ashigikiwe. Nugumane itegeko ryatanzwe kiretse gusa utazi imvugo y'imvugo y'urwo rukino.
IBIGANIRO VY'UBUHINGA Koresha uburyo bwa Advanced igihe hakenewe imvugo zitari zo. Nusuzume indome, inzira zishobora gukoreshwa, n'amazina y'ibikenewe mu rukino. Synix iramaze gutanga ivyiyumviro vyashigikiwe; kwongerako iyindi kopi birashobora gutuma haboneka impagararo ziteye kubiri.
Ntimuhindure amajwi y'ibishobora guhinduka canke ngo musubirize igiciro c'ubuhinga gitegerezwa guhindurwa n'izina ryaco. Ntimwigere mwongerako ivyemeza ku mabwirizwa kugira gusa biborohere gusubiramwo.
Amadosiye yo gutanguza amasanamu yoherejwe hanze Ku ma profiles ashigikiwe, Server Options → Create Batch File yandika itegeko ryo gutanguza ryateguwe muri script.
Iyo dosiye irashobora kuba irimwo impapuro z'ibanga zishobora gusomwa canke ibimenyetso vy'umurimo kugira ngo ishobore gukora mu buryo bwigenga. Nuzigame ku giti cawe wongere uzigenzure imbere y'uko ubigurisha canke ukabitwara ahandi.
Gushira ico gisomwa hanze ya Synix ntibituma ibikorwa vyose vya Synix vyugarwa, ugukorana kw'abacungera umutekano, gushigikira canke kubungabunga. Ntimukagikorere mu gihe Synix ifise iyo porogaramu ikora.
ABARUNDI barungitswe gukorera mu mahanga Amasanamu amwe n'amwe y'udukino aratangura gukoresha ibikoresho vyawo bwite aho gukoresha uburyo bumwe busanzwe bwa seriveri. Ivyo bikoresho birashobora gusaba uruhusha rw'inyongera kandi ntibishobora gushigikira kohereza dosiye yo gutanguza. Nukurikize ubuyobozi bw'umukino w'iyo profile aho gusubiriza ikindi gikora canke ico gipfukisho.

data.name: Content.E0B717C5C29D61FBF410
data.value:
GUSHIRIZA INTEGURIZA BIKENGEJE:

data.name: Content.EA307763F93AA4306555
data.value:
Nukoreshe igikoresho cemewe. Harimwo .NET runtime ikenewe na Synix; Abasuku b'udukino bashobora kuba bagikeneye ibisabwa.
NIWISUBIRE uburyo bwo kwinjiza • MSI: Kuramo SynixSetup.msi, uyitanguze, uce wugurura Synix Control Panel muri Start menu. Ahantu hakunze gukoreshwa na buri mukoresha ni %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. • WinGet: Koresha agapapuro nyene ubidzz.Synix. Ikiganiro WinGet Installation and Updates kirimwo amategeko. • Impapuro zishobora gutunganywa ku giti cazo: Nushire impapuro zisanzwe zitunganijwe ku giti cazo mu bubiko bushobora kwandikwamwo maze uzirungikeyo. Kwimura iyo porogarama ntisobanura kwimura amaserveri yanyu yose.
Amajwi y'abategetsi: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/releases/latest
Rungika Rungika 1. Nuhebe ivyo kwinjiza, ivyo gusubiriza n'ivyo kubungabunga. 2. Guhagarika seriveri z'urukino mu gukoresha Synix no gufunga Synix nk'uko bisanzwe. 3. Koresha ubuhinga bwo kwinjiza canke bw'ugushiraho uburyo wahisemwo. 4. Subira ufungure Synix uheze urabe ko ivyo wanditse kuri serveri be n'inzira yavyo ari vyo.
Mu gihe usubirije ubuhinga bwa kera bushingiye kuri EXE na MSI, banza ukureho ubuhinga bwa kera. Gumana amakuru y'umukozi wayo hamwe n'amafolda y'umukozi yigenga. Ntimukazimye C:\Synix kugira ngo muvugurure porogarama.
Kwugurura porogaramu ntibihindura udukino uba uriko urakoresha. Koresha igikorwa ca Update c'umukozi yatowe kuri ico.
Mu gihe Windows ivuga ko uruhusha rwanse mugihe bariko basubiriza ico gisomwa, kuraba ko ico gisomwa gisubirizwa kitakiriho. Ntiwandikire hejuru y'igikorwa kiriko kirakorwa canke ngo ukure amakuru ya seriveri kugira uhindure ikosa.

data.name: Content.F77CEDCB39BB6AFDDB17
data.value:
Synix iragenzura ko umuyagankuba ukoreshwa neza imbere y'uko ikoreshwa kugira ngo igabanye amahirwe yo kuremereza umuyagankuba. Mu gihe intango itevye canke ihagaritswe, soma ikibazo c'uburyo cavuzwe.
GUSHINGIRA ABAGENZI AKAZU Niwemere kwibuka Windows n'ibikorwa vyo mu nyuma hamwe n'urukino. Nuzigame ikibanza ku kadisiki kugira ushobore gushiraho amakuru mashasha, amadosiye y'igihe gito, ayo kuzigama n'ayo gusubiriza.
Umupaka w'ukwibuka wa Minecraft utegekanijwe ugira ingaruka ku rukino/igihe co gukina. Si iherezo rikomeye ry'ikintu cose gikorerwa mu rukino urwo ari rwo rwose.
Amasanamu y'ibikoresho ntashira serveri mu bubiko bwa CPU/RAM canke ngo yemeze ko Windows idashobora kubura ibikoresho. Koresha uburyo bwo kugenzura imfashanyo be n'ibiharuro vy'ibikoresho vy'imashini ya PC yose kugira utahure neza umutwaro w'ukuri.
UMURINZI W'UMURYANGO Ico gikoresho c'ubushakashatsi co kugabisha umurongo kigenzura ibintu bidasanzwe bijanye n'ibipimo vy'umurongo w'imiyagankuba/ibikoresho, kikongera kikerekana ibikorwa bizwi vya SteamCMD kugira kigabanye imburizi z'ibinyoma.
Si uruzitiro rw'umuriro, uruzitiro rw'uruja n'uruza canke igikorwa co gukingira DDoS. Kwimenyekanisha ntivyerekana uwateye canke ngo vyemeze ko hari igitero cabaye.
Igihe uhawe imburizi, nuce ugereranya ivyo ukora n'ivyo umaze kuvoma, ivyo umaze kuzigama, be n'ibindi bikoresho. Nusuzume inyandiko zikenewe imbere y'uko uhindura uburyo bwo gucungera umutekano canke uburyo bwo kwinjiza amakuru.

data.name: Content.F83D1D2838B71617191E
data.value:
Nuhitemwo agace ka Rust wongere usuzume isi yako, akaranga kayo, ingene uriko urakina, ivyo wipfuza, be n'ivyo ukunda imbere yo gutangura.
UBUZIMA bw'umukozi Synix itanga igiciro ca +server.identity gishigikiwe kivuye kuri identite ya serveur. Gumana ibibanza bitandukanye n'amazina y'ibintu bitandukanye kugira ngo ntibasangire isi canke ibintu bimwe bitari mu mugambi.
RUST+ Gushiraho uburyo budasanzwe bw'ukwinjira muri porogaramu bufasha kuri serivisi y'umugenzi, hanyuma ukurikize ivyo Rust isaba ku bijanye n'ugushira hamwe n'urusobe rw'urubuga. Ikibanza cayo gisigaye gitandukanye n'umukino w'abakinyi hamwe n'ubuyobozi bwa RCON.
Nusuzume ama ports y'ukuri yashizweho aho gusubiramwo amategeko avuye ku yindi serveri ya Rust. Urinde ivyemeza RCON kandi ntuvyamamaze kugira ufashe abantu kuja muri uwo mugwi.
VANILLA NA OXIDE Vanilla akoresha amadosiye yo kuri serveri yemewe. Guhitamwo Oxide vyongerako urwego rushigikiwe inyuma y'amadosiye Steam. Gushiraho icegeranyo ntibitora canke ngo bigenzure ivyongeweko vyose.
Koresha Mod & Plugin Manager's supported local workflow for a detected Oxide/uMod installation. Ama plugins aracakeneye impinduro zihuye n'izindi hamwe n'amasôko yizigirwa.
Synix isubira gushiraho igihe c'ugukoresha Oxide gishigikiwe inyuma y'ivugururwa canke kwemezwa kwa Rust igihe urwo rwego rwatoranijwe. Kugira ngo usubire mu madosiye ya Vanilla yemewe, hindura amahitamwo y'igihimba maze utanguze inzira y'ibikorwa ya Update canke Validate ishigikiwe.
Imbere y'uko ihinguriro canke urukino bihinduka, nuzigame isi, uburyo bwo gutunganya ibintu, n'amakuru y'inyongera. Gusuzuma inyandiko z'inyamaswa n'iz'ibinyabuzima vyo mu bwoko bwa Oxide inyuma yo gusubira gutangura; Kwimura icegeranyo c'urupapuro rw'inkuru nziza ntivyerekana ko ivyuma vyose vyinjijwe neza.

data.name: Content.F89E75BB7B8DECBE4C2B
data.value: Inyandiko za ServerModSetup muri dedicated_server_mods_setup.lua download Workshop mods; modoverrides.lua irabashoboza hamwe n'amahitamwo yabo y'isi/shard. Koresha inzira y'ugushiraho serveri ikora n'iy'igitereko. Mods z'abakiriya gusa ziri ukwazo; gusigasira ama backups y'urusobe imbere yo guhindura uburyo bwa seriveri.

data.name: Content.FC0C7D5D72BB74B7579E
data.value: Nusuzume amategeko agenga uruhusha imbere y'uko wemera ko server itangura gukora.

data.name: Content.FC8AD725F17E1C50CF67
data.value: Serveri irimwo PCServer-AFFGame.ini. Synix igumana dosiye yose yashizweko kandi ihindura gusa izina rya seriveri ryemejwe, ijambo ry'ibanga ry'umuyobozi, hamwe n'ivyandikano vy'abakinyi.

data.name: Content.FE08796B9B27C2F7036C
data.value: Kubera ko ATLAS ari icuma gikoresha ubuhinga bwa none, ntishobora kurema ayo madosiye mu gutangura ico cuma. Koresha Grapeshot Games ServerGridEditor kugira ngo ukore n'ugushira hanze uruzitiro. Nushire ServerGrid.json na ServerGrid.ServerOnly.json muri dosiye ya ShooterGame ya seriveri. Imbere yo gutangura ATLAS, tanga AtlasTools\RedisDatabase\redis-server_start.bat hanyuma ureke Redis igume ikora. Gumana Redis ifitaniye isano na 127.0.0.1; nturekure port 6379 kuri LAN, router, canke Internet. Umwanditsi mukuru: https://github.com/GrapeshotGames/ServerGridEditor

data.name: Content.FE8445D560EC3691D1E1
data.value: Nusuzume ingene Synix yubaka itegeko rikoreshwa mu gutanguza iyi seriveri.

data.name: Content.FF6EEAB0A9848FC8CD5C
data.value: Synix irema imiterere yuzuye ya serverconfig.xml ikorwa na seriveri kandi itegura izina rya seriveri, ijambo ryibanga, ikivuko, umupaka w'abakinyi, isi, imbuto, n'ubunini bw'isi. Iyindi migambi yo gukina iguma ishobora guhindurwa mu mpinyanyuro y'ibikoresho.

data.name: Language.Description
data.value: Hitamwo ururimi rukoreshwa na Synix. Amabwirizwa y'urukino be n'ibintu vyazigamwe ntibihindurwa.

data.name: Uninstall.Everything
data.value: Gukuraho porogaramu, seriveri ziyobowe n'amakuru ya Synix

data.name: Uninstall.Keep
data.value: Gusiba preferences za application Synix, cache, temporary files na entries zo gutangura. Nugumane C:\Synix yose, ivyandikano vy'udukino, ivyandikano vyo kuzigama n'ivy'ugusubiza ibintu mu buryo. Gumana urutonde rw'amasereri n'impagararo muri SynixData\servers.json. Koresha urwo rutonde rwarazigamwe hamwe n'izo mpagararo igihe Synix yongeye kwinjizwa.

data.name: Uninstall.Review
data.value: Nusuzume amafayili n'amadosiye biri hasi imbere yo kuyakuraho. Ibibanza vyashizweko akamenyetso ko kuzigama ntibizokurwaho. Gukurwaho ni ukw'ibihe vyose. Mu gihe iyo porogarama itazoshobora gukurwaho mu nyuma, ayo madosiye azoca ahanagurwa.

data.name: Uninstall.Confirm
data.value: Naraziganije ibintu vyose nkeneye. Nshaka gusiba burundu ayo madosiye.

data.name: Uninstall.Stop
data.value: Funga Synix hanyuma uhagarike seriveri zose z'urukino imbere yo gukuraho amakuru ya seriveri.

data.name: Uninstall.Changed
data.value: Inyandiko zo kuri serveri zarahindutse. Subira urabe ayo madosiye imbere y'uko uhanagura ikintu ico ari co cose.

data.name: Uninstall.Failed
data.value: Gukurwaho kwarahagaze. Amadosiye amwamwe ashobora kuba yaramaze guhanagurwa. Synix iracariho. Subira urabe amafolda asigaye imbere y'uko usubira kugerageza.

data.name: Uninstall.BackupsOption
data.value: Nimuce kandi amafayili y'ububiko bw'ibikoresho n'ay'ugusubiza mu buryo

data.name: Uninstall.BackupsKeep
data.value: Amadosiye yo gushigikira n'ayo kugarura azogumizwa:

data.name: Uninstall.BackupsDelete
data.value: Amadosiye y'isubiramwo n'ugusubizaho yatowe kugira ahindurwe:

data.name: Uninstall.NoBackups
data.value: Nta bikoresho vyo gusubiriza vyabonetse mu bibanza bizwi vyo gusubiriza Synix.

data.name: Uninstall.KeptLocations
data.value: Ibibanza vyazigamwe (kiretse ama backups yatoranijwe neza haruguru):

data.name: Uninstall.CloseApp
data.value: Funga Synix imbere yo kuyikuraho. Hamwe gusa iyo porogarama yokurwaho, seriveri z'urukino zirashobora kubandanya zikora.

data.name: History.Unavailable
data.value: Amateka ntiyashobora gusomwa canke kuzigamwa. Nusuzume uburyo bwo kwinjira mu madosiye n'ibibanza vy'ubusa kuri disike.

data.name: History.Recovered
data.value: Hari ivyanditswe bimwebimwe vy'ivya kahise bitumvikana vyasibwe.

data.name: History.Retention
data.value: Bishirijwe hagati ya Synix sessions. Gushika kuri {0} z'ibiherutse kwinjizwa kuri serveri. Amajambo y'ibanga n'amabwirizwa yo gutanguza birabujijwe.

data.name: BackupHealth.Notice
data.value: Bivanye n'amadosiye be n'amakarata y'amakori, si ugusuzuma ubugororotsi bundi bushasha. Ama backups arengeje imisi 7 arashimikwako.

data.name: History.Empty
data.value: Nta bikorwa vyanditswe kuri iyi seriveri gushika ubu.

data.name: History.NoMatches
data.value: Nta kintu na kimwe gihuye n'ivyo wanditse.

data.name: Appearance.Description
data.value: Hitamwo iciyumviro, ibara ry'indome be n'uburyo bwo gucungera. Amahinduka aratangura guhera ubwo nyene kandi akazigamwa mu buryo bwikora.

data.name: Settings.Privacy.ActivityCount.Description
data.value: Ntibisabwa: kurungika kode y'ikiganiro kuri synix.info buri minota 10 mugihe Synix iriko irakoreshwa, harimwo no mu nyuma. Nta makuru ya serveri yohererejwe. Ibiharuro birarangira inyuma y'iminota 15. Mu bisanzwe. Urashobora kuwuzimya ngaha.

data.name: RemoteManager.Description
data.value: Huza iyi mudasobwa kuri konti yawe kugira urabe, utanguze, uhagarike, usubire gutangura no gushigikira seriveri ku rubuga rwa Synix. Uburyo bwo gushikira kure burahagaritswe gushika wemeye ko duhuza hano.

data.name: RemoteManager.ManagePairing
data.value: Gushira hamwe canke guhagarika iyi mudasobwa

data.name: RemoteManager.Heading
data.value: Kugenzura iyi mudasobwa ukoresheje urubuga rwa Synix

data.name: RemoteManager.ComputerName
data.value: Izina rya mudasobwa ryerekanwa ku rubuga

data.name: RemoteManager.Instructions
data.value:
Niwinjirire kuri urwo rubuga maze wandike iyi kode. Wemeze izina ry'ukoresha ryawe gusa ngaha.
Gumana Synix yuguruye canke yagabanijwe. Umuyagankuba utagira amajwi uriko urumviriza ugushaka kwinjira. Amakuru yerekeye seriveri ahindurwa buri masegonda 10 igihe iriko irerekanwa. Gukoresha uburyo bwo gutandukanya abantu n'abo badasangiye igitsina biratuma umuntu adashobora kwinjiza amakuru ari kure atarinze guhagarika seriveri.

data.name: RemoteManager.WaitingClaim
data.value: Urindiriye ko ikonte yawe isaba guhuza...

data.name: RemoteManager.CodeExpired
data.value: Ikiringo c'ibanga cararangiye. Niwandike inomero nshasha yo guhuza.

data.name: RemoteManager.ClaimFormat
data.value: Gusaba kugenzura konti: {0} Wemeze gusa iyo ari izina ryawe ry'ukoresha.

data.name: RemoteManager.CheckFailed
data.value: Ntidushobora gusuzuma ugushira hamwe. Nusuzume ko ufise internet.

data.name: RemoteManager.Unavailable
data.value: Ntidushobora kuvugana n'umuyobozi wa Synix. Subira ugerageze.

data.name: RemoteManager.IdentitySoftware
data.value: Ideni rya mudasobwa: Windows-protected software key (TPM not available)

data.name: RemoteManager.RemovalPending
data.value: Bahagaritse guhanahana amakuru. Subira ugerageze gukuraho igihe uhujwe.

data.name: RemoteManager.LoadFailed
data.value: Gushira hamwe ntivyashoboye kwinjizwa. Uburyo bwo gushikira kure ntibukora.

data.name: RemoteManager.WaitingApproval
data.value: Harakenewe uruhusha rwo guhuza abantu n'abandi.

data.name: RemoteManager.SaveFailed
data.value: Uburyo bwo gushikira umuntu uvuye kure bwarakuweho. Amagenamiterere yo guhuza ntiyashoboye kuzigamwa.

data.name: RemoteManager.Listening
data.value: Gushira mu migwi y'abumviriza kugira binjire

data.name: RemoteManager.PairingRemoved
data.value: Gukorana n'urubuga vyakuweho. Uburyo bwo gushikira kure ntibukora.

data.name: RemoteManager.InvalidResponse
data.value: Umuyobozi wa Synix yasubije inyishu itari yo.

data.name: RemoteManager.FinishUnpair
data.value: Subira uhuze na internet hanyuma urangize gukuraho uburyo bwa kera bwo guhuza ubwa mbere.

data.name: RemoteManager.RecoveryInstructions
data.value: Hindura ijambo ry'ibanga ry'agateganyo ngaha. Koresha iri jambo ry'ibanga hamwe n'iryitwa 2FA canke iryitwa passkey kugira winjire ku rubuga. Nuce uhitamwo irindi jambo ry'ibanga. Nimba konti yawe ikeneye ubwo buryo bwose, uracakeneye ubwo buryo bwose. Ijambo ry'ibanga ry'agateganyo rishobora gukoreshwa rimwe gusa. Rihera inyuma y'iminota 10. Ijambo ry'ibanga rya mbere ukoresha riguma rifise agaciro gushika igihe igikorwa co gusubiza ibintu mu buryo kirangiye.

data.name: RemoteManager.RecoveryReady
data.value: Konti: {0}. Twiteguriye gushiraho ijambo ry'ibanga ry'agateganyo.

data.name: RemoteManager.RecoveryExpired
data.value: Gusubizwa amahera vyarangiye canke vyarahagaritswe. Subira utangure.

data.name: RemoteManager.RecoveryLimited
data.value: Hariho ibintu vyinshi vyasabwe. Subira ugerageze mu nyuma.

data.value: [SYNIX] Yasubiye guhuza na seriveri iriko ikora "{0}" yabonetse muri dosiye yayo yo kwinjiza (PID: {1}).

data.name: Settings.Backup.Transfer.RemoteAccessNotice
data.value: Gukorana n'umuntu ari kure ntibishobora guhindurwa. Niba ukoresha uburyo bwo kwinjira kure, shira hamwe mudasobwa nshasha n'ikonte yawe kuri manager.synix.info umaze gusubiza Synix.
